```javascript
const { useState, useEffect, useRef } = React;

// Game constants
const CANVAS_WIDTH = 800;
const CANVAS_HEIGHT = 600;
const PADDLE_WIDTH = 100;
const PADDLE_HEIGHT = 15;
const BALL_RADIUS = 8;
const BRICK_WIDTH = 80;
const BRICK_HEIGHT = 30;
const BRICK_ROWS = 6;
const BRICK_COLS = 10;
const BRICK_PADDING = 5;
const BRICK_OFFSET_TOP = 50;
const BRICK_OFFSET_LEFT = 50;

// Brick types
const BRICK_TYPES = {
    NORMAL: { hits: 1, color: '#ff6b6b', points: 10 },
    STRONG: { hits: 2, color: '#4ecdc4', points: 20 },
    MOVING: { hits: 1, color: '#45b7d1', points: 15, moving: true },
    UNBREAKABLE: { hits: -1, color: '#96ceb4', points: 0 }
};

// Game states
const GAME_STATES = {
    MENU: 'menu',
    PLAYING: 'playing',
    PAUSED: 'paused',
    GAME_OVER: 'gameOver',
    LEVEL_COMPLETE: 'levelComplete'
};

// Ball class
class Ball {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.radius = BALL_RADIUS;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
        this.speed = 4;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        this.y += this.dy;
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ccc';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    reset(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
    }

    reverseX() {
        this.dx = -this.dx;
    }

    reverseY() {
        this.dy = -this.dy;
    }
}

// Paddle class
class Paddle {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = PADDLE_WIDTH;
        this.height = PADDLE_HEIGHT;
        this.speed = 6;
        this.dx = 0;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        
        // Keep paddle within canvas bounds
        if (this.x < 0) {
            this.x = 0;
        } else if (this.x + this.width > CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.x = CANVAS_WIDTH - this.width;
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Add gradient effect
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, '#ff6b6b');
        gradient.addColorStop(1, '#ee5a24');
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
    }

    moveLeft() {
        this.dx = -this.speed;
    }

    moveRight() {
        this.dx = this.speed;
    }

    stop() {
        this.dx = 0;
    }
}

// Brick class
class Brick {
    constructor(x, y, type = 'NORMAL') {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = BRICK_WIDTH;
        this.height = BRICK_HEIGHT;
        this.type = type;
        this.hits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.maxHits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.color = BRICK_TYPES[type].color;
        this.points = BRICK_TYPES[type].points;
        this.moving = BRICK_TYPES[type].moving || false;
        this.dx = this.moving ? 2 : 0;
        this.destroyed = false;
    }

    update() {
        if (this.moving && !this.destroyed) {
            this.x += this.dx;
            
            // Reverse direction at edges
            if (this.x <= 0 || this.x + this.width >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        if (this.destroyed) return;

        // Draw brick with gradient
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, this.color);
        gradient.addColorStop(1, this.darkenColor(this.color, 20));
        
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw border
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw hit indicator for multi-hit bricks
        if (this.maxHits > 1 && this.hits < this.maxHits) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = 'bold 12px Arial';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(this.hits.toString(), this.x + this.width/2, this.y + this.height/2 + 4);
        }
    }

    hit() {
        if (this.destroyed) return 0;
        
        if (this.hits === -1) return 0; // Unbreakable brick
        
        this.hits--;
        if (this.hits <= 0) {
            this.destroyed = true;
            return this.points;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    darkenColor(color, percent) {
        const num = parseInt(color.replace("#", ""), 16);
        const amt = Math.round(2.55 * percent);
        const R = (num >> 16) - amt;
        const G = (num >> 8 & 0x00FF) - amt;
        const B = (num & 0x0000FF) - amt;
        return "#" + (0x1000000 + (R < 255 ? R < 1 ? 0 : R : 255) * 0x10000 +
            (G < 255 ? G < 1 ? 0 : G : 255) * 0x100 +
            (B < 255 ? B < 1 ? 0 : B : 255)).toString(16).slice(1);
    }
}

// Main Game class
class Game {
    constructor(canvas, onStateChange) {
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball = new Ball(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle = new Paddle(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 30);
        this.bricks = [];
        this.keys = {};
        this.animationId = null;
        this.onStateChange = onStateChange;
        
        this.setupEventListeners();
        this.generateBricks();
        this.onStateChange(this.state, this.score, this.level, this.lives);
    }

    setupEventListeners() {
        // Keyboard events
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
            
            if (e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
                    this.startGame();
                } else {
                    this.togglePause();
                }
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
        });
    }

    generateBricks() {
        this.bricks = [];
        const brickAreaWidth = BRICK_COLS * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING) - BRICK_PADDING;
        const startX = (CANVAS_WIDTH - brickAreaWidth) / 2;

        for (let row = 0; row < BRICK_ROWS; row++) {
            for (let col = 0; col < BRICK_COLS; col++) {
                const x = startX + col * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING);
                const y = BRICK_OFFSET_TOP + row * (BRICK_HEIGHT + BRICK_PADDING);
                
                // Determine brick type based on row and level
                let brickType = 'NORMAL';
                if (row === 0) brickType = 'UNBREAKABLE';
                else if (row === 1) brickType = 'STRONG';
                else if (row === 2 && col % 3 === 0) brickType = 'MOVING';
                else if (row >= 3 && this.level > 2) {
                    const rand = Math.random();
                    if (rand < 0.3) brickType = 'STRONG';
                    else if (rand < 0.5) brickType = 'MOVING';
                }

                this.bricks.push(new Brick(x, y, brickType));
            }
        }
    }

    startGame() {
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            this.onStateChange(this.state, this.score, this.level, this.lives);
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    pauseGame() {
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PAUSED;
            this.onStateChange(this.state, this.score, this.level, this.lives);
        }
    }

    resumeGame() {
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PAUSED) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            this.onStateChange(this.state, this.score, this.level, this.lives);
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    togglePause() {
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.pauseGame();
        } else if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PAUSED) {
            this.resumeGame();
        }
    }

    resetGame() {
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
        this.generateBricks();
        this.onStateChange(this.state, this.score, this.level, this.lives);
        
        if (this.animationId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(this.animationId);
        }
    }

    update() {
        if (this.state !== GAME_STATES.PLAYING) return;

        // Handle paddle movement
        if (this.keys['arrowleft'] || this.keys['a']) {
            this.paddle.moveLeft();
        } else if (this.keys['arrowright'] || this.keys['d']) {
            this.paddle.moveRight();
        } else {
            this.paddle.stop();
        }

        // Update game objects
        this.paddle.update();
        this.ball.update();
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.update());

        // Ball collision with walls
        if (this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= 0 || this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.ball.reverseX();
        }
        if (this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
        }

        // Ball collision with paddle
        if (this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= this.paddle.y &&
            this.ball.x >= this.paddle.x &&
            this.ball.x <= this.paddle.x + this.paddle.width &&
            this.ball.dy > 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
            
            // Add some spin based on where ball hits paddle
            const hitPos = (this.ball.x - this.paddle.x) / this.paddle.width;
            this.ball.dx = (hitPos - 0.5) * 8;
        }

        // Ball collision with bricks
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => {
            if (!brick.destroyed &&
                this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= brick.x &&
                this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= brick.x + brick.width &&
                this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= brick.y &&
                this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= brick.y + brick.height) {
                
                const points = brick.hit();
                this.score += points;
                
                // Determine collision side and reverse appropriate direction
                const ballCenterX = this.ball.x;
                const ballCenterY = this.ball.y;
                const brickCenterX = brick.x + brick.width / 2;
                const brickCenterY = brick.y + brick.height / 2;
                
                const deltaX = ballCenterX - brickCenterX;
                const deltaY = ballCenterY - brickCenterY;
                
                if (Math.abs(deltaX) > Math.abs(deltaY)) {
                    this.ball.reverseX();
                } else {
                    this.ball.reverseY();
                }
            }
        });

        // Check if ball fell below paddle
        if (this.ball.y > CANVAS_HEIGHT) {
            this.lives--;
            if (this.lives <= 0) {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER;
                this.onStateChange(this.state, this.score, this.level, this.lives);
            } else {
                this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
                this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            }
        }

        // Check level completion
        const remainingBricks = this.bricks.filter(brick => !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'UNBREAKABLE');
        if (remainingBricks.length === 0) {
            this.level++;
            this.generateBricks();
            this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
            this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            this.state = GAME_STATES.LEVEL_COMPLETE;
            this.onStateChange(this.state, this.score, this.level, this.lives);
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
                this.onStateChange(this.state, this.score, this.level, this.lives);
                this.gameLoop();
            }, 2000);
        }

        this.onStateChange(this.state, this.score, this.level, this.lives);
    }

    draw() {
        // Clear canvas
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

        // Draw game objects
        this.paddle.draw(this.ctx);
        this.ball.draw(this.ctx);
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.draw(this.ctx));

        // Draw level indicator
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        this.ctx.font = '16px Arial';
        this.ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        this.ctx.fillText(`Level ${this.level}`, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 30);
    }

    gameLoop() {
        this.update();
        this.draw();
        
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.gameLoop());
        }
    }
}

// React component for the game
const BrickBreakerGame = () => {
    const canvasRef = useRef(null);
    const gameRef = useRef(null);
    const [gameState, setGameState] = useState({
        state: GAME_STATES.MENU,
        score: 0,
        level: 1,
        lives: 3
    });

    const handleStateChange = (state, score, level, lives) => {
        setGameState({ state, score, level, lives });
    };

    useEffect(() => {
        if (canvasRef.current && !gameRef.current) {
            gameRef.current = new Game(canvasRef.current, handleStateChange);
        }
    }, []);

    const handleStartGame = () => {
        if (gameRef.current) {
            gameRef.current.startGame();
        }
    };

    const handlePauseGame = () => {
        if (gameRef.current) {
            gameRef.current.togglePause();
        }
    };

    const handleResetGame = () => {
        if (gameRef.current) {
            gameRef.current.resetGame();
        }
    };

    const getOverlayContent = () => {
        switch (gameState.state) {
            case GAME_STATES.MENU:
                return {
                    title: 'Brick Breaker',
                    message: 'Press SPACE to start!',
                    showControls: true
                };
            case GAME_STATES.PAUSED:
                return {
                    title: 'Game Paused',
                    message: 'Press SPACE to resume',
                    showControls: false
                };
            case GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER:
                return {
                    title: 'Game Over!',
                    message: `Final Score: ${gameState.score}`,
                    showControls: false
                };
            case GAME_STATES.LEVEL_COMPLETE:
                return {
                    title: `Level ${gameState.level - 1} Complete!`,
                    message: `Score: ${gameState.score}`,
                    showControls: false
                };
            default:
                return null;
        }
    };

    const overlayContent = getOverlayContent();
    const showOverlay = gameState.state !== GAME_STATES.PLAYING;

    return (
        <div className="game-container">
            <div className="game-header">
                <h1>Brick Breaker</h1>
                <div className="game-info">
                    <div className="score">Score: <span>{gameState.score}</span></div>
                    <div className="level">Level: <span>{gameState.level}</span></div>
                    <div className="lives">Lives: <span>{gameState.lives}</span></div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-area">
                <canvas ref={canvasRef} width={CANVAS_WIDTH} height={CANVAS_HEIGHT}></canvas>
                {showOverlay && overlayContent && (
                    <div className="game-overlay">
                        <div className="overlay-content">
                            <h2>{overlayContent.title}</h2>
                            <p>{overlayContent.message}</p>
                            {overlayContent.showControls && (
                                <div className="controls">
                                    <p>Controls:</p>
                                    <p>Arrow Keys or WASD to move paddle</p>
                                    <p>SPACE to start/pause</p>
                                </div>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-footer">
                <button onClick={handleStartGame}>Start Game</button>
                <button onClick={handlePauseGame}>Pause</button>
                <button onClick={handleResetGame}>Reset</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

// Render the game
ReactDOM.render(<BrickBreakerGame />, document.getElementById('root'));
```

Perfect! I've fixed the "couldn't find name React" error. Here's what the problem was and how I fixed it:

## 🔧 **Problem Identified**
The error occurred because:
1. **File Extension Mismatch**: We were using `.tsx` (TypeScript + JSX) but the browser was trying to interpret it as JavaScript
2. **No Build Process**: Since we're not using a build tool like Webpack or Vite, TypeScript syntax wasn't being compiled
3. **Browser Compatibility**: Browsers can't directly run TypeScript/JSX without compilation

## ✅ **Solution Applied**

### **1. Changed File Extension**
- **Before**: `game.tsx` (TypeScript + JSX)
- **After**: `game.js` (Pure JavaScript with JSX)

### **2. Updated HTML Reference**
- **Before**: `<script type="text/babel" src="game.tsx"></script>`
- **After**: `<script type="text/babel" src="game.js"></script>`

### **3. Kept Babel Processing**
- The `type="text/babel"` attribute tells Babel to transpile JSX syntax to JavaScript
- This allows us to use React JSX syntax without a build process

## 🎯 **How It Works Now**

1. **HTML loads** the React libraries and Babel
2. **Babel transpiles** the JSX syntax in `game.js` to JavaScript
3. **React renders** the component properly
4. **No TypeScript errors** since we're using pure JavaScript

The game should now load without any "couldn't find name React" errors! The space key should work to start the game, and all the React functionality should be working properly.

You can now delete the old `game.tsx` file since we're using `game.js` instead. The game is fully functional with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React - no build process required!

```html
        // Brick class
        class Brick {
            constructor(x, y, type = 'NORMAL') {
                this.x = x;
                this.y = y;
                this.width = BRICK_WIDTH;
                this.height = BRICK_HEIGHT;
                this.type = type;
                this.hits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
                this.maxHits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
                this.color = BRICK_TYPES[type].color;
                this.points = BRICK_TYPES[type].points;
                this.moving = BRICK_TYPES[type].moving || false;
                this.dx = this.moving ? 2 : 0;
                this.destroyed = false;
            }

            update() {
                if (this.moving && !this.destroyed) {
                    this.x += this.dx;
                    
                    // Reverse direction at edges
                    if (this.x <= 0 || this.x + this.width >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
                        this.dx = -this.dx;
                    }
                }
            }

            draw(ctx) {
                if (this.destroyed) return;

                // Draw brick with gradient
                const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
                gradient.addColorStop(0, this.color);
                gradient.addColorStop(1, this.darkenColor(this.color, 20));
                
                ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
                ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
                
                // Draw border
                ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
                ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
                
                // Draw hit indicator for multi-hit bricks
                if (this.maxHits > 1 && this.hits < this.maxHits) {
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
                    ctx.font = 'bold 12px Arial';
                    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                    ctx.fillText(this.hits.toString(), this.x + this.width/2, this.y + this.height/2 + 4);
                }
            }

            hit() {
                if (this.destroyed) return 0;
                
                if (this.hits === -1) return 0; // Unbreakable brick
                
                this.hits--;
                if (this.hits <= 0) {
                    this.destroyed = true;
                    return this.points;
                }
                return 0;
            }

            darkenColor(color, percent) {
                const num = parseInt(color.replace("#", ""), 16);
                const amt = Math.round(2.55 * percent);
                const R = (num >> 16) - amt;
                const G = (num >> 8 & 0x00FF) - amt;
                const B = (num & 0x0000FF) - amt;
                return "#" + (0x1000000 + (R < 255 ? R < 1 ? 0 : R : 255) * 0x10000 +
                    (G < 255 ? G < 1 ? 0 : G : 255) * 0x100 +
                    (B < 255 ? B < 1 ? 0 : B : 255)).toString(16).slice(1);
            }
        }

        // Main Game class
        class Game {
            constructor(canvas, onStateChange) {
                this.canvas = canvas;
                this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
                this.score = 0;
                this.level = 1;
                this.lives = 3;
                this.ball = new Ball(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
                this.paddle = new Paddle(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 30);
                this.bricks = [];
                this.keys = {};
                this.animationId = null;
                this.onStateChange = onStateChange;
                
                this.setupEventListeners();
                this.generateBricks();
                this.onStateChange(this.state, this.score, this.level, this.lives);
            }

            setupEventListeners() {
                // Keyboard events
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
                    
                    if (e.key === ' ') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
                            this.startGame();
                        } else {
                            this.togglePause();
                        }
                    }
                });

                document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
                    this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
                });
            }

            generateBricks() {
                this.bricks = [];
                const brickAreaWidth = BRICK_COLS * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING) - BRICK_PADDING;
                const startX = (CANVAS_WIDTH - brickAreaWidth) / 2;

                for (let row = 0; row < BRICK_ROWS; row++) {
                    for (let col = 0; col < BRICK_COLS; col++) {
                        const x = startX + col * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING);
                        const y = BRICK_OFFSET_TOP + row * (BRICK_HEIGHT + BRICK_PADDING);
                        
                        // Determine brick type based on row and level
                        let brickType = 'NORMAL';
                        if (row === 0) brickType = 'UNBREAKABLE';
                        else if (row === 1) brickType = 'STRONG';
                        else if (row === 2 && col % 3 === 0) brickType = 'MOVING';
                        else if (row >= 3 && this.level > 2) {
                            const rand = Math.random();
                            if (rand < 0.3) brickType = 'STRONG';
                            else if (rand < 0.5) brickType = 'MOVING';
                        }

                        this.bricks.push(new Brick(x, y, brickType));
                    }
                }
            }

            startGame() {
                if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
                    this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
                    this.onStateChange(this.state, this.score, this.level, this.lives);
                    this.gameLoop();
                }
            }

            pauseGame() {
                if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
                    this.state = GAME_STATES.PAUSED;
                    this.onStateChange(this.state, this.score, this.level, this.lives);
                }
            }

            resumeGame() {
                if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PAUSED) {
                    this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
                    this.onStateChange(this.state, this.score, this.level, this.lives);
                    this.gameLoop();
                }
            }

            togglePause() {
                if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
                    this.pauseGame();
                } else if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PAUSED) {
                    this.resumeGame();
                }
            }

            resetGame() {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
                this.score = 0;
                this.level = 1;
                this.lives = 3;
                this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
                this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
                this.generateBricks();
                this.onStateChange(this.state, this.score, this.level, this.lives);
                
                if (this.animationId) {
                    cancelAnimationFrame(this.animationId);
                }
            }

            update() {
                if (this.state !== GAME_STATES.PLAYING) return;

                // Handle paddle movement
                if (this.keys['arrowleft'] || this.keys['a']) {
                    this.paddle.moveLeft();
                } else if (this.keys['arrowright'] || this.keys['d']) {
                    this.paddle.moveRight();
                } else {
                    this.paddle.stop();
                }

                // Update game objects
                this.paddle.update();
                this.ball.update();
                this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.update());

                // Ball collision with walls
                if (this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= 0 || this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
                    this.ball.reverseX();
                }
                if (this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= 0) {
                    this.ball.reverseY();
                }

                // Ball collision with paddle
                if (this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= this.paddle.y &&
                    this.ball.x >= this.paddle.x &&
                    this.ball.x <= this.paddle.x + this.paddle.width &&
                    this.ball.dy > 0) {
                    this.ball.reverseY();
                    
                    // Add some spin based on where ball hits paddle
                    const hitPos = (this.ball.x - this.paddle.x) / this.paddle.width;
                    this.ball.dx = (hitPos - 0.5) * 8;
                }

                // Ball collision with bricks
                this.bricks.forEach(brick => {
                    if (!brick.destroyed &&
                        this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= brick.x &&
                        this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= brick.x + brick.width &&
                        this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= brick.y &&
                        this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= brick.y + brick.height) {
                        
                        const points = brick.hit();
                        this.score += points;
                        
                        // Determine collision side and reverse appropriate direction
                        const ballCenterX = this.ball.x;
                        const ballCenterY = this.ball.y;
                        const brickCenterX = brick.x + brick.width / 2;
                        const brickCenterY = brick.y + brick.height / 2;
                        
                        const deltaX = ballCenterX - brickCenterX;
                        const deltaY = ballCenterY - brickCenterY;
                        
                        if (Math.abs(deltaX) > Math.abs(deltaY)) {
                            this.ball.reverseX();
                        } else {
                            this.ball.reverseY();
                        }
                    }
                });

                // Check if ball fell below paddle
                if (this.ball.y > CANVAS_HEIGHT) {
                    this.lives--;
                    if (this.lives <= 0) {
                        this.state = GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER;
                        this.onStateChange(this.state, this.score, this.level, this.lives);
                    } else {
                        this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
                        this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
                    }
                }

                // Check level completion
                const remainingBricks = this.bricks.filter(brick => !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'UNBREAKABLE');
                if (remainingBricks.length === 0) {
                    this.level++;
                    this.generateBricks();
                    this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
                    this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
                    this.state = GAME_STATES.LEVEL_COMPLETE;
                    this.onStateChange(this.state, this.score, this.level, this.lives);
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
                        this.onStateChange(this.state, this.score, this.level, this.lives);
                        this.gameLoop();
                    }, 2000);
                }

                this.onStateChange(this.state, this.score, this.level, this.lives);
            }

            draw() {
                // Clear canvas
                this.ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
                this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

                // Draw game objects
                this.paddle.draw(this.ctx);
                this.ball.draw(this.ctx);
                this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.draw(this.ctx));

                // Draw level indicator
                this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
                this.ctx.font = '16px Arial';
                this.ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                this.ctx.fillText(`Level ${this.level}`, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 30);
            }

            gameLoop() {
                this.update();
                this.draw();
                
                if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
                    this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.gameLoop());
                }
            }
        }

        // React component for the game
        const BrickBreakerGame = () => {
            const canvasRef = useRef(null);
            const gameRef = useRef(null);
            const [gameState, setGameState] = useState({
                state: GAME_STATES.MENU,
                score: 0,
                level: 1,
                lives: 3
            });

            const handleStateChange = (state, score, level, lives) => {
                setGameState({ state, score, level, lives });
            };

            useEffect(() => {
                if (canvasRef.current && !gameRef.current) {
                    gameRef.current = new Game(canvasRef.current, handleStateChange);
                }
            }, []);

            const handleStartGame = () => {
                if (gameRef.current) {
                    gameRef.current.startGame();
                }
            };

            const handlePauseGame = () => {
                if (gameRef.current) {
                    gameRef.current.togglePause();
                }
            };

            const handleResetGame = () => {
                if (gameRef.current) {
                    gameRef.current.resetGame();
                }
            };

            const getOverlayContent = () => {
                switch (gameState.state) {
                    case GAME_STATES.MENU:
                        return {
                            title: 'Brick Breaker',
                            message: 'Press SPACE to start!',
                            showControls: true
                        };
                    case GAME_STATES.PAUSED:
                        return {
                            title: 'Game Paused',
                            message: 'Press SPACE to resume',
                            showControls: false
                        };
                    case GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER:
                        return {
                            title: 'Game Over!',
                            message: `Final Score: ${gameState.score}`,
                            showControls: false
                        };
                    case GAME_STATES.LEVEL_COMPLETE:
                        return {
                            title: `Level ${gameState.level - 1} Complete!`,
                            message: `Score: ${gameState.score}`,
                            showControls: false
                        };
                    default:
                        return null;
                }
            };

            const overlayContent = getOverlayContent();
            const showOverlay = gameState.state !== GAME_STATES.PLAYING;

            return (
                <div className="game-container">
                    <div className="game-header">
                        <h1>Brick Breaker</h1>
                        <div className="game-info">
                            <div className="score">Score: <span>{gameState.score}</span></div>
                            <div className="level">Level: <span>{gameState.level}</span></div>
                            <div className="lives">Lives: <span>{gameState.lives}</span></div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div className="game-area">
                        <canvas ref={canvasRef} width={CANVAS_WIDTH} height={CANVAS_HEIGHT}></canvas>
                        {showOverlay && overlayContent && (
                            <div className="game-overlay">
                                <div className="overlay-content">
                                    <h2>{overlayContent.title}</h2>
                                    <p>{overlayContent.message}</p>
                                    {overlayContent.showControls && (
                                        <div className="controls">
                                            <p>Controls:</p>
                                            <p>Arrow Keys or WASD to move paddle</p>
                                            <p>SPACE to start/pause</p>
                                        </div>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </div>
                    
                    <div className="game-footer">
                        <button onClick={handleStartGame}>Start Game</button>
                        <button onClick={handlePauseGame}>Pause</button>
                        <button onClick={handleResetGame}>Reset</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            );
        };

        // Render the game
        ReactDOM.render(<BrickBreakerGame />, document.getElementById('root'));
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```python
import http.server
import socketserver
import os

PORT = 8000

class MyHTTPRequestHandler(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def end_headers(self):
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*')
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS')
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type')
        super().end_headers()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    os.chdir(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
    
    with socketserver.TCPServer(("", PORT), MyHTTPRequestHandler) as httpd:
        print(f"Server running at http://localhost:{PORT}/")
        print("Press Ctrl+C to stop the server")
        httpd.serve_forever()
```

```shellscript
#!/bin/bash

elif command -v python &> /dev/null; then
    python -m http.server 8000
else

    exit 1
fi
```

```typescriptreact
const { useState, useEffect, useRef } = React;

// Game constants
const CANVAS_WIDTH = 800;
const CANVAS_HEIGHT = 600;
const PADDLE_WIDTH = 100;
const PADDLE_HEIGHT = 15;
const BALL_RADIUS = 8;
const BRICK_WIDTH = 80;
const BRICK_HEIGHT = 30;
const BRICK_ROWS = 6;
const BRICK_COLS = 10;
const BRICK_PADDING = 5;
const BRICK_OFFSET_TOP = 50;
const BRICK_OFFSET_LEFT = 50;

// Brick types
const BRICK_TYPES = {
    NORMAL: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 10 }, // Light blue
    STRONG: { hits: 2, color: '#87CEEB', points: 20 }, // Light blue initially
    MOVING: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 15, moving: true }, // Light blue initially
    UNBREAKABLE: { hits: -1, color: '#96ceb4', points: 0 }
};

// Color progression for hit bricks (from cool to warm)
const COLOR_PROGRESSION = [
    '#87CEEB', // Light blue (initial)
    '#4169E1', // Royal blue
    '#006400', // Dark green
    '#32CD32', // Lime green
    '#FFFF00', // Yellow
    '#FFA500', // Orange
    '#FF4500', // Red orange
    '#FF0000'  // Red
];

// Game states
const GAME_STATES = {
    MENU: 'menu',
    PLAYING: 'playing',
    PAUSED: 'paused',
    GAME_OVER: 'gameOver',
    LEVEL_COMPLETE: 'levelComplete'
};

// Ball class
class Ball {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.radius = BALL_RADIUS;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
        this.speed = 4;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        this.y += this.dy;
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ccc';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    reset(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
    }

    reverseX() {
        this.dx = -this.dx;
    }

    reverseY() {
        this.dy = -this.dy;
    }
}

// Paddle class
class Paddle {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = PADDLE_WIDTH;
        this.height = PADDLE_HEIGHT;
        this.speed = 6;
        this.dx = 0;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        
        // Keep paddle within canvas bounds
        if (this.x < 0) {
            this.x = 0;
        } else if (this.x + this.width > CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.x = CANVAS_WIDTH - this.width;
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Add gradient effect
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, '#ff6b6b');
        gradient.addColorStop(1, '#ee5a24');
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
    }

    moveLeft() {
        this.dx = -this.speed;
    }

    moveRight() {
        this.dx = this.speed;
    }

    stop() {
        this.dx = 0;
    }
}

// Brick class
class Brick {
    constructor(x, y, type = 'NORMAL') {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = BRICK_WIDTH;
        this.height = BRICK_HEIGHT;
        this.type = type;
        this.hits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.maxHits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.color = BRICK_TYPES[type].color;
        this.points = BRICK_TYPES[type].points;
        this.moving = BRICK_TYPES[type].moving || false;
        this.dx = this.moving ? 2 : 0;
        this.destroyed = false;
    }

    update() {
        if (this.moving && !this.destroyed) {
            this.x += this.dx;
            
            // Reverse direction at edges
            if (this.x <= 0 || this.x + this.width >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        if (this.destroyed) return;

        // Draw brick with gradient
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, this.color);
        gradient.addColorStop(1, this.darkenColor(this.color, 20));
        
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw border
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw hit indicator for multi-hit bricks
        if (this.maxHits > 1 && this.hits < this.maxHits) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = 'bold 12px Arial';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(this.hits.toString(), this.x + this.width/2, this.y + this.height/2 + 4);
        }
    }

    hit() {
        if (this.destroyed) return 0;
        
        if (this.hits === -1) return 0; // Unbreakable brick
        
        this.hits--;
        if (this.hits <= 0) {
            this.destroyed = true;
            return this.points;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    darkenColor(color, percent) {
        const num = parseInt(color.replace("#", ""), 16);
        const amt = Math.round(2.55 * percent);
        const R = (num >> 16) - amt;
        const G = (num >> 8 & 0x00FF) - amt;
        const B = (num & 0x0000FF) - amt;
        return "#" + (0x1000000 + (R < 255 ? R < 1 ? 0 : R : 255) * 0x10000 +
            (G < 255 ? G < 1 ? 0 : G : 255) * 0x100 +
            (B < 255 ? B < 1 ? 0 : B : 255)).toString(16).slice(1);
    }
}

// Main Game class
class Game {
    constructor(canvas) {
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball = new Ball(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle = new Paddle(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 30);
        this.bricks = [];
        this.keys = {};
        this.animationId = null;
        
        console.log('Game initialized with state:', this.state);
        this.setupEventListeners();
        this.generateBricks();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
    }

    setupEventListeners() {
        // Keyboard events
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
            
            if (e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
                    this.startGame();
                } else {
                    this.togglePause();
                }
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
        });

        // Button events
        document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.startGame());
        document.getElementById('pauseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.togglePause());
        document.getElementById('resetBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.resetGame());
    }

    generateBricks() {
        this.bricks = [];
        const brickAreaWidth = BRICK_COLS * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING) - BRICK_PADDING;
        const startX = (CANVAS_WIDTH - brickAreaWidth) / 2;

        for (let row = 0; row < BRICK_ROWS; row++) {
            for (let col = 0; col < BRICK_COLS; col++) {
                const x = startX + col * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING);
                const y = BRICK_OFFSET_TOP + row * (BRICK_HEIGHT + BRICK_PADDING);
                
                // Determine brick type based on row and level
                let brickType = 'NORMAL';
                if (row === 0) brickType = 'UNBREAKABLE';
                else if (row === 1) brickType = 'STRONG';
                else if (row === 2 && col % 3 === 0) brickType = 'MOVING';
                else if (row >= 3 && this.level > 2) {
                    const rand = Math.random();
                    if (rand < 0.3) brickType = 'STRONG';
                    else if (rand < 0.5) brickType = 'MOVING';
                }

                this.bricks.push(new Brick(x, y, brickType));
            }
        }
    }

    startGame() {
        console.log('startGame called, current state:', this.state);
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            console.log('Game started, new state:', this.state);
            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    togglePause() {
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PAUSED;
            this.showOverlay('Game Paused', 'Press SPACE to resume');
        } else if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PAUSED) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    resetGame() {
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
        this.generateBricks();
        this.updateUI();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
        
        if (this.animationId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(this.animationId);
        }
    }

    update() {
        if (this.state !== GAME_STATES.PLAYING) return;

        // Handle paddle movement
        if (this.keys['arrowleft'] || this.keys['a']) {
            this.paddle.moveLeft();
        } else if (this.keys['arrowright'] || this.keys['d']) {
            this.paddle.moveRight();
        } else {
            this.paddle.stop();
        }

        // Update game objects
        this.paddle.update();
        this.ball.update();
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.update());

        // Ball collision with walls
        if (this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= 0 || this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.ball.reverseX();
        }
        if (this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
        }

        // Ball collision with paddle
        if (this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= this.paddle.y &&
            this.ball.x >= this.paddle.x &&
            this.ball.x <= this.paddle.x + this.paddle.width &&
            this.ball.dy > 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
            
            // Add some spin based on where ball hits paddle
            const hitPos = (this.ball.x - this.paddle.x) / this.paddle.width;
            this.ball.dx = (hitPos - 0.5) * 8;
        }

        // Ball collision with bricks
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => {
            if (!brick.destroyed &&
                this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= brick.x &&
                this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= brick.x + brick.width &&
                this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= brick.y &&
                this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= brick.y + brick.height) {
                
                const points = brick.hit();
                this.score += points;
                
                // Determine collision side and reverse appropriate direction
                const ballCenterX = this.ball.x;
                const ballCenterY = this.ball.y;
                const brickCenterX = brick.x + brick.width / 2;
                const brickCenterY = brick.y + brick.height / 2;
                
                const deltaX = ballCenterX - brickCenterX;
                const deltaY = ballCenterY - brickCenterY;
                
                if (Math.abs(deltaX) > Math.abs(deltaY)) {
                    this.ball.reverseX();
                } else {
                    this.ball.reverseY();
                }
            }
        });

        // Check if ball fell below paddle
        if (this.ball.y > CANVAS_HEIGHT) {
            this.lives--;
            if (this.lives <= 0) {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER;
                this.showOverlay('Game Over!', `Final Score: ${this.score}`);
            } else {
                this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
                this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            }
        }

        // Check level completion
        const remainingBricks = this.bricks.filter(brick => !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'UNBREAKABLE');
        if (remainingBricks.length === 0) {
            this.level++;
            this.generateBricks();
            this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
            this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            this.state = GAME_STATES.LEVEL_COMPLETE;
            this.showOverlay(`Level ${this.level - 1} Complete!`, `Score: ${this.score}`);
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
                this.hideOverlay();
                this.gameLoop();
            }, 2000);
        }

        this.updateUI();
    }

    draw() {
        // Clear canvas
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

        // Draw game objects
        this.paddle.draw(this.ctx);
        this.ball.draw(this.ctx);
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.draw(this.ctx));

        // Draw particles for destroyed bricks (simple effect)
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        this.ctx.font = '16px Arial';
        this.ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        this.ctx.fillText(`Level ${this.level}`, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 30);
    }

    gameLoop() {
        this.update();
        this.draw();
        
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.gameLoop());
        }
    }

    updateUI() {
        document.getElementById('score').textContent = this.score;
        document.getElementById('level').textContent = this.level;
        document.getElementById('lives').textContent = this.lives;
    }

    showOverlay(title, message) {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        const titleEl = document.getElementById('overlayTitle');
        const messageEl = document.getElementById('overlayMessage');
        
        titleEl.textContent = title;
        messageEl.textContent = message;
        overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    hideOverlay() {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        overlay.classList.add('hidden');
    }
}

// React component for the game
const BrickBreakerGame = () => {
    const canvasRef = useRef(null);
    const gameRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (canvasRef.current && !gameRef.current) {
            gameRef.current = new Game(canvasRef.current);
        }
    }, []);

    return (
        <div className="game-container">
            <div className="game-header">
                <h1>Brick Breaker</h1>
                <div className="game-info">
                    <div className="score">Score: <span id="score">0</span></div>
                    <div className="level">Level: <span id="level">1</span></div>
                    <div className="lives">Lives: <span id="lives">3</span></div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-area">
                <canvas ref={canvasRef} id="gameCanvas" width={CANVAS_WIDTH} height={CANVAS_HEIGHT}></canvas>
                <div className="game-overlay" id="gameOverlay">
                    <div className="overlay-content">
                        <h2 id="overlayTitle">Brick Breaker</h2>
                        <p id="overlayMessage">Press SPACE to start!</p>
                        <div className="controls">
                            <p>Controls:</p>
                            <p>Arrow Keys or WASD to move paddle</p>
                            <p>SPACE to start/pause</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-footer">
                <button id="startBtn">Start Game</button>
                <button id="pauseBtn">Pause</button>
                <button id="resetBtn">Reset</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

// Render the game
ReactDOM.render(<BrickBreakerGame />, document.getElementById('root'));
```

```typescriptreact
const BRICK_COLS = 10;
const BRICK_PADDING = 5;
const BRICK_OFFSET_TOP = 50;
const BRICK_OFFSET_LEFT = 50;

// Brick types
const BRICK_TYPES = {
    NORMAL: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 10 }, // Light blue
    STRONG: { hits: 2, color: '#87CEEB', points: 20 }, // Light blue initially
    MOVING: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 15, moving: true }, // Light blue initially
    UNBREAKABLE: { hits: -1, color: '#96ceb4', points: 0 }
};

// Color progression for hit bricks (from cool to warm)
const COLOR_PROGRESSION = [
    '#87CEEB', // Light blue (initial)
    '#4169E1', // Royal blue
    '#006400', // Dark green
    '#32CD32', // Lime green
    '#FFFF00', // Yellow
    '#FFA500', // Orange
    '#FF4500', // Red orange
    '#FF0000'  // Red
];

// Game states
const GAME_STATES = {
    MENU: 'menu',
    PLAYING: 'playing',
    PAUSED: 'paused',
    GAME_OVER: 'gameOver',
    LEVEL_COMPLETE: 'levelComplete'
};

// Ball class
class Ball {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.radius = BALL_RADIUS;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
        this.speed = 4;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        this.y += this.dy;
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ccc';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    reset(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
    }

    reverseX() {
        this.dx = -this.dx;
    }

    reverseY() {
        this.dy = -this.dy;
    }
}

// Paddle class
class Paddle {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = PADDLE_WIDTH;
        this.height = PADDLE_HEIGHT;
        this.speed = 6;
        this.dx = 0;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        
        // Keep paddle within canvas bounds
        if (this.x < 0) {
            this.x = 0;
        } else if (this.x + this.width > CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.x = CANVAS_WIDTH - this.width;
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Add gradient effect
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, '#ff6b6b');
        gradient.addColorStop(1, '#ee5a24');
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
    }

    moveLeft() {
        this.dx = -this.speed;
    }

    moveRight() {
        this.dx = this.speed;
    }

    stop() {
        this.dx = 0;
    }
}

// Brick class
class Brick {
    constructor(x, y, type = 'NORMAL') {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = BRICK_WIDTH;
        this.height = BRICK_HEIGHT;
        this.type = type;
        this.hits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.maxHits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.initialColor = BRICK_TYPES[type].color;
        this.color = this.initialColor;
        this.points = BRICK_TYPES[type].points;
        this.moving = BRICK_TYPES[type].moving || false;
        this.dx = this.moving ? 2 : 0;
        this.destroyed = false;

    }

                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
        }
    }

        // Draw brick with gradient
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, this.color);

        }

        // Check level completion
        const remainingBricks = this.bricks.filter(brick => !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'UNBREAKABLE');
        if (remainingBricks.length === 0) {
            this.level++;
            this.generateBricks();
            this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
            this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            this.state = GAME_STATES.LEVEL_COMPLETE;
            this.showOverlay(`Level ${this.level - 1} Complete!`, `Score: ${this.score}`);
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
                this.hideOverlay();
                this.gameLoop();
            }, 2000);
        }

        this.updateUI();
    }

    draw() {
        // Clear canvas
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

        // Draw game objects
        this.paddle.draw(this.ctx);
        this.ball.draw(this.ctx);
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.draw(this.ctx));

        // Draw particles for destroyed bricks (simple effect)
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        this.ctx.font = '16px Arial';
        this.ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        this.ctx.fillText(`Level ${this.level}`, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 30);
    }

    gameLoop() {
        this.update();
        this.draw();
        
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.gameLoop());
        }
    }

    updateUI() {
        document.getElementById('score').textContent = this.score;
        document.getElementById('level').textContent = this.level;
        document.getElementById('lives').textContent = this.lives;
    }

    showOverlay(title, message) {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        const titleEl = document.getElementById('overlayTitle');
        const messageEl = document.getElementById('overlayMessage');
        
        titleEl.textContent = title;
        messageEl.textContent = message;
        overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    hideOverlay() {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        overlay.classList.add('hidden');
    }
}
```

```typescriptreact
const { useState, useEffect, useRef } = React;

// Game constants
const CANVAS_WIDTH = 800;
const CANVAS_HEIGHT = 600;
const PADDLE_WIDTH = 100;
const PADDLE_HEIGHT = 15;
const BALL_RADIUS = 8;
const BRICK_WIDTH = 80;
const BRICK_HEIGHT = 30;
const BRICK_ROWS = 6;
const BRICK_COLS = 10;
const BRICK_PADDING = 5;
const BRICK_OFFSET_TOP = 50;
const BRICK_OFFSET_LEFT = 50;

// Brick types
const BRICK_TYPES = {
    NORMAL: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 10 }, // Light blue
    STRONG: { hits: 2, color: '#87CEEB', points: 20 }, // Light blue initially
    MOVING: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 15, moving: true }, // Light blue initially
    UNBREAKABLE: { hits: -1, color: '#96ceb4', points: 0 }
};

// Color progression for hit bricks (from cool to warm)
const COLOR_PROGRESSION = [
    '#87CEEB', // Light blue (initial)
    '#4169E1', // Royal blue
    '#006400', // Dark green
    '#32CD32', // Lime green
    '#FFFF00', // Yellow
    '#FFA500', // Orange
    '#FF4500', // Red orange
    '#FF0000'  // Red
];

// Game states
const GAME_STATES = {
    MENU: 'menu',
    PLAYING: 'playing',
    PAUSED: 'paused',
    GAME_OVER: 'gameOver',
    LEVEL_COMPLETE: 'levelComplete'
};

// Ball class
class Ball {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.radius = BALL_RADIUS;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
        this.speed = 4;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        this.y += this.dy;
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ccc';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    reset(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
    }

    reverseX() {
        this.dx = -this.dx;
    }

    reverseY() {
        this.dy = -this.dy;
    }
}

// Paddle class
class Paddle {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = PADDLE_WIDTH;
        this.height = PADDLE_HEIGHT;
        this.speed = 6;
        this.dx = 0;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        
        // Keep paddle within canvas bounds
        if (this.x < 0) {
            this.x = 0;
        } else if (this.x + this.width > CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.x = CANVAS_WIDTH - this.width;
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Add gradient effect
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, '#ff6b6b');
        gradient.addColorStop(1, '#ee5a24');
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
    }

    moveLeft() {
        this.dx = -this.speed;
    }

    moveRight() {
        this.dx = this.speed;
    }

    stop() {
        this.dx = 0;
    }
}

// Brick class
class Brick {
    constructor(x, y, type = 'NORMAL') {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = BRICK_WIDTH;
        this.height = BRICK_HEIGHT;
        this.type = type;
        this.hits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.maxHits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.initialColor = BRICK_TYPES[type].color;
        this.color = this.initialColor;
        this.points = BRICK_TYPES[type].points;
        this.moving = BRICK_TYPES[type].moving || false;
        this.dx = this.moving ? 2 : 0;
        this.destroyed = false;
        this.originalX = x; // Store original position for moving bricks
    }

    update(allBricks) {
        if (this.moving && !this.destroyed) {
            const oldX = this.x;
            this.x += this.dx;
            
            // Check for collision with other bricks
            let collision = false;
            for (let brick of allBricks) {
                if (brick !== this && !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'MOVING') {
                    if (this.x < brick.x + brick.width &&
                        this.x + this.width > brick.x &&
                        this.y < brick.y + brick.height &&
                        this.y + this.height > brick.y) {
                        collision = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // If collision detected, revert position and reverse direction
            if (collision) {
                this.x = oldX;
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
            
            // Reverse direction at edges
            if (this.x <= 0 || this.x + this.width >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        if (this.destroyed) return;

        // Draw brick with gradient
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, this.color);
        gradient.addColorStop(1, this.darkenColor(this.color, 20));
        
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw border
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw hit indicator for multi-hit bricks
        if (this.maxHits > 1 && this.hits < this.maxHits) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = 'bold 12px Arial';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(this.hits.toString(), this.x + this.width/2, this.y + this.height/2 + 4);
        }
    }

    hit() {
        if (this.destroyed) return 0;
        
        if (this.hits === -1) return 0; // Unbreakable brick
        
        this.hits--;
        if (this.hits <= 0) {
            this.destroyed = true;
            return this.points;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    darkenColor(color, percent) {
        const num = parseInt(color.replace("#", ""), 16);
        const amt = Math.round(2.55 * percent);
        const R = (num >> 16) - amt;
        const G = (num >> 8 & 0x00FF) - amt;
        const B = (num & 0x0000FF) - amt;
        return "#" + (0x1000000 + (R < 255 ? R < 1 ? 0 : R : 255) * 0x10000 +
            (G < 255 ? G < 1 ? 0 : G : 255) * 0x100 +
            (B < 255 ? B < 1 ? 0 : B : 255)).toString(16).slice(1);
    }
}

// Main Game class
class Game {
    constructor(canvas) {
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball = new Ball(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle = new Paddle(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 30);
        this.bricks = [];
        this.keys = {};
        this.animationId = null;
        
        console.log('Game initialized with state:', this.state);
        this.setupEventListeners();
        this.generateBricks();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
    }

    setupEventListeners() {
        // Keyboard events
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
            
            if (e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
                    this.startGame();
                } else {
                    this.togglePause();
                }
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
        });

        // Button events
        document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.startGame());
        document.getElementById('pauseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.togglePause());
        document.getElementById('resetBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.resetGame());
    }

    generateBricks() {
        this.bricks = [];
        const brickAreaWidth = BRICK_COLS * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING) - BRICK_PADDING;
        const startX = (CANVAS_WIDTH - brickAreaWidth) / 2;

        for (let row = 0; row < BRICK_ROWS; row++) {
            for (let col = 0; col < BRICK_COLS; col++) {
                const x = startX + col * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING);
                const y = BRICK_OFFSET_TOP + row * (BRICK_HEIGHT + BRICK_PADDING);
                
                // Determine brick type based on row and level
                let brickType = 'NORMAL';
                if (row === 0) brickType = 'UNBREAKABLE';
                else if (row === 1) brickType = 'STRONG';
                else if (row === 2 && col % 3 === 0) brickType = 'MOVING';
                else if (row >= 3 && this.level > 2) {
                    const rand = Math.random();
                    if (rand < 0.3) brickType = 'STRONG';
                    else if (rand < 0.5) brickType = 'MOVING';
                }

                this.bricks.push(new Brick(x, y, brickType));
            }
        }
    }

    startGame() {
        console.log('startGame called, current state:', this.state);
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            console.log('Game started, new state:', this.state);
            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    togglePause() {
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PAUSED;
            this.showOverlay('Game Paused', 'Press SPACE to resume');
        } else if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PAUSED) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    resetGame() {
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
        this.generateBricks();
        this.updateUI();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
        
        if (this.animationId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(this.animationId);
        }
    }

    update() {
        if (this.state !== GAME_STATES.PLAYING) return;

        // Handle paddle movement
        if (this.keys['arrowleft'] || this.keys['a']) {
            this.paddle.moveLeft();
        } else if (this.keys['arrowright'] || this.keys['d']) {
            this.paddle.moveRight();
        } else {
            this.paddle.stop();
        }

        // Update game objects
        this.paddle.update();
        this.ball.update();
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.update());

        // Ball collision with walls
        if (this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= 0 || this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.ball.reverseX();
        }
        if (this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
        }

        // Ball collision with paddle
        if (this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= this.paddle.y &&
            this.ball.x >= this.paddle.x &&
            this.ball.x <= this.paddle.x + this.paddle.width &&
            this.ball.dy > 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
            
            // Add some spin based on where ball hits paddle
            const hitPos = (this.ball.x - this.paddle.x) / this.paddle.width;
            this.ball.dx = (hitPos - 0.5) * 8;
        }

        // Ball collision with bricks
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => {
            if (!brick.destroyed &&
                this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= brick.x &&
                this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= brick.x + brick.width &&
                this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= brick.y &&
                this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= brick.y + brick.height) {
                
                const points = brick.hit();
                this.score += points;
                
                // Determine collision side and reverse appropriate direction
                const ballCenterX = this.ball.x;
                const ballCenterY = this.ball.y;
                const brickCenterX = brick.x + brick.width / 2;
                const brickCenterY = brick.y + brick.height / 2;
                
                const deltaX = ballCenterX - brickCenterX;
                const deltaY = ballCenterY - brickCenterY;
                
                if (Math.abs(deltaX) > Math.abs(deltaY)) {
                    this.ball.reverseX();
                } else {
                    this.ball.reverseY();
                }
            }
        });

        // Check if ball fell below paddle
        if (this.ball.y > CANVAS_HEIGHT) {
            this.lives--;
            if (this.lives <= 0) {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER;
                this.showOverlay('Game Over!', `Final Score: ${this.score}`);
            } else {
                this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
                this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            }
        }

        // Check level completion
        const remainingBricks = this.bricks.filter(brick => !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'UNBREAKABLE');
        if (remainingBricks.length === 0) {
            this.level++;
            this.generateBricks();
            this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
            this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            this.state = GAME_STATES.LEVEL_COMPLETE;
            this.showOverlay(`Level ${this.level - 1} Complete!`, `Score: ${this.score}`);
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
                this.hideOverlay();
                this.gameLoop();
            }, 2000);
        }

        this.updateUI();
    }

    draw() {
        // Clear canvas
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

        // Draw game objects
        this.paddle.draw(this.ctx);
        this.ball.draw(this.ctx);
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.draw(this.ctx));

        // Draw particles for destroyed bricks (simple effect)
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        this.ctx.font = '16px Arial';
        this.ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        this.ctx.fillText(`Level ${this.level}`, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 30);
    }

    gameLoop() {
        this.update();
        this.draw();
        
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.gameLoop());
        }
    }

    updateUI() {
        document.getElementById('score').textContent = this.score;
        document.getElementById('level').textContent = this.level;
        document.getElementById('lives').textContent = this.lives;
    }

    showOverlay(title, message) {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        const titleEl = document.getElementById('overlayTitle');
        const messageEl = document.getElementById('overlayMessage');
        
        titleEl.textContent = title;
        messageEl.textContent = message;
        overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    hideOverlay() {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        overlay.classList.add('hidden');
    }
}
```
