```typescriptreact
    }

    stop() {
        this.dx = 0;
    }
}

// Brick class
class Brick {
    constructor(x, y, type = 'NORMAL') {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = BRICK_WIDTH;
        this.height = BRICK_HEIGHT;
        this.type = type;
        this.hits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.maxHits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.initialColor = BRICK_TYPES[type].color;
        this.color = this.initialColor;
        this.points = BRICK_TYPES[type].points;
        this.moving = BRICK_TYPES[type].moving || false;
        this.dx = this.moving ? 2 : 0;
        this.destroyed = false;
        this.originalX = x; // Store original position for moving bricks
    }

    update(allBricks) {
        if (this.moving && !this.destroyed) {
            const oldX = this.x;
            this.x += this.dx;
            
            // Check for collision with other bricks
            let collision = false;
            for (let brick of allBricks) {
                if (brick !== this && !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'MOVING') {
                    if (this.x < brick.x + brick.width &&
                        this.x + this.width > brick.x &&
                        this.y < brick.y + brick.height &&
                        this.y + this.height > brick.y) {
                        collision = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // If collision detected, revert position and reverse direction
            if (collision) {
                this.x = oldX;
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
            
            // Reverse direction at edges
            if (this.x <= 0 || this.x + this.width >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        if (this.destroyed) return;

        // Draw brick with gradient
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, this.color);
        gradient.addColorStop(1, this.darkenColor(this.color, 20));
        
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw border
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw hit indicator for multi-hit bricks
        if (this.maxHits > 1 && this.hits < this.maxHits) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = 'bold 12px Arial';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(this.hits.toString(), this.x + this.width/2, this.y + this.height/2 + 4);
        }
    }

    hit() {
        if (this.destroyed) return 0;
        
        if (this.hits === -1) return 0; // Unbreakable brick
        
        this.hits--;
        
        // Update color based on remaining hits
        if (this.maxHits > 1) {
            const colorIndex = Math.min(this.maxHits - this.hits, COLOR_PROGRESSION.length - 1);
            this.color = COLOR_PROGRESSION[colorIndex];
        }
        
        if (this.hits <= 0) {
            this.destroyed = true;
            return this.points;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    darkenColor(color, percent) {
        const num = parseInt(color.replace("#", ""), 16);
        const amt = Math.round(2.55 * percent);
        const R = (num >> 16) - amt;
        const G = (num >> 8 & 0x00FF) - amt;
        const B = (num & 0x0000FF) - amt;
        return "#" + (0x1000000 + (R < 255 ? R < 1 ? 0 : R : 255) * 0x10000 +
            (G < 255 ? G < 1 ? 0 : G : 255) * 0x100 +
            (B < 255 ? B < 1 ? 0 : B : 255)).toString(16).slice(1);
    }
}

// Main Game class
class Game {
    constructor(canvas) {
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball = new Ball(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle = new Paddle(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 30);
        this.bricks = [];
        this.keys = {};
        this.animationId = null;
        
        console.log('Game initialized with state:', this.state);
        this.setupEventListeners();
        this.generateBricks();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
    }

    setupEventListeners() {
        // Keyboard events
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
            
            if (e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
                    this.startGame();
                } else {
                    this.togglePause();
                }
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
        });

        // Button events
        document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.startGame());
        document.getElementById('pauseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.togglePause());
        document.getElementById('resetBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.resetGame());
    }

    generateBricks() {
        this.bricks = [];
        const brickAreaWidth = BRICK_COLS * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING) - BRICK_PADDING;
        const startX = (CANVAS_WIDTH - brickAreaWidth) / 2;

        for (let row = 0; row < BRICK_ROWS; row++) {
            for (let col = 0; col < BRICK_COLS; col++) {
                const x = startX + col * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING);
                const y = BRICK_OFFSET_TOP + row * (BRICK_HEIGHT + BRICK_PADDING);
                
                // Determine brick type based on row and level
                let brickType = 'NORMAL';
                if (row === 0) brickType = 'UNBREAKABLE';
                else if (row === 1) brickType = 'STRONG';
                else if (row === 2 && col % 3 === 0) brickType = 'MOVING';
                else if (row >= 3 && this.level > 2) {
                    const rand = Math.random();
                    if (rand < 0.3) brickType = 'STRONG';
                    else if (rand < 0.5) brickType = 'MOVING';
                }

                this.bricks.push(new Brick(x, y, brickType));
            }
        }
    }

    startGame() {
        console.log('startGame called, current state:', this.state);
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            console.log('Game started, new state:', this.state);
            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    togglePause() {
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PAUSED;
            this.showOverlay('Game Paused', 'Press SPACE to resume');
        } else if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PAUSED) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    resetGame() {
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
        this.generateBricks();
        this.updateUI();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
        
        if (this.animationId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(this.animationId);
        }
    }

    update() {
        if (this.state !== GAME_STATES.PLAYING) return;

        // Handle paddle movement
        if (this.keys['arrowleft'] || this.keys['a']) {
            this.paddle.moveLeft();
        } else if (this.keys['arrowright'] || this.keys['d']) {
            this.paddle.moveRight();
        } else {
            this.paddle.stop();
        }

        // Update game objects
        this.paddle.update();
        this.ball.update();
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.update());

        // Ball collision with walls
        if (this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= 0 || this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.ball.reverseX();
        }
        if (this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
        }

        // Ball collision with paddle
        if (this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= this.paddle.y &&
            this.ball.x >= this.paddle.x &&
            this.ball.x <= this.paddle.x + this.paddle.width &&
            this.ball.dy > 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
            
            // Add some spin based on where ball hits paddle
            const hitPos = (this.ball.x - this.paddle.x) / this.paddle.width;
            this.ball.dx = (hitPos - 0.5) * 8;
        }

        // Ball collision with bricks
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => {
            if (!brick.destroyed &&
                this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= brick.x &&
                this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= brick.x + brick.width &&
                this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= brick.y &&
                this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= brick.y + brick.height) {
                
                const points = brick.hit();
                this.score += points;
                
                // Determine collision side and reverse appropriate direction
                const ballCenterX = this.ball.x;
                const ballCenterY = this.ball.y;
                const brickCenterX = brick.x + brick.width / 2;
                const brickCenterY = brick.y + brick.height / 2;
                
                const deltaX = ballCenterX - brickCenterX;
                const deltaY = ballCenterY - brickCenterY;
                
                if (Math.abs(deltaX) > Math.abs(deltaY)) {
                    this.ball.reverseX();
                } else {
                    this.ball.reverseY();
                }
            }
        });

        // Check if ball fell below paddle
        if (this.ball.y > CANVAS_HEIGHT) {
            this.lives--;
            if (this.lives <= 0) {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER;
                this.showOverlay('Game Over!', `Final Score: ${this.score}`);
            } else {
                this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
                this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            }
        }

        // Check level completion
        const remainingBricks = this.bricks.filter(brick => !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'UNBREAKABLE');
        if (remainingBricks.length === 0) {
            this.level++;
            this.generateBricks();
            this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
            this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            this.state = GAME_STATES.LEVEL_COMPLETE;
            this.showOverlay(`Level ${this.level - 1} Complete!`, `Score: ${this.score}`);
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
                this.hideOverlay();
                this.gameLoop();
            }, 2000);
        }

        this.updateUI();
    }

    draw() {
        // Clear canvas
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

        // Draw game objects
        this.paddle.draw(this.ctx);
        this.ball.draw(this.ctx);
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.draw(this.ctx));

        // Draw particles for destroyed bricks (simple effect)
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        this.ctx.font = '16px Arial';
        this.ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        this.ctx.fillText(`Level ${this.level}`, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 30);
    }

    gameLoop() {
        this.update();
        this.draw();
        
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.gameLoop());
        }
    }

    updateUI() {
        document.getElementById('score').textContent = this.score;
        document.getElementById('level').textContent = this.level;
        document.getElementById('lives').textContent = this.lives;
    }

    showOverlay(title, message) {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        const titleEl = document.getElementById('overlayTitle');
        const messageEl = document.getElementById('overlayMessage');
        
        titleEl.textContent = title;
        messageEl.textContent = message;
        overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    hideOverlay() {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        overlay.classList.add('hidden');
    }
}

// React component for the game
const BrickBreakerGame = () => {
    const canvasRef = useRef(null);
    const gameRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (canvasRef.current && !gameRef.current) {
            gameRef.current = new Game(canvasRef.current);
        }
    }, []);

    return (
        <div className="game-container">
            <div className="game-header">
                <h1>Brick Breaker</h1>
                <div className="game-info">
                    <div className="score">Score: <span id="score">0</span></div>
                    <div className="level">Level: <span id="level">1</span></div>
                    <div className="lives">Lives: <span id="lives">3</span></div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-area">
                <canvas ref={canvasRef} id="gameCanvas" width={CANVAS_WIDTH} height={CANVAS_HEIGHT}></canvas>
                <div className="game-overlay" id="gameOverlay">
                    <div className="overlay-content">
                        <h2 id="overlayTitle">Brick Breaker</h2>
                        <p id="overlayMessage">Press SPACE to start!</p>
                        <div className="controls">
                            <p>Controls:</p>
                            <p>Arrow Keys or WASD to move paddle</p>
                            <p>SPACE to start/pause</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-footer">
                <button id="startBtn">Start Game</button>
                <button id="pauseBtn">Pause</button>
                <button id="resetBtn">Reset</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

// Render the game
ReactDOM.render(<BrickBreakerGame />, document.getElementById('root'));
```

```typescriptreact
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
        this.generateBricks();
        this.updateUI();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
        
        if (this.animationId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(this.animationId);
        }
    }

    update() {
        if (this.state !== GAME_STATES.PLAYING) return;

        // Handle paddle movement
        if (this.keys['arrowleft'] || this.keys['a']) {
            this.paddle.moveLeft();
        } else if (this.keys['arrowright'] || this.keys['d']) {
            this.paddle.moveRight();
        } else {
            this.paddle.stop();
        }

        // Update game objects
        this.paddle.update();
        this.ball.update();
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.update(this.bricks));

        // Ball collision with walls
        if (this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= 0 || this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.ball.reverseX();
        }
        if (this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
        }

        // Ball collision with paddle
        if (this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= this.paddle.y &&
            this.ball.x >= this.paddle.x &&
            this.ball.x <= this.paddle.x + this.paddle.width &&
            this.ball.dy > 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
            
            // Add some spin based on where ball hits paddle
            const hitPos = (this.ball.x - this.paddle.x) / this.paddle.width;
            this.ball.dx = (hitPos - 0.5) * 8;
        }

        // Ball collision with bricks
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => {
            if (!brick.destroyed &&
                this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= brick.x &&
                this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= brick.x + brick.width &&
                this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= brick.y &&
                this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= brick.y + brick.height) {
                
                const points = brick.hit();
                this.score += points;
                
                // Determine collision side and reverse appropriate direction
                const ballCenterX = this.ball.x;
                const ballCenterY = this.ball.y;
                const brickCenterX = brick.x + brick.width / 2;
                const brickCenterY = brick.y + brick.height / 2;
                
                const deltaX = ballCenterX - brickCenterX;
                const deltaY = ballCenterY - brickCenterY;
                
                if (Math.abs(deltaX) > Math.abs(deltaY)) {
                    this.ball.reverseX();
                } else {
                    this.ball.reverseY();
                }
            }
        });

        // Check if ball fell below paddle
        if (this.ball.y > CANVAS_HEIGHT) {
            this.lives--;
            if (this.lives <= 0) {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER;
                this.showOverlay('Game Over!', `Final Score: ${this.score}`);
            } else {
                this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
                this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            }
        }

        // Check level completion
        const remainingBricks = this.bricks.filter(brick => !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'UNBREAKABLE');
        if (remainingBricks.length === 0) {
            this.level++;
            this.generateBricks();
            this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
            this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            this.state = GAME_STATES.LEVEL_COMPLETE;
            this.showOverlay(`Level ${this.level - 1} Complete!`, `Score: ${this.score}`);
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
                this.hideOverlay();
                this.gameLoop();
            }, 2000);
        }

        this.updateUI();
    }

    draw() {
        // Clear canvas
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

        // Draw game objects
        this.paddle.draw(this.ctx);
        this.ball.draw(this.ctx);
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.draw(this.ctx));

        // Draw particles for destroyed bricks (simple effect)
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        this.ctx.font = '16px Arial';
        this.ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        this.ctx.fillText(`Level ${this.level}`, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 30);
    }

    gameLoop() {
        this.update();
        this.draw();
        
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.gameLoop());
        }
    }

    updateUI() {
        document.getElementById('score').textContent = this.score;
        document.getElementById('level').textContent = this.level;
        document.getElementById('lives').textContent = this.lives;
    }

    showOverlay(title, message) {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        const titleEl = document.getElementById('overlayTitle');
        const messageEl = document.getElementById('overlayMessage');
        
        titleEl.textContent = title;
        messageEl.textContent = message;
        overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    hideOverlay() {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        overlay.classList.add('hidden');
    }
}

// React component for the game
const BrickBreakerGame = () => {
    const canvasRef = useRef(null);
    const gameRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (canvasRef.current && !gameRef.current) {
            gameRef.current = new Game(canvasRef.current);
        }
    }, []);

    return (
        <div className="game-container">
            <div className="game-header">
                <h1>Brick Breaker</h1>
                <div className="game-info">
                    <div className="score">Score: <span id="score">0</span></div>
                    <div className="level">Level: <span id="level">1</span></div>
                    <div className="lives">Lives: <span id="lives">3</span></div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-area">
                <canvas ref={canvasRef} id="gameCanvas" width={CANVAS_WIDTH} height={CANVAS_HEIGHT}></canvas>
                <div className="game-overlay" id="gameOverlay">
                    <div className="overlay-content">
                        <h2 id="overlayTitle">Brick Breaker</h2>
                        <p id="overlayMessage">Press SPACE to start!</p>
                        <div className="controls">
                            <p>Controls:</p>
                            <p>Arrow Keys or WASD to move paddle</p>
                            <p>SPACE to start/pause</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-footer">
                <button id="startBtn">Start Game</button>
                <button id="pauseBtn">Pause</button>
                <button id="resetBtn">Reset</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

// Render the game
ReactDOM.render(<BrickBreakerGame />, document.getElementById('root'));
```

## ✅ **Changes Made**

### **1. Color Progression System**
- **Initial Color**: All bricks now start as light blue (`#87CEEB`)
- **Color Progression**: When hit, bricks change through this gradient:
  - 🔵 Light Blue (initial)
  - 🔵 Royal Blue
  - 🟢 Dark Green
  - 🟢 Lime Green
  - 🟡 Yellow
  - 🟠 Orange
  - 🔴 Red Orange
  - 🔴 Red

### **2. Moving Blocks Collision Prevention**
- **Collision Detection**: Moving blocks now check for collisions with other stationary bricks
- **Smart Movement**: When a moving block hits another brick, it:
  - Reverts to its previous position
  - Reverses direction
  - Continues moving in the opposite direction
- **No Overlap**: Moving blocks will never overlap with other blocks

## 🎮 **How It Works**

1. **Color Changes**: 
   - Single-hit bricks (NORMAL, MOVING) stay light blue until destroyed
   - Multi-hit bricks (STRONG) start light blue and progress through warmer colors as they take damage
   - The color progression makes it visually clear how much damage a brick has taken

2. **Moving Block Behavior**:
   - Moving blocks bounce off walls and other bricks
   - They maintain their movement pattern without overlapping
   - The collision detection ensures smooth, realistic movement

The game should now have much better visual feedback for brick damage and more realistic moving block behavior! Try hitting some of the multi-hit bricks to see the color progression in action.

```typescriptreact
const { useState, useEffect, useRef } = React;

// Game constants
const CANVAS_WIDTH = 800;
const CANVAS_HEIGHT = 600;
const PADDLE_WIDTH = 100;
const PADDLE_HEIGHT = 15;
const BALL_RADIUS = 8;
const BRICK_WIDTH = 80;
const BRICK_HEIGHT = 30;
const BRICK_ROWS = 4;
const BRICK_COLS = 8;
const BRICK_PADDING = 5;
const BRICK_OFFSET_TOP = 50;
const BRICK_OFFSET_LEFT = 50;

// Brick types
const BRICK_TYPES = {
    NORMAL: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 10 }, // Light blue
    STRONG: { hits: 2, color: '#87CEEB', points: 20 }, // Light blue initially
    MOVING: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 15, moving: true }, // Light blue initially
    UNBREAKABLE: { hits: -1, color: '#96ceb4', points: 0 }
};

// Color progression for hit bricks (from cool to warm)
const COLOR_PROGRESSION = [
    '#87CEEB', // Light blue (initial)
    '#4169E1', // Royal blue
    '#006400', // Dark green
    '#32CD32', // Lime green
    '#FFFF00', // Yellow
    '#FFA500', // Orange
    '#FF4500', // Red orange
    '#FF0000'  // Red
];

// Game states
const GAME_STATES = {
    MENU: 'menu',
    PLAYING: 'playing',
    PAUSED: 'paused',
    GAME_OVER: 'gameOver',
    LEVEL_COMPLETE: 'levelComplete'
};

// Ball class
class Ball {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.radius = BALL_RADIUS;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
        this.speed = 4;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        this.y += this.dy;
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ccc';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    reset(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
    }

    reverseX() {
        this.dx = -this.dx;
    }

    reverseY() {
        this.dy = -this.dy;
    }
}

// Paddle class
class Paddle {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = PADDLE_WIDTH;
        this.height = PADDLE_HEIGHT;
        this.speed = 6;
        this.dx = 0;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        
        // Keep paddle within canvas bounds
        if (this.x < 0) {
            this.x = 0;
        } else if (this.x + this.width > CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.x = CANVAS_WIDTH - this.width;
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Add gradient effect
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, '#ff6b6b');
        gradient.addColorStop(1, '#ee5a24');
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
    }

    moveLeft() {
        this.dx = -this.speed;
    }

    moveRight() {
        this.dx = this.speed;
    }

    stop() {
        this.dx = 0;
    }
}

// Brick class
class Brick {
    constructor(x, y, type = 'NORMAL') {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = BRICK_WIDTH;
        this.height = BRICK_HEIGHT;
        this.type = type;
        this.hits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.maxHits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.initialColor = BRICK_TYPES[type].color;
        this.color = this.initialColor;
        this.points = BRICK_TYPES[type].points;
        this.moving = BRICK_TYPES[type].moving || false;
        this.dx = this.moving ? 2 : 0;
        this.destroyed = false;
        this.originalX = x; // Store original position for moving bricks
    }

    update(allBricks) {
        if (this.moving && !this.destroyed) {
            const oldX = this.x;
            this.x += this.dx;
            
            // Check for collision with other bricks
            let collision = false;
            for (let brick of allBricks) {
                if (brick !== this && !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'MOVING') {
                    if (this.x < brick.x + brick.width &&
                        this.x + this.width > brick.x &&
                        this.y < brick.y + brick.height &&
                        this.y + this.height > brick.y) {
                        collision = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // If collision detected, revert position and reverse direction
            if (collision) {
                this.x = oldX;
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
            
            // Reverse direction at edges
            if (this.x <= 0 || this.x + this.width >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        if (this.destroyed) return;

        // Draw brick with gradient
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, this.color);
        gradient.addColorStop(1, this.darkenColor(this.color, 20));
        
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw border
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw hit indicator for multi-hit bricks
        if (this.maxHits > 1 && this.hits < this.maxHits) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = 'bold 12px Arial';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(this.hits.toString(), this.x + this.width/2, this.y + this.height/2 + 4);
        }
    }

    hit() {
        if (this.destroyed) return 0;
        
        if (this.hits === -1) return 0; // Unbreakable brick
        
        this.hits--;
        
        // Update color based on remaining hits
        if (this.maxHits > 1) {
            const colorIndex = Math.min(this.maxHits - this.hits, COLOR_PROGRESSION.length - 1);
            this.color = COLOR_PROGRESSION[colorIndex];
        }
        
        if (this.hits <= 0) {
            this.destroyed = true;
            return this.points;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    darkenColor(color, percent) {
        const num = parseInt(color.replace("#", ""), 16);
        const amt = Math.round(2.55 * percent);
        const R = (num >> 16) - amt;
        const G = (num >> 8 & 0x00FF) - amt;
        const B = (num & 0x0000FF) - amt;
        return "#" + (0x1000000 + (R < 255 ? R < 1 ? 0 : R : 255) * 0x10000 +
            (G < 255 ? G < 1 ? 0 : G : 255) * 0x100 +
            (B < 255 ? B < 1 ? 0 : B : 255)).toString(16).slice(1);
    }
}

// Main Game class

    setupEventListeners() {
        // Keyboard events

            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
            
            if (e.key === ' ') {

                if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
                    this.startGame();
                } else {
                    this.togglePause();
                }
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {

        });

        // Button events

        document.getElementById('pauseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.togglePause());

    generateBricks() {
        this.bricks = [];
        const brickAreaWidth = BRICK_COLS * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING) - BRICK_PADDING;

                <div className="game-info">

                    <div className="level">Level: <span id="level">1</span></div>
                    <div className="lives">Lives: <span id="lives">3</span></div>
                </div>

            <div className="game-area">
                <canvas ref={canvasRef} id="gameCanvas" width={CANVAS_WIDTH} height={CANVAS_HEIGHT}></canvas>
                <div className="game-overlay" id="gameOverlay">
                    <div className="overlay-content">
                        <h2 id="overlayTitle">Brick Breaker</h2>
                        <p id="overlayMessage">Press SPACE to start!</p>

            </div>
            
            <div className="game-footer">
                <button id="startBtn">Start Game</button>
```

```typescriptreact
const { useState, useEffect, useRef } = React;

// Game constants
const CANVAS_WIDTH = 800;
const CANVAS_HEIGHT = 600;
const PADDLE_WIDTH = 100;
const PADDLE_HEIGHT = 15;
const BALL_RADIUS = 8;
const BRICK_WIDTH = 80;
const BRICK_HEIGHT = 30;
const BRICK_ROWS = 4;
const BRICK_COLS = 8;
const BRICK_PADDING = 5;
const BRICK_OFFSET_TOP = 50;
const BRICK_OFFSET_LEFT = 50;

// Brick types
const BRICK_TYPES = {
    NORMAL: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 10 }, // Light blue
    STRONG: { hits: 3, color: '#87CEEB', points: 30 }, // Light blue initially, 3 hits
    VERY_STRONG: { hits: 5, color: '#87CEEB', points: 50 }, // Light blue initially, 5 hits
    MOVING: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 15, moving: true }, // Light blue initially
    MOVING_STRONG: { hits: 2, color: '#87CEEB', points: 25, moving: true }, // Moving with 2 hits
    UNBREAKABLE: { hits: -1, color: '#808080', points: 0 } // Grey unbreakable
};

// Color progression for hit bricks (from cool to warm)
const COLOR_PROGRESSION = [
    '#87CEEB', // Light blue (initial)
    '#4169E1', // Royal blue
    '#006400', // Dark green
    '#32CD32', // Lime green
    '#FFFF00', // Yellow
    '#FFA500', // Orange
    '#FF4500', // Red orange
    '#FF0000'  // Red
];

// Game states
const GAME_STATES = {
    MENU: 'menu',
    PLAYING: 'playing',
    PAUSED: 'paused',
    GAME_OVER: 'gameOver',
    LEVEL_COMPLETE: 'levelComplete'
};

// Ball class
class Ball {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.radius = BALL_RADIUS;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
        this.speed = 4;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        this.y += this.dy;
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ccc';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    reset(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
    }

    reverseX() {
        this.dx = -this.dx;
    }

    reverseY() {
        this.dy = -this.dy;
    }
}

// Paddle class
class Paddle {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = PADDLE_WIDTH;
        this.height = PADDLE_HEIGHT;
        this.speed = 6;
        this.dx = 0;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        
        // Keep paddle within canvas bounds
        if (this.x < 0) {
            this.x = 0;
        } else if (this.x + this.width > CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.x = CANVAS_WIDTH - this.width;
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Add gradient effect
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, '#ff6b6b');
        gradient.addColorStop(1, '#ee5a24');
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
    }

    moveLeft() {
        this.dx = -this.speed;
    }

    moveRight() {
        this.dx = this.speed;
    }

    stop() {
        this.dx = 0;
    }
}

// Brick class
class Brick {
    constructor(x, y, type = 'NORMAL') {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = BRICK_WIDTH;
        this.height = BRICK_HEIGHT;
        this.type = type;
        this.hits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.maxHits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.initialColor = BRICK_TYPES[type].color;
        this.color = this.initialColor;
        this.points = BRICK_TYPES[type].points;
        this.moving = BRICK_TYPES[type].moving || false;
        this.dx = this.moving ? 2 : 0;
        this.destroyed = false;
        this.originalX = x; // Store original position for moving bricks
    }

    update(allBricks) {
        if (this.moving && !this.destroyed) {
            const oldX = this.x;
            this.x += this.dx;
            
            // Check for collision with other bricks
            let collision = false;
            for (let brick of allBricks) {
                if (brick !== this && !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'MOVING') {
                    if (this.x < brick.x + brick.width &&
                        this.x + this.width > brick.x &&
                        this.y < brick.y + brick.height &&
                        this.y + this.height > brick.y) {
                        collision = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // If collision detected, revert position and reverse direction
            if (collision) {
                this.x = oldX;
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
            
            // Reverse direction at edges
            if (this.x <= 0 || this.x + this.width >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        if (this.destroyed) return;

        // Draw brick with gradient
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, this.color);
        gradient.addColorStop(1, this.darkenColor(this.color, 20));
        
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw border
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw hit indicator for multi-hit bricks
        if (this.maxHits > 1 && this.hits < this.maxHits) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = 'bold 12px Arial';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(this.hits.toString(), this.x + this.width/2, this.y + this.height/2 + 4);
        }
    }

    hit() {
        if (this.destroyed) return 0;
        
        if (this.hits === -1) return 0; // Unbreakable brick
        
        this.hits--;
        
        // Update color based on remaining hits
        if (this.maxHits > 1) {
            const colorIndex = Math.min(this.maxHits - this.hits, COLOR_PROGRESSION.length - 1);
            this.color = COLOR_PROGRESSION[colorIndex];
        }
        
        if (this.hits <= 0) {
            this.destroyed = true;
            return this.points;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    darkenColor(color, percent) {
        const num = parseInt(color.replace("#", ""), 16);
        const amt = Math.round(2.55 * percent);
        const R = (num >> 16) - amt;
        const G = (num >> 8 & 0x00FF) - amt;
        const B = (num & 0x0000FF) - amt;
        return "#" + (0x1000000 + (R < 255 ? R < 1 ? 0 : R : 255) * 0x10000 +
            (G < 255 ? G < 1 ? 0 : G : 255) * 0x100 +
            (B < 255 ? B < 1 ? 0 : B : 255)).toString(16).slice(1);
    }
}

// Main Game class
class Game {
    constructor(canvas) {
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball = new Ball(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle = new Paddle(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 30);
        this.bricks = [];
        this.keys = {};
        this.animationId = null;
        
        console.log('Game initialized with state:', this.state);
        this.setupEventListeners();
        this.generateBricks();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
    }

    setupEventListeners() {
        // Keyboard events
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
            
            if (e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
                    this.startGame();
                } else {
                    this.togglePause();
                }
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
        });

        // Button events
        document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.startGame());
        document.getElementById('pauseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.togglePause());
        document.getElementById('resetBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.resetGame());
    }

    generateBricks() {
        this.bricks = [];
        const brickAreaWidth = BRICK_COLS * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING) - BRICK_PADDING;
        const startX = (CANVAS_WIDTH - brickAreaWidth) / 2;

        for (let row = 0; row < BRICK_ROWS; row++) {
            for (let col = 0; col < BRICK_COLS; col++) {
                const x = startX + col * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING);
                const y = BRICK_OFFSET_TOP + row * (BRICK_HEIGHT + BRICK_PADDING);
                
                // Determine brick type based on row and level
                let brickType = 'NORMAL';
                if (row === 0) brickType = 'UNBREAKABLE';
                else if (row === 1) brickType = 'STRONG';
                else if (row === 2 && col % 3 === 0) brickType = 'MOVING';
                else if (row >= 3 && this.level > 2) {
                    const rand = Math.random();
                    if (rand < 0.3) brickType = 'STRONG';
                    else if (rand < 0.5) brickType = 'MOVING';
                }

                this.bricks.push(new Brick(x, y, brickType));
            }
        }
    }

    startGame() {
        console.log('startGame called, current state:', this.state);
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            console.log('Game started, new state:', this.state);
            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    togglePause() {
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PAUSED;
            this.showOverlay('Game Paused', 'Press SPACE to resume');
        } else if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PAUSED) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    resetGame() {
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
        this.generateBricks();
        this.updateUI();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
        
        if (this.animationId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(this.animationId);
        }
    }

    update() {
        if (this.state !== GAME_STATES.PLAYING) return;

        // Handle paddle movement
        if (this.keys['arrowleft'] || this.keys['a']) {
            this.paddle.moveLeft();
        } else if (this.keys['arrowright'] || this.keys['d']) {
            this.paddle.moveRight();
        } else {
            this.paddle.stop();
        }

        // Update game objects
        this.paddle.update();
        this.ball.update();
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.update(this.bricks));

        // Ball collision with walls
        if (this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= 0 || this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.ball.reverseX();
        }
        if (this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
        }

        // Ball collision with paddle
        if (this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= this.paddle.y &&
            this.ball.x >= this.paddle.x &&
            this.ball.x <= this.paddle.x + this.paddle.width &&
            this.ball.dy > 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
            
            // Add some spin based on where ball hits paddle
            const hitPos = (this.ball.x - this.paddle.x) / this.paddle.width;
            this.ball.dx = (hitPos - 0.5) * 8;
        }

        // Ball collision with bricks
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => {
            if (!brick.destroyed &&
                this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= brick.x &&
                this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= brick.x + brick.width &&
                this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= brick.y &&
                this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= brick.y + brick.height) {
                
                const points = brick.hit();
                this.score += points;
                
                // Determine collision side and reverse appropriate direction
                const ballCenterX = this.ball.x;
                const ballCenterY = this.ball.y;
                const brickCenterX = brick.x + brick.width / 2;
                const brickCenterY = brick.y + brick.height / 2;
                
                const deltaX = ballCenterX - brickCenterX;
                const deltaY = ballCenterY - brickCenterY;
                
                if (Math.abs(deltaX) > Math.abs(deltaY)) {
                    this.ball.reverseX();
                } else {
                    this.ball.reverseY();
                }
            }
        });

        // Check if ball fell below paddle
        if (this.ball.y > CANVAS_HEIGHT) {
            this.lives--;
            if (this.lives <= 0) {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER;
                this.showOverlay('Game Over!', `Final Score: ${this.score}`);
            } else {
                this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
                this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            }
        }

        // Check level completion
        const remainingBricks = this.bricks.filter(brick => !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'UNBREAKABLE');
        if (remainingBricks.length === 0) {
            this.level++;
            this.generateBricks();
            this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
            this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            this.state = GAME_STATES.LEVEL_COMPLETE;
            this.showOverlay(`Level ${this.level - 1} Complete!`, `Score: ${this.score}`);
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
                this.hideOverlay();
                this.gameLoop();
            }, 2000);
        }

        this.updateUI();
    }

    draw() {
        // Clear canvas
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

        // Draw game objects
        this.paddle.draw(this.ctx);
        this.ball.draw(this.ctx);
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.draw(this.ctx));

        // Draw particles for destroyed bricks (simple effect)
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        this.ctx.font = '16px Arial';
        this.ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        this.ctx.fillText(`Level ${this.level}`, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 30);
    }

    gameLoop() {
        this.update();
        this.draw();
        
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.gameLoop());
        }
    }

    updateUI() {
        document.getElementById('score').textContent = this.score;
        document.getElementById('level').textContent = this.level;
        document.getElementById('lives').textContent = this.lives;
    }

    showOverlay(title, message) {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        const titleEl = document.getElementById('overlayTitle');
        const messageEl = document.getElementById('overlayMessage');
        
        titleEl.textContent = title;
        messageEl.textContent = message;
        overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    hideOverlay() {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        overlay.classList.add('hidden');
    }
}

// React component for the game
const BrickBreakerGame = () => {
    const canvasRef = useRef(null);
    const gameRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (canvasRef.current && !gameRef.current) {
            gameRef.current = new Game(canvasRef.current);
        }
    }, []);

    return (
        <div className="game-container">
            <div className="game-header">
                <h1>Brick Breaker</h1>
                <div className="game-info">
                    <div className="score">Score: <span id="score">0</span></div>
                    <div className="level">Level: <span id="level">1</span></div>
                    <div className="lives">Lives: <span id="lives">3</span></div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-area">
                <canvas ref={canvasRef} id="gameCanvas" width={CANVAS_WIDTH} height={CANVAS_HEIGHT}></canvas>
                <div className="game-overlay" id="gameOverlay">
                    <div className="overlay-content">
                        <h2 id="overlayTitle">Brick Breaker</h2>
                        <p id="overlayMessage">Press SPACE to start!</p>
                        <div className="controls">
                            <p>Controls:</p>
                            <p>Arrow Keys or WASD to move paddle</p>
                            <p>SPACE to start/pause</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-footer">
                <button id="startBtn">Start Game</button>
                <button id="pauseBtn">Pause</button>
                <button id="resetBtn">Reset</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

// Render the game
ReactDOM.render(<BrickBreakerGame />, document.getElementById('root'));
```

```typescriptreact
            if (this.x <= 0 || this.x + this.width >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {

            }
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        if (this.destroyed) return;

        // Draw brick with gradient
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, this.color);
        gradient.addColorStop(1, this.darkenColor(this.color, 20));
        
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw border
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw hit indicator for multi-hit bricks
        if (this.maxHits > 1 && this.hits < this.maxHits) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = 'bold 12px Arial';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(this.hits.toString(), this.x + this.width/2, this.y + this.height/2 + 4);
        }
    }

    hit() {
        if (this.destroyed) return 0;
        
        if (this.hits === -1) return 0; // Unbreakable brick
        
        this.hits--;
        
        // Update color based on remaining hits
        if (this.maxHits > 1) {
            const colorIndex = Math.min(this.maxHits - this.hits, COLOR_PROGRESSION.length - 1);
            this.color = COLOR_PROGRESSION[colorIndex];
        }
        
        if (this.hits <= 0) {
            this.destroyed = true;
            return this.points;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    darkenColor(color, percent) {
        const num = parseInt(color.replace("#", ""), 16);
        const amt = Math.round(2.55 * percent);
        const R = (num >> 16) - amt;
        const G = (num >> 8 & 0x00FF) - amt;
        const B = (num & 0x0000FF) - amt;
        return "#" + (0x1000000 + (R < 255 ? R < 1 ? 0 : R : 255) * 0x10000 +
            (G < 255 ? G < 1 ? 0 : G : 255) * 0x100 +
            (B < 255 ? B < 1 ? 0 : B : 255)).toString(16).slice(1);
    }
}

// Main Game class
class Game {
    constructor(canvas) {
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball = new Ball(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle = new Paddle(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 30);
        this.bricks = [];
        this.keys = {};
        this.animationId = null;
        
        console.log('Game initialized with state:', this.state);
        this.setupEventListeners();
        this.generateBricks();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
    }

    setupEventListeners() {
        // Keyboard events
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
            
            if (e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
                    this.startGame();
                } else {
                    this.togglePause();
                }
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
        });

        // Button events
        document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.startGame());
        document.getElementById('pauseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.togglePause());
        document.getElementById('resetBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.resetGame());
    }

    generateBricks() {
        this.bricks = [];
        const brickAreaWidth = BRICK_COLS * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING) - BRICK_PADDING;
        const startX = (CANVAS_WIDTH - brickAreaWidth) / 2;

        for (let row = 0; row < BRICK_ROWS; row++) {
            for (let col = 0; col < BRICK_COLS; col++) {
                const x = startX + col * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING);
                const y = BRICK_OFFSET_TOP + row * (BRICK_HEIGHT + BRICK_PADDING);
                
                // Determine brick type based on row and level
                let brickType = 'NORMAL';
                if (row === 0) {
                    // Top row: mix of unbreakable and very strong
                    if (col % 4 === 0) brickType = 'UNBREAKABLE';
                    else brickType = 'VERY_STRONG';
                } else if (row === 1) {
                    // Second row: strong and moving strong
                    if (col % 3 === 0) brickType = 'MOVING_STRONG';
                    else brickType = 'STRONG';
                } else if (row === 2) {
                    // Third row: mix of normal and moving
                    if (col % 2 === 0) brickType = 'MOVING';
                    else brickType = 'NORMAL';
                } else if (row === 3) {
                    // Bottom row: mostly normal with some strong
                    if (col % 5 === 0) brickType = 'STRONG';
                    else brickType = 'NORMAL';
                }

                this.bricks.push(new Brick(x, y, brickType));
            }
        }
    }

    startGame() {
        console.log('startGame called, current state:', this.state);
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            console.log('Game started, new state:', this.state);
            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    togglePause() {
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PAUSED;
            this.showOverlay('Game Paused', 'Press SPACE to resume');
        } else if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PAUSED) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    resetGame() {
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
        this.generateBricks();
        this.updateUI();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
        
        if (this.animationId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(this.animationId);
        }
    }

    update() {
        if (this.state !== GAME_STATES.PLAYING) return;

        // Handle paddle movement
        if (this.keys['arrowleft'] || this.keys['a']) {
            this.paddle.moveLeft();
        } else if (this.keys['arrowright'] || this.keys['d']) {
            this.paddle.moveRight();
        } else {
            this.paddle.stop();
        }

        // Update game objects
        this.paddle.update();
        this.ball.update();
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.update(this.bricks));

        // Ball collision with walls
        if (this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= 0 || this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.ball.reverseX();
        }
        if (this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
        }

        // Ball collision with paddle
        if (this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= this.paddle.y &&
            this.ball.x >= this.paddle.x &&
            this.ball.x <= this.paddle.x + this.paddle.width &&
            this.ball.dy > 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
            
            // Add some spin based on where ball hits paddle
            const hitPos = (this.ball.x - this.paddle.x) / this.paddle.width;
            this.ball.dx = (hitPos - 0.5) * 8;
        }

        // Ball collision with bricks
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => {
            if (!brick.destroyed &&
                this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= brick.x &&
                this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= brick.x + brick.width &&
                this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= brick.y &&
                this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= brick.y + brick.height) {
                
                const points = brick.hit();
                this.score += points;
                
                // Determine collision side and reverse appropriate direction
                const ballCenterX = this.ball.x;
                const ballCenterY = this.ball.y;
                const brickCenterX = brick.x + brick.width / 2;
                const brickCenterY = brick.y + brick.height / 2;
                
                const deltaX = ballCenterX - brickCenterX;
                const deltaY = ballCenterY - brickCenterY;
                
                if (Math.abs(deltaX) > Math.abs(deltaY)) {
                    this.ball.reverseX();
                } else {
                    this.ball.reverseY();
                }
            }
        });

        // Check if ball fell below paddle
        if (this.ball.y > CANVAS_HEIGHT) {
            this.lives--;
            if (this.lives <= 0) {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER;
                this.showOverlay('Game Over!', `Final Score: ${this.score}`);
            } else {
                this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
                this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            }
        }

        // Check level completion
        const remainingBricks = this.bricks.filter(brick => !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'UNBREAKABLE');
        if (remainingBricks.length === 0) {
            this.level++;
            this.generateBricks();
            this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
            this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            this.state = GAME_STATES.LEVEL_COMPLETE;
            this.showOverlay(`Level ${this.level - 1} Complete!`, `Score: ${this.score}`);
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
                this.hideOverlay();
                this.gameLoop();
            }, 2000);
        }

        this.updateUI();
    }

    draw() {
        // Clear canvas
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

        // Draw game objects
        this.paddle.draw(this.ctx);
        this.ball.draw(this.ctx);
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.draw(this.ctx));

        // Draw particles for destroyed bricks (simple effect)
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        this.ctx.font = '16px Arial';
        this.ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        this.ctx.fillText(`Level ${this.level}`, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 30);
    }

    gameLoop() {
        this.update();
        this.draw();
        
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.gameLoop());
        }
    }

    updateUI() {
        document.getElementById('score').textContent = this.score;
        document.getElementById('level').textContent = this.level;
        document.getElementById('lives').textContent = this.lives;
    }

    showOverlay(title, message) {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        const titleEl = document.getElementById('overlayTitle');
        const messageEl = document.getElementById('overlayMessage');
        
        titleEl.textContent = title;
        messageEl.textContent = message;
        overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    hideOverlay() {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        overlay.classList.add('hidden');
    }
}

// React component for the game
const BrickBreakerGame = () => {
    const canvasRef = useRef(null);
    const gameRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (canvasRef.current && !gameRef.current) {
            gameRef.current = new Game(canvasRef.current);
        }
    }, []);

    return (
        <div className="game-container">
            <div className="game-header">
                <h1>Brick Breaker</h1>
                <div className="game-info">
                    <div className="score">Score: <span id="score">0</span></div>
                    <div className="level">Level: <span id="level">1</span></div>
                    <div className="lives">Lives: <span id="lives">3</span></div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-area">
                <canvas ref={canvasRef} id="gameCanvas" width={CANVAS_WIDTH} height={CANVAS_HEIGHT}></canvas>
                <div className="game-overlay" id="gameOverlay">
                    <div className="overlay-content">
                        <h2 id="overlayTitle">Brick Breaker</h2>
                        <p id="overlayMessage">Press SPACE to start!</p>
                        <div className="controls">
                            <p>Controls:</p>
                            <p>Arrow Keys or WASD to move paddle</p>
                            <p>SPACE to start/pause</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-footer">
                <button id="startBtn">Start Game</button>
                <button id="pauseBtn">Pause</button>
                <button id="resetBtn">Reset</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

// Render the game
ReactDOM.render(<BrickBreakerGame />, document.getElementById('root'));
```

```typescriptreact
const BRICK_COLS = 8;
const BRICK_PADDING = 5;
const BRICK_OFFSET_TOP = 50;
const BRICK_OFFSET_LEFT = 50;

// Brick types
const BRICK_TYPES = {
    NORMAL: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 10 }, // Light blue
    STRONG: { hits: 3, color: '#87CEEB', points: 30 }, // Light blue initially, 3 hits
    VERY_STRONG: { hits: 5, color: '#87CEEB', points: 50 }, // Light blue initially, 5 hits
    MOVING: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 15, moving: true }, // Light blue initially
    MOVING_STRONG: { hits: 2, color: '#87CEEB', points: 25, moving: true }, // Moving with 2 hits
    UNBREAKABLE: { hits: -1, color: '#808080', points: 0 } // Grey unbreakable
};

// Color progression for hit bricks (from cool to warm)
const COLOR_PROGRESSION = [
    '#87CEEB', // Light blue (initial)
    '#4169E1', // Royal blue
    '#006400', // Dark green
    '#32CD32', // Lime green
    '#FFFF00', // Yellow
    '#FFA500', // Orange
    '#FF4500', // Red orange
    '#FF0000'  // Red
];

// Game states
const GAME_STATES = {
    MENU: 'menu',
    PLAYING: 'playing',
    PAUSED: 'paused',
    GAME_OVER: 'gameOver',
    LEVEL_COMPLETE: 'levelComplete'
};

// Ball class
class Ball {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.radius = BALL_RADIUS;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
        this.speed = 4;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        this.y += this.dy;
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ccc';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    reset(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
    }

    reverseX() {
        this.dx = -this.dx;
    }

    reverseY() {
        this.dy = -this.dy;
    }
}

// Paddle class
class Paddle {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = PADDLE_WIDTH;
        this.height = PADDLE_HEIGHT;
        this.speed = 6;
        this.dx = 0;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        
        // Keep paddle within canvas bounds
        if (this.x < 0) {
            this.x = 0;
        } else if (this.x + this.width > CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.x = CANVAS_WIDTH - this.width;
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Add gradient effect
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, '#ff6b6b');
        gradient.addColorStop(1, '#ee5a24');
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
    }

    moveLeft() {
        this.dx = -this.speed;
    }

    moveRight() {
        this.dx = this.speed;
    }

    stop() {
        this.dx = 0;
    }
}

// Brick class
class Brick {
    constructor(x, y, type = 'NORMAL') {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = BRICK_WIDTH;
        this.height = BRICK_HEIGHT;
        this.type = type;
        this.hits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.maxHits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.initialColor = BRICK_TYPES[type].color;
        this.color = this.initialColor;
        this.points = BRICK_TYPES[type].points;
        this.moving = BRICK_TYPES[type].moving || false;
        this.dx = this.moving ? 2 : 0;
        this.destroyed = false;
        this.originalX = x; // Store original position for moving bricks
    }

    update(allBricks) {
        if (this.moving && !this.destroyed) {
            const oldX = this.x;
            this.x += this.dx;
            
            // Check for collision with other bricks
            let collision = false;
            for (let brick of allBricks) {
                if (brick !== this && !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'MOVING') {
                    if (this.x < brick.x + brick.width &&
                        this.x + this.width > brick.x &&
                        this.y < brick.y + brick.height &&
                        this.y + this.height > brick.y) {
                        collision = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // If collision detected, revert position and reverse direction
            if (collision) {
                this.x = oldX;
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
            
            // Reverse direction at edges
            if (this.x <= 0 || this.x + this.width >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
        }
    }

        }

        }
        
        if (this.hits <= 0) {
            this.destroyed = true;
            return this.points;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    darkenColor(color, percent) {
        const num = parseInt(color.replace("#", ""), 16);
        const amt = Math.round(2.55 * percent);
        const R = (num >> 16) - amt;
        const G = (num >> 8 & 0x00FF) - amt;

            (B < 255 ? B < 1 ? 0 : B : 255)).toString(16).slice(1);
    }
}

            this.paddle.stop();
        }

        // Update game objects
        this.paddle.update();
        this.ball.update();
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.update(this.bricks));

        // Ball collision with walls
        if (this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= 0 || this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.ball.reverseX();
        }
        if (this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
        }

        // Ball collision with paddle
        if (this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= this.paddle.y &&
            this.ball.x >= this.paddle.x &&
            this.ball.x <= this.paddle.x + this.paddle.width &&
            this.ball.dy > 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
            
            // Add some spin based on where ball hits paddle
            const hitPos = (this.ball.x - this.paddle.x) / this.paddle.width;
            this.ball.dx = (hitPos - 0.5) * 8;
        }

        // Ball collision with bricks
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => {
            if (!brick.destroyed &&
                this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= brick.x &&
                this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= brick.x + brick.width &&
                this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= brick.y &&
                this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= brick.y + brick.height) {
                
                const points = brick.hit();
                this.score += points;
                
                // Calculate collision side more accurately
                const ballLeft = this.ball.x - this.ball.radius;
                const ballRight = this.ball.x + this.ball.radius;
                const ballTop = this.ball.y - this.ball.radius;
                const ballBottom = this.ball.y + this.ball.radius;
                
                const brickLeft = brick.x;
                const brickRight = brick.x + brick.width;
                const brickTop = brick.y;
                const brickBottom = brick.y + brick.height;
                
                // Calculate overlap distances
                const overlapLeft = ballRight - brickLeft;
                const overlapRight = brickRight - ballLeft;
                const overlapTop = ballBottom - brickTop;
                const overlapBottom = brickBottom - ballTop;
                
                // Find the smallest overlap to determine collision side
                const minOverlap = Math.min(overlapLeft, overlapRight, overlapTop, overlapBottom);
                
                if (minOverlap === overlapLeft || minOverlap === overlapRight) {
                    // Horizontal collision (left or right side)
                    this.ball.reverseX();
                } else {
                    // Vertical collision (top or bottom side)
                    this.ball.reverseY();
                }
            }
        });

        // Check if ball fell below paddle
        if (this.ball.y > CANVAS_HEIGHT) {
            this.lives--;
            if (this.lives <= 0) {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER;
                this.showOverlay('Game Over!', `Final Score: ${this.score}`);
            } else {
                this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
                this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            }
        }

        // Check level completion
        const remainingBricks = this.bricks.filter(brick => !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'UNBREAKABLE');
        if (remainingBricks.length === 0) {
            this.level++;
            this.generateBricks();
            this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
            this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            this.state = GAME_STATES.LEVEL_COMPLETE;
            this.showOverlay(`Level ${this.level - 1} Complete!`, `Score: ${this.score}`);
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
                this.hideOverlay();
                this.gameLoop();
            }, 2000);
        }

        this.updateUI();
    }

    draw() {
        // Clear canvas
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

        // Draw game objects
        this.paddle.draw(this.ctx);
        this.ball.draw(this.ctx);
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.draw(this.ctx));

        // Draw particles for destroyed bricks (simple effect)
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        this.ctx.font = '16px Arial';
        this.ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        this.ctx.fillText(`Level ${this.level}`, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 30);
    }

    gameLoop() {
        this.update();
        this.draw();
        
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.gameLoop());
        }
    }

    updateUI() {
        document.getElementById('score').textContent = this.score;
        document.getElementById('level').textContent = this.level;
        document.getElementById('lives').textContent = this.lives;
    }

    showOverlay(title, message) {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        const titleEl = document.getElementById('overlayTitle');
        const messageEl = document.getElementById('overlayMessage');
        
        titleEl.textContent = title;
        messageEl.textContent = message;
        overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    hideOverlay() {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        overlay.classList.add('hidden');
    }
}

                <button id="pauseBtn">Pause</button>

    );
};

ReactDOM.render(<BrickBreakerGame />, document.getElementById('root'));
```
