```typescriptreact
const { useState, useEffect, useRef } = React;

// Game constants
const CANVAS_WIDTH = 800;
const CANVAS_HEIGHT = 600;
const PADDLE_WIDTH = 100;
const PADDLE_HEIGHT = 15;
const BALL_RADIUS = 8;
const BRICK_WIDTH = 80;
const BRICK_HEIGHT = 30;
const BRICK_ROWS = 4;
const BRICK_COLS = 8;
const BRICK_PADDING = 15;
const BRICK_OFFSET_TOP = 50;
const BRICK_OFFSET_LEFT = 50;

// Brick types
const BRICK_TYPES = {
    NORMAL: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 10 }, // Light blue
    STRONG: { hits: 3, color: '#4169E1', points: 30 }, // Royal blue initially
    VERY_STRONG: { hits: 5, color: '#006400', points: 50 }, // Dark green initially
    MOVING: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 15, moving: true }, // Light blue initially
    MOVING_STRONG: { hits: 2, color: '#32CD32', points: 25, moving: true }, // Lime green initially
    UNBREAKABLE: { hits: -1, color: '#808080', points: 0 } // Grey unbreakable
};

// Color progression for hit bricks (from cool to warm)
const COLOR_PROGRESSION = [
    '#87CEEB', // Light blue (initial)
    '#4169E1', // Royal blue
    '#006400', // Dark green
    '#32CD32', // Lime green
    '#FFFF00', // Yellow
    '#FFA500', // Orange
    '#FF4500', // Red orange
    '#FF0000'  // Red
];

// Game states
const GAME_STATES = {
    MENU: 'menu',
    PLAYING: 'playing',
    PAUSED: 'paused',
    GAME_OVER: 'gameOver',
    LEVEL_COMPLETE: 'levelComplete'
};

// Ball class
class Ball {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.radius = BALL_RADIUS;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
        this.speed = 4;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        this.y += this.dy;
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ccc';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    reset(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
    }

    reverseX() {
        this.dx = -this.dx;
    }

    reverseY() {
        this.dy = -this.dy;
    }
}

// Paddle class
class Paddle {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = PADDLE_WIDTH;
        this.height = PADDLE_HEIGHT;
        this.speed = 6;
        this.dx = 0;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        
        // Keep paddle within canvas bounds
        if (this.x < 0) {
            this.x = 0;
        } else if (this.x + this.width > CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.x = CANVAS_WIDTH - this.width;
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Add gradient effect
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, '#ff6b6b');
        gradient.addColorStop(1, '#ee5a24');
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
    }

    moveLeft() {
        this.dx = -this.speed;
    }

    moveRight() {
        this.dx = this.speed;
    }

    stop() {
        this.dx = 0;
    }
}

// Brick class
class Brick {
    constructor(x, y, type = 'NORMAL') {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = BRICK_WIDTH;
        this.height = BRICK_HEIGHT;
        this.type = type;
        this.hits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.maxHits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.initialColor = BRICK_TYPES[type].color;
        this.color = this.initialColor;
        this.points = BRICK_TYPES[type].points;
        this.moving = BRICK_TYPES[type].moving || false;
        this.dx = this.moving ? 2 : 0;
        this.destroyed = false;
        this.originalX = x; // Store original position for moving bricks
    }

    update(allBricks) {
        if (this.moving && !this.destroyed) {
            const oldX = this.x;
            this.x += this.dx;
            
            // Check for collision with other bricks
            let collision = false;
            for (let brick of allBricks) {
                if (brick !== this && !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'MOVING') {
                    if (this.x < brick.x + brick.width &&
                        this.x + this.width > brick.x &&
                        this.y < brick.y + brick.height &&
                        this.y + this.height > brick.y) {
                        collision = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // If collision detected, revert position and reverse direction
            if (collision) {
                this.x = oldX;
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
            
            // Reverse direction at edges
            if (this.x <= 0 || this.x + this.width >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        if (this.destroyed) return;

        // Draw brick with gradient
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, this.color);
        gradient.addColorStop(1, this.darkenColor(this.color, 20));
        
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw border
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // No hit numbers displayed - color progression shows damage level
    }

    hit() {
        if (this.destroyed) return 0;
        
        if (this.hits === -1) return 0; // Unbreakable brick
        
        this.hits--;
        
        // Update color based on remaining hits
        if (this.maxHits > 1) {
            const colorIndex = Math.min(this.maxHits - this.hits, COLOR_PROGRESSION.length - 1);
            this.color = COLOR_PROGRESSION[colorIndex];
        }
        
        if (this.hits <= 0) {
            this.destroyed = true;
            return this.points;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    darkenColor(color, percent) {
        const num = parseInt(color.replace("#", ""), 16);
        const amt = Math.round(2.55 * percent);
        const R = (num >> 16) - amt;
        const G = (num >> 8 & 0x00FF) - amt;
        const B = (num & 0x0000FF) - amt;
        return "#" + (0x1000000 + (R < 255 ? R < 1 ? 0 : R : 255) * 0x10000 +
            (G < 255 ? G < 1 ? 0 : G : 255) * 0x100 +
            (B < 255 ? B < 1 ? 0 : B : 255)).toString(16).slice(1);
    }
}

// Main Game class
class Game {
    constructor(canvas) {
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball = new Ball(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle = new Paddle(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 30);
        this.bricks = [];
        this.keys = {};
        this.animationId = null;
        
        console.log('Game initialized with state:', this.state);
        this.setupEventListeners();
        this.generateBricks();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
    }

    setupEventListeners() {
        // Keyboard events
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
            
            if (e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
                    this.startGame();
                } else {
                    this.togglePause();
                }
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
        });

        // Button events
        document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.startGame());
        document.getElementById('pauseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.togglePause());
        document.getElementById('resetBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.resetGame());
    }

    generateBricks() {
        this.bricks = [];
        const brickAreaWidth = BRICK_COLS * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING) - BRICK_PADDING;
        const startX = (CANVAS_WIDTH - brickAreaWidth) / 2;

        // Create a grid to track occupied positions
        const grid = Array(BRICK_ROWS).fill().map(() => Array(BRICK_COLS).fill(false));

        for (let row = 0; row < BRICK_ROWS; row++) {
            for (let col = 0; col < BRICK_COLS; col++) {
                // Skip if this position is already occupied
                if (grid[row][col]) continue;

                const x = startX + col * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING);
                const y = BRICK_OFFSET_TOP + row * (BRICK_HEIGHT + BRICK_PADDING);
                
                // Determine brick type based on row and level
                let brickType = 'NORMAL';
                if (row === 0) {
                    // Top row: mix of unbreakable and very strong
                    if (col % 4 === 0) brickType = 'UNBREAKABLE';
                    else brickType = 'VERY_STRONG';
                } else if (row === 1) {
                    // Second row: strong and moving strong
                    if (col % 3 === 0) brickType = 'MOVING_STRONG';
                    else brickType = 'STRONG';
                } else if (row === 2) {
                    // Third row: mix of normal and moving
                    if (col % 2 === 0) brickType = 'MOVING';
                    else brickType = 'NORMAL';
                } else if (row === 3) {
                    // Bottom row: mostly normal with some strong
                    if (col % 5 === 0) brickType = 'STRONG';
                    else brickType = 'NORMAL';
                }

                // If it's a moving block, ensure left and right spaces are empty
                if (brickType === 'MOVING' || brickType === 'MOVING_STRONG') {
                    // Check if left and right positions are available
                    if (col > 0 && col < BRICK_COLS - 1 && 
                        !grid[row][col - 1] && !grid[row][col + 1]) {
                        // Mark left and right positions as occupied
                        grid[row][col - 1] = true;
                        grid[row][col + 1] = true;
                    } else {
                        // Skip this position if we can't place moving block with empty sides
                        continue;
                    }
                }

                // Mark this position as occupied
                grid[row][col] = true;

                this.bricks.push(new Brick(x, y, brickType));
            }
        }
    }

    startGame() {
        console.log('startGame called, current state:', this.state);
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {

            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();

            this.gameLoop();

    }

            this.ball.reverseX();

        if (this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= 0) {

            const hitPos = (this.ball.x - this.paddle.x) / this.paddle.width;
            this.ball.dx = (hitPos - 0.5) * 8;
        }

        // Ball collision with bricks
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => {
            if (!brick.destroyed &&
                this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= brick.x &&
                this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= brick.x + brick.width &&

            if (this.lives <= 0) {

            } else {

                this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;

        if (remainingBricks.length === 0) {

            setTimeout(() => {

```typescriptreact
const { useState, useEffect, useRef } = React;

// Game constants
const CANVAS_WIDTH = 800;
const CANVAS_HEIGHT = 600;
const PADDLE_WIDTH = 100;
const PADDLE_HEIGHT = 15;
const BALL_RADIUS = 8;
const BRICK_WIDTH = 80;
const BRICK_HEIGHT = 30;
const BRICK_ROWS = 4;
const BRICK_COLS = 8;
const BRICK_PADDING = 15;
const BRICK_OFFSET_TOP = 50;
const BRICK_OFFSET_LEFT = 50;

// Brick types
const BRICK_TYPES = {
    NORMAL: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 10 }, // Light blue
    STRONG: { hits: 3, color: '#4169E1', points: 30 }, // Royal blue initially
    VERY_STRONG: { hits: 5, color: '#006400', points: 50 }, // Dark green initially
    MOVING: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 15, moving: true }, // Light blue initially
    MOVING_STRONG: { hits: 2, color: '#32CD32', points: 25, moving: true }, // Lime green initially
    UNBREAKABLE: { hits: -1, color: '#808080', points: 0 } // Grey unbreakable
};

// Color progression for hit bricks (from red to blue - warm to cool)
const COLOR_PROGRESSION = [
    '#FF6B6B', // Red
    '#FF8E53', // Red-orange
    '#FFB347', // Orange
    '#FFD700', // Gold/Yellow
    '#ADFF2F', // Green-yellow
    '#32CD32', // Lime green
    '#00CED1', // Dark turquoise
    '#4169E1', // Royal blue
    '#1E90FF', // Dodger blue
    '#87CEEB'  // Sky blue
];

// Game states
const GAME_STATES = {
    MENU: 'menu',
    PLAYING: 'playing',
    PAUSED: 'paused',
    GAME_OVER: 'gameOver',
    LEVEL_COMPLETE: 'levelComplete'
};

// Ball class
class Ball {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.radius = BALL_RADIUS;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
        this.speed = 4;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        this.y += this.dy;
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ccc';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    reset(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
    }

    reverseX() {
        this.dx = -this.dx;
    }

    reverseY() {
        this.dy = -this.dy;
    }
}

// Paddle class
class Paddle {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = PADDLE_WIDTH;
        this.height = PADDLE_HEIGHT;
        this.speed = 6;
        this.dx = 0;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        
        // Keep paddle within canvas bounds
        if (this.x < 0) {
            this.x = 0;
        } else if (this.x + this.width > CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.x = CANVAS_WIDTH - this.width;
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Add gradient effect
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, '#ff6b6b');
        gradient.addColorStop(1, '#ee5a24');
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
    }

    moveLeft() {
        this.dx = -this.speed;
    }

    moveRight() {
        this.dx = this.speed;
    }

    stop() {
        this.dx = 0;
    }
}

// Brick class
class Brick {
    constructor(x, y, type = 'NORMAL') {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = BRICK_WIDTH;
        this.height = BRICK_HEIGHT;
        this.type = type;
        this.hits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.maxHits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.initialColor = BRICK_TYPES[type].color;
        this.color = this.initialColor;
        this.points = BRICK_TYPES[type].points;
        this.moving = BRICK_TYPES[type].moving || false;
        this.dx = this.moving ? 2 : 0;
        this.destroyed = false;
        this.originalX = x; // Store original position for moving bricks
    }

    update(allBricks) {
        if (this.moving && !this.destroyed) {
            const oldX = this.x;
            this.x += this.dx;
            
            // Check for collision with other bricks
            let collision = false;
            for (let brick of allBricks) {
                if (brick !== this && !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'MOVING') {
                    if (this.x < brick.x + brick.width &&
                        this.x + this.width > brick.x &&
                        this.y < brick.y + brick.height &&
                        this.y + this.height > brick.y) {
                        collision = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // If collision detected, revert position and reverse direction
            if (collision) {
                this.x = oldX;
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
            
            // Reverse direction at edges
            if (this.x <= 0 || this.x + this.width >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        if (this.destroyed) return;

        // Draw brick with gradient
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, this.color);
        gradient.addColorStop(1, this.darkenColor(this.color, 20));
        
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw border
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // No hit numbers displayed - color progression shows damage level
    }

    hit() {
        if (this.destroyed) return 0;
        
        if (this.hits === -1) return 0; // Unbreakable brick
        
        this.hits--;
        
        // Update color based on remaining hits
        if (this.maxHits > 1) {
            const colorIndex = Math.min(this.maxHits - this.hits, COLOR_PROGRESSION.length - 1);
            this.color = COLOR_PROGRESSION[colorIndex];
        }
        
        if (this.hits <= 0) {
            this.destroyed = true;
            return this.points;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    darkenColor(color, percent) {
        const num = parseInt(color.replace("#", ""), 16);
        const amt = Math.round(2.55 * percent);
        const R = (num >> 16) - amt;
        const G = (num >> 8 & 0x00FF) - amt;
        const B = (num & 0x0000FF) - amt;
        return "#" + (0x1000000 + (R < 255 ? R < 1 ? 0 : R : 255) * 0x10000 +
            (G < 255 ? G < 1 ? 0 : G : 255) * 0x100 +
            (B < 255 ? B < 1 ? 0 : B : 255)).toString(16).slice(1);
    }
}

// Main Game class
class Game {
    constructor(canvas) {
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball = new Ball(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle = new Paddle(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 30);
        this.bricks = [];
        this.keys = {};
        this.animationId = null;
        
        console.log('Game initialized with state:', this.state);
        this.setupEventListeners();
        this.generateBricks();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
    }

    setupEventListeners() {
        // Keyboard events
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
            
            if (e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
                    this.startGame();
                } else {
                    this.togglePause();
                }
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
        });

        // Button events
        document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.startGame());
        document.getElementById('pauseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.togglePause());
        document.getElementById('resetBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.resetGame());
    }

    generateBricks() {
        this.bricks = [];
        const brickAreaWidth = BRICK_COLS * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING) - BRICK_PADDING;
        const startX = (CANVAS_WIDTH - brickAreaWidth) / 2;

        // Create a grid to track occupied positions
        const grid = Array(BRICK_ROWS).fill().map(() => Array(BRICK_COLS).fill(false));

        for (let row = 0; row < BRICK_ROWS; row++) {
            for (let col = 0; col < BRICK_COLS; col++) {
                // Skip if this position is already occupied
                if (grid[row][col]) continue;

                const x = startX + col * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING);
                const y = BRICK_OFFSET_TOP + row * (BRICK_HEIGHT + BRICK_PADDING);
                
                // Determine brick type based on row and level
                let brickType = 'NORMAL';
                if (row === 0) {
                    // Top row: mix of unbreakable and very strong
                    if (col % 4 === 0) brickType = 'UNBREAKABLE';
                    else brickType = 'VERY_STRONG';
                } else if (row === 1) {
                    // Second row: strong and moving strong
                    if (col % 3 === 0) brickType = 'MOVING_STRONG';
                    else brickType = 'STRONG';
                } else if (row === 2) {
                    // Third row: mix of normal and moving
                    if (col % 2 === 0) brickType = 'MOVING';
                    else brickType = 'NORMAL';
                } else if (row === 3) {
                    // Bottom row: mostly normal with some strong
                    if (col % 5 === 0) brickType = 'STRONG';
                    else brickType = 'NORMAL';
                }

                // If it's a moving block, ensure left and right spaces are empty
                if (brickType === 'MOVING' || brickType === 'MOVING_STRONG') {
                    // Check if left and right positions are available
                    if (col > 0 && col < BRICK_COLS - 1 && 
                        !grid[row][col - 1] && !grid[row][col + 1]) {
                        // Mark left and right positions as occupied
                        grid[row][col - 1] = true;
                        grid[row][col + 1] = true;
                    } else {
                        // Skip this position if we can't place moving block with empty sides
                        continue;
                    }
                }

                // Mark this position as occupied
                grid[row][col] = true;

                this.bricks.push(new Brick(x, y, brickType));
            }
        }
    }

    startGame() {
        console.log('startGame called, current state:', this.state);
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            console.log('Game started, new state:', this.state);
            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    togglePause() {
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PAUSED;
            this.showOverlay('Game Paused', 'Press SPACE to resume');
        } else if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PAUSED) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    resetGame() {
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
        this.generateBricks();
        this.updateUI();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
        
        if (this.animationId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(this.animationId);
        }
    }

    update() {
        if (this.state !== GAME_STATES.PLAYING) return;

        // Handle paddle movement
        if (this.keys['arrowleft'] || this.keys['a']) {
            this.paddle.moveLeft();
        } else if (this.keys['arrowright'] || this.keys['d']) {
            this.paddle.moveRight();
        } else {
            this.paddle.stop();
        }

        // Update game objects
        this.paddle.update();
        this.ball.update();
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.update(this.bricks));

        // Ball collision with walls
        if (this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= 0 || this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.ball.reverseX();
        }
        if (this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
        }

        // Ball collision with paddle
        if (this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= this.paddle.y &&
            this.ball.x >= this.paddle.x &&
            this.ball.x <= this.paddle.x + this.paddle.width &&
            this.ball.dy > 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
            
            // Add some spin based on where ball hits paddle
            const hitPos = (this.ball.x - this.paddle.x) / this.paddle.width;
            this.ball.dx = (hitPos - 0.5) * 8;
        }

        // Ball collision with bricks
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => {
            if (!brick.destroyed &&
                this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= brick.x &&
                this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= brick.x + brick.width &&
                this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= brick.y &&
                this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= brick.y + brick.height) {
                
                const points = brick.hit();
                this.score += points;
                
                // Calculate collision side more accurately
                const ballLeft = this.ball.x - this.ball.radius;
                const ballRight = this.ball.x + this.ball.radius;
                const ballTop = this.ball.y - this.ball.radius;
                const ballBottom = this.ball.y + this.ball.radius;
                
                const brickLeft = brick.x;
                const brickRight = brick.x + brick.width;
                const brickTop = brick.y;
                const brickBottom = brick.y + brick.height;
                
                // Calculate overlap distances
                const overlapLeft = ballRight - brickLeft;
                const overlapRight = brickRight - ballLeft;
                const overlapTop = ballBottom - brickTop;
                const overlapBottom = brickBottom - ballTop;
                
                // Find the smallest overlap to determine collision side
                const minOverlap = Math.min(overlapLeft, overlapRight, overlapTop, overlapBottom);
                
                if (minOverlap === overlapLeft || minOverlap === overlapRight) {
                    // Horizontal collision (left or right side)
                    this.ball.reverseX();
                } else {
                    // Vertical collision (top or bottom side)
                    this.ball.reverseY();
                }
            }
        });

        // Check if ball fell below paddle
        if (this.ball.y > CANVAS_HEIGHT) {
            this.lives--;
            if (this.lives <= 0) {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER;
                this.showOverlay('Game Over!', `Final Score: ${this.score}`);
            } else {
                this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
                this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            }
        }

        // Check level completion
        const remainingBricks = this.bricks.filter(brick => !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'UNBREAKABLE');
        if (remainingBricks.length === 0) {
            this.level++;
            this.generateBricks();
            this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
            this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            this.state = GAME_STATES.LEVEL_COMPLETE;
            this.showOverlay(`Level ${this.level - 1} Complete!`, `Score: ${this.score}`);
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
                this.hideOverlay();
                this.gameLoop();
            }, 2000);
        }

        this.updateUI();
    }

    draw() {
        // Clear canvas
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

        // Draw game objects
        this.paddle.draw(this.ctx);
        this.ball.draw(this.ctx);
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.draw(this.ctx));

        // Draw particles for destroyed bricks (simple effect)
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        this.ctx.font = '16px Arial';
        this.ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        this.ctx.fillText(`Level ${this.level}`, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 30);
    }

    gameLoop() {
        this.update();
        this.draw();
        
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.gameLoop());
        }
    }

    updateUI() {
        document.getElementById('score').textContent = this.score;
        document.getElementById('level').textContent = this.level;
        
        // Update lives with heart emojis
        const livesElement = document.getElementById('lives');
        let heartsDisplay = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            if (i < this.lives) {
                heartsDisplay += '❤️'; // Red heart for remaining lives
            } else {
                heartsDisplay += '🖤'; // Black heart for lost lives
            }
        }
        livesElement.textContent = heartsDisplay;
    }

    showOverlay(title, message) {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        const titleEl = document.getElementById('overlayTitle');
        const messageEl = document.getElementById('overlayMessage');
        
        titleEl.textContent = title;
        messageEl.textContent = message;
        overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    hideOverlay() {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        overlay.classList.add('hidden');
    }
}

// React component for the game
const BrickBreakerGame = () => {
    const canvasRef = useRef(null);
    const gameRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (canvasRef.current && !gameRef.current) {

        }
    }, []);

    return (
        <div className="game-container">
            <div className="game-header">
                <h1>Brick Breaker</h1>
                        <div className="game-info">
                            <div className="score">Score: <span id="score">0</span></div>
                            <div className="level">Level: <span id="level">1</span></div>
                            <div className="lives">Lives: <span id="lives">❤️❤️❤️</span></div>
                        </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-area">
                <canvas ref={canvasRef} id="gameCanvas" width={CANVAS_WIDTH} height={CANVAS_HEIGHT}></canvas>
                <div className="game-overlay" id="gameOverlay">
                    <div className="overlay-content">
                        <h2 id="overlayTitle">Brick Breaker</h2>
                        <p id="overlayMessage">Press SPACE to start!</p>
                        <div className="controls">
                            <p>Controls:</p>
                            <p>Arrow Keys or WASD to move paddle</p>
                            <p>SPACE to start/pause</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-footer">
                <button id="startBtn">Start Game</button>
                <button id="pauseBtn">Pause</button>
                <button id="resetBtn">Reset</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

// Render the game
ReactDOM.render(<BrickBreakerGame />, document.getElementById('root'));

    }

    reverseY() {
        this.dy = -this.dy;
    }
}

// Paddle class
class Paddle {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = PADDLE_WIDTH;
        this.height = PADDLE_HEIGHT;
        this.speed = 6;
        this.dx = 0;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        
        // Keep paddle within canvas bounds
        if (this.x < 0) {
            this.x = 0;
        } else if (this.x + this.width > CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.x = CANVAS_WIDTH - this.width;
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Add gradient effect
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, '#ff6b6b');
        gradient.addColorStop(1, '#ee5a24');
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
    }

    moveLeft() {
        this.dx = -this.speed;
    }

    moveRight() {
        this.dx = this.speed;
    }

    stop() {
        this.dx = 0;
    }
}

// Brick class
class Brick {
    constructor(x, y, type = 'NORMAL') {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = BRICK_WIDTH;
        this.height = BRICK_HEIGHT;
        this.type = type;
        this.hits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.maxHits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.initialColor = BRICK_TYPES[type].color;
        this.color = this.initialColor;
        this.points = BRICK_TYPES[type].points;
        this.moving = BRICK_TYPES[type].moving || false;
        this.dx = this.moving ? 2 : 0;
        this.destroyed = false;
        this.originalX = x; // Store original position for moving bricks
    }

    update(allBricks) {
        if (this.moving && !this.destroyed) {
            const oldX = this.x;
            this.x += this.dx;
            
            // Check for collision with other bricks
            let collision = false;
            for (let brick of allBricks) {
                if (brick !== this && !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'MOVING') {
                    if (this.x < brick.x + brick.width &&
                        this.x + this.width > brick.x &&
                        this.y < brick.y + brick.height &&
                        this.y + this.height > brick.y) {
                        collision = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // If collision detected, revert position and reverse direction
            if (collision) {
                this.x = oldX;
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
            
            // Reverse direction at edges
            if (this.x <= 0 || this.x + this.width >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        if (this.destroyed) return;

        // Draw brick with gradient
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, this.color);
        gradient.addColorStop(1, this.darkenColor(this.color, 20));
        
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw border
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // No hit numbers displayed - color progression shows damage level
    }

    hit() {
        if (this.destroyed) return 0;
        
        if (this.hits === -1) return 0; // Unbreakable brick
        
        this.hits--;
        
        // Update color based on remaining hits
        if (this.maxHits > 1) {
            const colorIndex = Math.min(this.maxHits - this.hits, COLOR_PROGRESSION.length - 1);
            this.color = COLOR_PROGRESSION[colorIndex];
        }
        
        if (this.hits <= 0) {
            this.destroyed = true;
            return this.points;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    darkenColor(color, percent) {
        const num = parseInt(color.replace("#", ""), 16);
        const amt = Math.round(2.55 * percent);
        const R = (num >> 16) - amt;
        const G = (num >> 8 & 0x00FF) - amt;
        const B = (num & 0x0000FF) - amt;
        return "#" + (0x1000000 + (R < 255 ? R < 1 ? 0 : R : 255) * 0x10000 +
            (G < 255 ? G < 1 ? 0 : G : 255) * 0x100 +
            (B < 255 ? B < 1 ? 0 : B : 255)).toString(16).slice(1);
    }
}

// Main Game class
class Game {
    constructor(canvas) {
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball = new Ball(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle = new Paddle(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 30);
        this.bricks = [];
        this.keys = {};
        this.animationId = null;
        
        console.log('Game initialized with state:', this.state);
        this.setupEventListeners();
        this.generateBricks();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
    }

    setupEventListeners() {
        // Keyboard events
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
            
            if (e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
                    this.startGame();
                } else {
                    this.togglePause();
                }
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
        });

        // Button events
        document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.startGame());
        document.getElementById('pauseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.togglePause());
        document.getElementById('resetBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.resetGame());
    }

    generateBricks() {
        this.bricks = [];
        const brickAreaWidth = BRICK_COLS * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING) - BRICK_PADDING;
        const startX = (CANVAS_WIDTH - brickAreaWidth) / 2;

        // Create a grid to track occupied positions
        const grid = Array(BRICK_ROWS).fill().map(() => Array(BRICK_COLS).fill(false));

        for (let row = 0; row < BRICK_ROWS; row++) {
            for (let col = 0; col < BRICK_COLS; col++) {
                // Skip if this position is already occupied
                if (grid[row][col]) continue;

                const x = startX + col * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING);
                const y = BRICK_OFFSET_TOP + row * (BRICK_HEIGHT + BRICK_PADDING);
                
                // Determine brick type based on row and level
                let brickType = 'NORMAL';
                if (row === 0) {
                    // Top row: mix of unbreakable and very strong
                    if (col % 4 === 0) brickType = 'UNBREAKABLE';
                    else brickType = 'VERY_STRONG';
                } else if (row === 1) {
                    // Second row: strong and moving strong
                    if (col % 3 === 0) brickType = 'MOVING_STRONG';
                    else brickType = 'STRONG';
                } else if (row === 2) {
                    // Third row: mix of normal and moving
                    if (col % 2 === 0) brickType = 'MOVING';
                    else brickType = 'NORMAL';
                } else if (row === 3) {
                    // Bottom row: mostly normal with some strong
                    if (col % 5 === 0) brickType = 'STRONG';
                    else brickType = 'NORMAL';
                }

                // If it's a moving block, ensure left and right spaces are empty
                if (brickType === 'MOVING' || brickType === 'MOVING_STRONG') {
                    // Check if left and right positions are available
                    if (col > 0 && col < BRICK_COLS - 1 && 
                        !grid[row][col - 1] && !grid[row][col + 1]) {
                        // Mark left and right positions as occupied
                        grid[row][col - 1] = true;
                        grid[row][col + 1] = true;
                    } else {
                        // Skip this position if we can't place moving block with empty sides
                        continue;
                    }
                }

                // Mark this position as occupied
                grid[row][col] = true;

                this.bricks.push(new Brick(x, y, brickType));
            }
        }
    }

    startGame() {
        console.log('startGame called, current state:', this.state);
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            console.log('Game started, new state:', this.state);
            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    togglePause() {
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PAUSED;
            this.showOverlay('Game Paused', 'Press SPACE to resume');
        } else if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PAUSED) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    resetGame() {
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
        this.generateBricks();
        this.updateUI();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
        
        if (this.animationId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(this.animationId);
        }
    }

    update() {
        if (this.state !== GAME_STATES.PLAYING) return;

        // Handle paddle movement
        if (this.keys['arrowleft'] || this.keys['a']) {
            this.paddle.moveLeft();
        } else if (this.keys['arrowright'] || this.keys['d']) {
            this.paddle.moveRight();
        } else {
            this.paddle.stop();
        }

        // Update game objects
        this.paddle.update();
        this.ball.update();
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.update(this.bricks));

        // Ball collision with walls
        if (this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= 0 || this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.ball.reverseX();
        }
        if (this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
        }

        // Ball collision with paddle
        if (this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= this.paddle.y &&
            this.ball.x >= this.paddle.x &&
            this.ball.x <= this.paddle.x + this.paddle.width &&
            this.ball.dy > 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
            
            // Add some spin based on where ball hits paddle
            const hitPos = (this.ball.x - this.paddle.x) / this.paddle.width;
            this.ball.dx = (hitPos - 0.5) * 8;
        }

        // Ball collision with bricks
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => {
            if (!brick.destroyed &&
                this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= brick.x &&
                this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= brick.x + brick.width &&
                this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= brick.y &&
                this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= brick.y + brick.height) {
                
                const points = brick.hit();
                this.score += points;
                
                // Calculate collision side more accurately
                const ballLeft = this.ball.x - this.ball.radius;
                const ballRight = this.ball.x + this.ball.radius;
                const ballTop = this.ball.y - this.ball.radius;
                const ballBottom = this.ball.y + this.ball.radius;
                
                const brickLeft = brick.x;
                const brickRight = brick.x + brick.width;
                const brickTop = brick.y;
                const brickBottom = brick.y + brick.height;
                
                // Calculate overlap distances
                const overlapLeft = ballRight - brickLeft;
                const overlapRight = brickRight - ballLeft;
                const overlapTop = ballBottom - brickTop;
                const overlapBottom = brickBottom - ballTop;
                
                // Find the smallest overlap to determine collision side
                const minOverlap = Math.min(overlapLeft, overlapRight, overlapTop, overlapBottom);
                
                if (minOverlap === overlapLeft || minOverlap === overlapRight) {
                    // Horizontal collision (left or right side)
                    this.ball.reverseX();
                } else {
                    // Vertical collision (top or bottom side)
                    this.ball.reverseY();
                }
            }
        });

        // Check if ball fell below paddle
        if (this.ball.y > CANVAS_HEIGHT) {
            this.lives--;
            if (this.lives <= 0) {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER;
                this.showOverlay('Game Over!', `Final Score: ${this.score}`);
            } else {
                this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
                this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            }
        }

        // Check level completion
        const remainingBricks = this.bricks.filter(brick => !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'UNBREAKABLE');
        if (remainingBricks.length === 0) {
            this.level++;
            this.generateBricks();
            this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
            this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            this.state = GAME_STATES.LEVEL_COMPLETE;
            this.showOverlay(`Level ${this.level - 1} Complete!`, `Score: ${this.score}`);
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
                this.hideOverlay();
                this.gameLoop();
            }, 2000);
        }

        this.updateUI();
    }

    draw() {
        // Clear canvas
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

        // Draw game objects
        this.paddle.draw(this.ctx);
        this.ball.draw(this.ctx);
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.draw(this.ctx));

        // Draw particles for destroyed bricks (simple effect)
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        this.ctx.font = '16px Arial';
        this.ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        this.ctx.fillText(`Level ${this.level}`, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 30);
    }

    gameLoop() {
        this.update();
        this.draw();
        
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.gameLoop());
        }
    }

    updateUI() {
        document.getElementById('score').textContent = this.score;
        document.getElementById('level').textContent = this.level;
        
        // Update lives with heart emojis
        const livesElement = document.getElementById('lives');
        let heartsDisplay = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            if (i < this.lives) {
                heartsDisplay += '❤️'; // Red heart for remaining lives
            } else {
                heartsDisplay += '🖤'; // Black heart for lost lives
            }
        }
        livesElement.textContent = heartsDisplay;
    }

    showOverlay(title, message) {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        const titleEl = document.getElementById('overlayTitle');
        const messageEl = document.getElementById('overlayMessage');
        
        titleEl.textContent = title;
        messageEl.textContent = message;
        overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    hideOverlay() {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        overlay.classList.add('hidden');
    }
}

// React component for the game
const BrickBreakerGame = () => {
    const canvasRef = useRef(null);
    const gameRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (canvasRef.current && !gameRef.current) {
            gameRef.current = new Game(canvasRef.current);
        }
    }, []);

    return (
        <div className="game-container">
            <div className="game-header">
                <h1>Brick Breaker</h1>
                        <div className="game-info">
                            <div className="score">Score: <span id="score">0</span></div>
                            <div className="level">Level: <span id="level">1</span></div>
                            <div className="lives">Lives: <span id="lives">❤️❤️❤️</span></div>
                        </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-area">
                <canvas ref={canvasRef} id="gameCanvas" width={CANVAS_WIDTH} height={CANVAS_HEIGHT}></canvas>
                <div className="game-overlay" id="gameOverlay">
                    <div className="overlay-content">
                        <h2 id="overlayTitle">Brick Breaker</h2>
                        <p id="overlayMessage">Press SPACE to start!</p>
                        <div className="controls">
                            <p>Controls:</p>
                            <p>Arrow Keys or WASD to move paddle</p>
                            <p>SPACE to start/pause</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-footer">
                <button id="startBtn">Start Game</button>
                <button id="pauseBtn">Pause</button>
                <button id="resetBtn">Reset</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

// Render the game
ReactDOM.render(<BrickBreakerGame />, document.getElementById('root'));

        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball = new Ball(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle = new Paddle(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 30);
        this.bricks = [];
        this.keys = {};
        this.animationId = null;
        
        console.log('Game initialized with state:', this.state);
        this.setupEventListeners();
        this.generateBricks();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
    }

    setupEventListeners() {
        // Keyboard events
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
            
            if (e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
                    this.startGame();
                } else {
                    this.togglePause();
                }
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
        });

        // Button events
        document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.startGame());
        document.getElementById('pauseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.togglePause());
        document.getElementById('resetBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.resetGame());
    }

    generateBricks() {
        this.bricks = [];
        const brickAreaWidth = BRICK_COLS * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING) - BRICK_PADDING;
        const startX = (CANVAS_WIDTH - brickAreaWidth) / 2;

        // Create a grid to track occupied positions
        const grid = Array(BRICK_ROWS).fill().map(() => Array(BRICK_COLS).fill(false));

        for (let row = 0; row < BRICK_ROWS; row++) {
            for (let col = 0; col < BRICK_COLS; col++) {
                // Skip if this position is already occupied
                if (grid[row][col]) continue;

                const x = startX + col * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING);
                const y = BRICK_OFFSET_TOP + row * (BRICK_HEIGHT + BRICK_PADDING);
                
                // Determine brick type based on row and level
                let brickType = 'NORMAL';
                if (row === 0) {
                    // Top row: mix of unbreakable and very strong
                    if (col % 4 === 0) brickType = 'UNBREAKABLE';
                    else brickType = 'VERY_STRONG';
                } else if (row === 1) {
                    // Second row: strong and moving strong
                    if (col % 3 === 0) brickType = 'MOVING_STRONG';
                    else brickType = 'STRONG';
                } else if (row === 2) {
                    // Third row: mix of normal and moving
                    if (col % 2 === 0) brickType = 'MOVING';
                    else brickType = 'NORMAL';
                } else if (row === 3) {
                    // Bottom row: mostly normal with some strong
                    if (col % 5 === 0) brickType = 'STRONG';
                    else brickType = 'NORMAL';
                }

                // If it's a moving block, ensure left and right spaces are empty
                if (brickType === 'MOVING' || brickType === 'MOVING_STRONG') {
                    // Check if left and right positions are available
                    if (col > 0 && col < BRICK_COLS - 1 && 
                        !grid[row][col - 1] && !grid[row][col + 1]) {
                        // Mark left and right positions as occupied
                        grid[row][col - 1] = true;
                        grid[row][col + 1] = true;
                    } else {
                        // Skip this position if we can't place moving block with empty sides
                        continue;
                    }
                }

                // Mark this position as occupied
                grid[row][col] = true;

                this.bricks.push(new Brick(x, y, brickType));
            }
        }
    }

    startGame() {
        console.log('startGame called, current state:', this.state);
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            console.log('Game started, new state:', this.state);
            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    togglePause() {
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PAUSED;
            this.showOverlay('Game Paused', 'Press SPACE to resume');
        } else if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PAUSED) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    resetGame() {
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
        this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
        this.generateBricks();
        this.updateUI();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
        
        if (this.animationId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(this.animationId);
        }
    }

    update() {
        if (this.state !== GAME_STATES.PLAYING) return;

        // Handle paddle movement
        if (this.keys['arrowleft'] || this.keys['a']) {
            this.paddle.moveLeft();
        } else if (this.keys['arrowright'] || this.keys['d']) {
            this.paddle.moveRight();
        } else {
            this.paddle.stop();
        }

        // Update game objects
        this.paddle.update();
        this.ball.update();
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.update(this.bricks));

        // Ball collision with walls
        if (this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= 0 || this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.ball.reverseX();
        }
        if (this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
        }

        // Ball collision with paddle
        if (this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= this.paddle.y &&
            this.ball.x >= this.paddle.x &&
            this.ball.x <= this.paddle.x + this.paddle.width &&
            this.ball.dy > 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
            
            // Add some spin based on where ball hits paddle
            const hitPos = (this.ball.x - this.paddle.x) / this.paddle.width;
            this.ball.dx = (hitPos - 0.5) * 8;
        }

        // Ball collision with bricks
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => {
            if (!brick.destroyed &&
                this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= brick.x &&
                this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= brick.x + brick.width &&
                this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= brick.y &&
                this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= brick.y + brick.height) {
                
                const points = brick.hit();
                this.score += points;
                
                // Calculate collision side more accurately
                const ballLeft = this.ball.x - this.ball.radius;
                const ballRight = this.ball.x + this.ball.radius;
                const ballTop = this.ball.y - this.ball.radius;
                const ballBottom = this.ball.y + this.ball.radius;
                
                const brickLeft = brick.x;
                const brickRight = brick.x + brick.width;
                const brickTop = brick.y;
                const brickBottom = brick.y + brick.height;
                
                // Calculate overlap distances
                const overlapLeft = ballRight - brickLeft;
                const overlapRight = brickRight - ballLeft;
                const overlapTop = ballBottom - brickTop;
                const overlapBottom = brickBottom - ballTop;
                
                // Find the smallest overlap to determine collision side
                const minOverlap = Math.min(overlapLeft, overlapRight, overlapTop, overlapBottom);
                
                if (minOverlap === overlapLeft || minOverlap === overlapRight) {
                    // Horizontal collision (left or right side)
                    this.ball.reverseX();
                } else {
                    // Vertical collision (top or bottom side)
                    this.ball.reverseY();
                }
            }
        });

        // Check if ball fell below paddle
        if (this.ball.y > CANVAS_HEIGHT) {
            this.lives--;
            if (this.lives <= 0) {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER;
                this.showOverlay('Game Over!', `Final Score: ${this.score}`);
            } else {
                this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
                this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            }
        }

        // Check level completion
        const remainingBricks = this.bricks.filter(brick => !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'UNBREAKABLE');
        if (remainingBricks.length === 0) {
            this.level++;
            this.generateBricks();
            this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
            this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            this.state = GAME_STATES.LEVEL_COMPLETE;
            this.showOverlay(`Level ${this.level - 1} Complete!`, `Score: ${this.score}`);
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
                this.hideOverlay();
                this.gameLoop();
            }, 2000);
        }

        this.updateUI();
    }

    draw() {
        // Clear canvas
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

        // Draw game objects
        this.paddle.draw(this.ctx);
        this.ball.draw(this.ctx);
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.draw(this.ctx));

        // Draw particles for destroyed bricks (simple effect)
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        this.ctx.font = '16px Arial';
        this.ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        this.ctx.fillText(`Level ${this.level}`, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 30);
    }

    gameLoop() {
        this.update();
        this.draw();
        
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.gameLoop());
        }
    }

    updateUI() {
        document.getElementById('score').textContent = this.score;
        document.getElementById('level').textContent = this.level;
        
        // Update lives with heart emojis
        const livesElement = document.getElementById('lives');
        let heartsDisplay = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            if (i < this.lives) {
                heartsDisplay += '❤️'; // Red heart for remaining lives
            } else {
                heartsDisplay += '🖤'; // Black heart for lost lives
            }
        }
        livesElement.textContent = heartsDisplay;
    }

    showOverlay(title, message) {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        const titleEl = document.getElementById('overlayTitle');
        const messageEl = document.getElementById('overlayMessage');
        
        titleEl.textContent = title;
        messageEl.textContent = message;
        overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    hideOverlay() {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        overlay.classList.add('hidden');
    }
}

// React component for the game
const BrickBreakerGame = () => {
    const canvasRef = useRef(null);
    const gameRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (canvasRef.current && !gameRef.current) {
            gameRef.current = new Game(canvasRef.current);
        }
    }, []);

    return (
        <div className="game-container">
            <div className="game-header">
                <h1>Brick Breaker</h1>
                        <div className="game-info">
                            <div className="score">Score: <span id="score">0</span></div>
                            <div className="level">Level: <span id="level">1</span></div>
                            <div className="lives">Lives: <span id="lives">❤️❤️❤️</span></div>
                        </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-area">
                <canvas ref={canvasRef} id="gameCanvas" width={CANVAS_WIDTH} height={CANVAS_HEIGHT}></canvas>
                <div className="game-overlay" id="gameOverlay">
                    <div className="overlay-content">
                        <h2 id="overlayTitle">Brick Breaker</h2>
                        <p id="overlayMessage">Press SPACE to start!</p>
                        <div className="controls">
                            <p>Controls:</p>
                            <p>Arrow Keys or WASD to move paddle</p>
                            <p>SPACE to start/pause</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-footer">
                <button id="startBtn">Start Game</button>
                <button id="pauseBtn">Pause</button>
                <button id="resetBtn">Reset</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

// Render the game
ReactDOM.render(<BrickBreakerGame />, document.getElementById('root'));

const { useState, useEffect, useRef } = React;

// Game constants
const CANVAS_WIDTH = 800;
const CANVAS_HEIGHT = 600;
const PADDLE_WIDTH = 100;
const PADDLE_HEIGHT = 15;
const BALL_RADIUS = 8;
const BRICK_WIDTH = 80;
const BRICK_HEIGHT = 30;
const BRICK_ROWS = 4;
const BRICK_COLS = 8;
const BRICK_PADDING = 15;
const BRICK_OFFSET_TOP = 50;
const BRICK_OFFSET_LEFT = 50;

// Brick types
const BRICK_TYPES = {
    NORMAL: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 10 }, // Sky blue (final color)
    STRONG: { hits: 3, color: '#1E90FF', points: 30 }, // Dodger blue (3rd from end)
    VERY_STRONG: { hits: 5, color: '#4169E1', points: 50 }, // Royal blue (5th from end)
    MOVING: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 15, moving: true }, // Sky blue
    MOVING_STRONG: { hits: 2, color: '#00CED1', points: 25, moving: true }, // Dark turquoise
    UNBREAKABLE: { hits: -1, color: '#808080', points: 0 } // Grey unbreakable
};

// Color progression for hit bricks (from red to blue - warm to cool)
const COLOR_PROGRESSION = [
    '#FF6B6B', // Red
    '#FF8E53', // Red-orange
    '#FFB347', // Orange
    '#FFD700', // Gold/Yellow
    '#ADFF2F', // Green-yellow
    '#32CD32', // Lime green
    '#00CED1', // Dark turquoise
    '#4169E1', // Royal blue
    '#1E90FF', // Dodger blue
    '#87CEEB'  // Sky blue
];

// Game states
const GAME_STATES = {
    MENU: 'menu',
    PLAYING: 'playing',
    PAUSED: 'paused',
    GAME_OVER: 'gameOver',
    LEVEL_COMPLETE: 'levelComplete'
};

// Ball class
class Ball {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.radius = BALL_RADIUS;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
        this.speed = 4;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        this.y += this.dy;
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ccc';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    reset(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
    }

    reverseX() {
        this.dx = -this.dx;
    }

    reverseY() {
        this.dy = -this.dy;
    }
}

// Paddle class
class Paddle {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = PADDLE_WIDTH;
        this.height = PADDLE_HEIGHT;
        this.speed = 6;
        this.dx = 0;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        
        // Keep paddle within canvas bounds
        if (this.x < 0) {
            this.x = 0;
        } else if (this.x + this.width > CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.x = CANVAS_WIDTH - this.width;
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Add gradient effect
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, '#ff6b6b');
        gradient.addColorStop(1, '#ee5a24');
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
    }

    moveLeft() {
        this.dx = -this.speed;
    }

    moveRight() {
        this.dx = this.speed;
    }

    stop() {
        this.dx = 0;
    }
}

// Brick class
class Brick {
    constructor(x, y, type = 'NORMAL') {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = BRICK_WIDTH;
        this.height = BRICK_HEIGHT;
        this.type = type;
        this.hits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.maxHits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.initialColor = BRICK_TYPES[type].color;
        this.color = this.initialColor;
        this.targetColor = this.initialColor;
        this.points = BRICK_TYPES[type].points;
        this.moving = BRICK_TYPES[type].moving || false;
        this.dx = this.moving ? 2 : 0;
        this.destroyed = false;
        this.originalX = x; // Store original position for moving bricks
        this.colorTransitionTime = 0;
        this.colorTransitionDuration = 300; // 300ms transition
    }

    update(allBricks, deltaTime = 16) {
        // Handle color transition animation
        if (this.colorTransitionTime > 0) {
            this.colorTransitionTime -= deltaTime;
            const progress = 1 - (this.colorTransitionTime / this.colorTransitionDuration);
            this.color = this.interpolateColor(this.color, this.targetColor, progress);
        }

        if (this.moving && !this.destroyed) {
            const oldX = this.x;
            this.x += this.dx;
            
            // Check for collision with other bricks
            let collision = false;
            for (let brick of allBricks) {
                if (brick !== this && !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'MOVING') {
                    if (this.x < brick.x + brick.width &&
                        this.x + this.width > brick.x &&
                        this.y < brick.y + brick.height &&
                        this.y + this.height > brick.y) {
                        collision = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // If collision detected, revert position and reverse direction
            if (collision) {
                this.x = oldX;
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
            
            // Reverse direction at edges
            if (this.x <= 0 || this.x + this.width >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        if (this.destroyed) return;

        // Draw brick with gradient
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, this.color);
        gradient.addColorStop(1, this.darkenColor(this.color, 20));
        
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw border
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // No hit numbers displayed - color progression shows damage level
    }

    hit() {
        if (this.destroyed) return 0;
        
        if (this.hits === -1) return 0; // Unbreakable brick
        
        this.hits--;
        
        // Update color based on remaining hits
        if (this.maxHits > 1) {
            const colorIndex = Math.min(this.maxHits - this.hits, COLOR_PROGRESSION.length - 1);
            this.color = COLOR_PROGRESSION[colorIndex];
        }
        
        if (this.hits <= 0) {
            this.destroyed = true;
            return this.points;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    darkenColor(color, percent) {
        const num = parseInt(color.replace("#", ""), 16);
        const amt = Math.round(2.55 * percent);
        const R = (num >> 16) - amt;
        const G = (num >> 8 & 0x00FF) - amt;
        const B = (num & 0x0000FF) - amt;
        return "#" + (0x1000000 + (R < 255 ? R < 1 ? 0 : R : 255) * 0x10000 +
            (G < 255 ? G < 1 ? 0 : G : 255) * 0x100 +
            (B < 255 ? B < 1 ? 0 : B : 255)).toString(16).slice(1);
    }
}

    }

    update() {
        if (this.state !== GAME_STATES.PLAYING) return;

        // Handle paddle movement
        if (this.keys['arrowleft'] || this.keys['a']) {
            this.paddle.moveLeft();
        } else if (this.keys['arrowright'] || this.keys['d']) {
            this.paddle.moveRight();
        } else {
            this.paddle.stop();
        }

        // Update game objects
        this.paddle.update();
        this.ball.update();
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.update(this.bricks));

        // Ball collision with walls
        if (this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= 0 || this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.ball.reverseX();
        }
        if (this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
        }

        // Ball collision with paddle
        if (this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= this.paddle.y &&
            this.ball.x >= this.paddle.x &&
            this.ball.x <= this.paddle.x + this.paddle.width &&
            this.ball.dy > 0) {
            this.ball.reverseY();
            
            // Add some spin based on where ball hits paddle
            const hitPos = (this.ball.x - this.paddle.x) / this.paddle.width;
            this.ball.dx = (hitPos - 0.5) * 8;
        }

        // Ball collision with bricks
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => {
            if (!brick.destroyed &&
                this.ball.x + this.ball.radius >= brick.x &&
                this.ball.x - this.ball.radius <= brick.x + brick.width &&
                this.ball.y + this.ball.radius >= brick.y &&
                this.ball.y - this.ball.radius <= brick.y + brick.height) {
                
                const points = brick.hit();
                this.score += points;
                
                // Calculate collision side more accurately
                const ballLeft = this.ball.x - this.ball.radius;
                const ballRight = this.ball.x + this.ball.radius;
                const ballTop = this.ball.y - this.ball.radius;
                const ballBottom = this.ball.y + this.ball.radius;
                
                const brickLeft = brick.x;
                const brickRight = brick.x + brick.width;
                const brickTop = brick.y;
                const brickBottom = brick.y + brick.height;
                
                // Calculate overlap distances
                const overlapLeft = ballRight - brickLeft;
                const overlapRight = brickRight - ballLeft;
                const overlapTop = ballBottom - brickTop;
                const overlapBottom = brickBottom - ballTop;
                
                // Find the smallest overlap to determine collision side
                const minOverlap = Math.min(overlapLeft, overlapRight, overlapTop, overlapBottom);
                
                if (minOverlap === overlapLeft || minOverlap === overlapRight) {
                    // Horizontal collision (left or right side)
                    this.ball.reverseX();
                } else {
                    // Vertical collision (top or bottom side)
                    this.ball.reverseY();
                }
            }
        });

        // Check if ball fell below paddle
        if (this.ball.y > CANVAS_HEIGHT) {
            this.lives--;
            if (this.lives <= 0) {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER;
                this.showOverlay('Game Over!', `Final Score: ${this.score}`);
            } else {
                this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
                this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            }
        }

        // Check level completion
        const remainingBricks = this.bricks.filter(brick => !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'UNBREAKABLE');
        if (remainingBricks.length === 0) {
            this.level++;
            this.generateBricks();
            this.ball.reset(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50);
            this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            this.state = GAME_STATES.LEVEL_COMPLETE;
            this.showOverlay(`Level ${this.level - 1} Complete!`, `Score: ${this.score}`);
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
                this.hideOverlay();
                this.gameLoop();
            }, 2000);
        }

        this.updateUI();
    }

    draw() {
        // Clear canvas
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

        // Draw game objects
        this.paddle.draw(this.ctx);
        this.ball.draw(this.ctx);
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.draw(this.ctx));

        // Draw particles for destroyed bricks (simple effect)
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        this.ctx.font = '16px Arial';
        this.ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        this.ctx.fillText(`Level ${this.level}`, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 30);
    }

    gameLoop() {
        this.update();
        this.draw();
        
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.gameLoop());
        }
    }

    updateUI() {
        document.getElementById('score').textContent = this.score;
        document.getElementById('level').textContent = this.level;
        
        // Update lives with heart emojis
        const livesElement = document.getElementById('lives');
        let heartsDisplay = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            if (i < this.lives) {
                heartsDisplay += '❤️'; // Red heart for remaining lives
            } else {
                heartsDisplay += '🖤'; // Black heart for lost lives
            }
        }
        livesElement.textContent = heartsDisplay;
    }

    showOverlay(title, message) {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        const titleEl = document.getElementById('overlayTitle');
        const messageEl = document.getElementById('overlayMessage');
        
        titleEl.textContent = title;
        messageEl.textContent = message;
        overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    hideOverlay() {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        overlay.classList.add('hidden');
    }
}

// React component for the game
const BrickBreakerGame = () => {
    const canvasRef = useRef(null);
    const gameRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (canvasRef.current && !gameRef.current) {

};

// Render the game
ReactDOM.render(<BrickBreakerGame />, document.getElementById('root'));
