```typescriptreact
const { useState, useEffect, useRef } = React;

// Game constants
const CANVAS_WIDTH = 800;
const CANVAS_HEIGHT = 600;
const PADDLE_WIDTH = 100;
const PADDLE_HEIGHT = 15;
const BALL_RADIUS = 5;
const BRICK_WIDTH = 80;
const BRICK_HEIGHT = 30;
const BRICK_ROWS = 3;
const BRICK_COLS = 4;
const BRICK_PADDING = 15;
const BRICK_OFFSET_TOP = 50;
const BRICK_OFFSET_LEFT = 50;

// Brick types
const BRICK_TYPES = {
    NORMAL: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 10 }, // Sky blue - 1 health
    STRONG: { hits: 3, color: '#4169E1', points: 30 }, // Royal blue - 3 health
    VERY_STRONG: { hits: 5, color: '#32CD32', points: 50 }, // Lime green - 5 health
    MOVING: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 15, moving: true }, // Sky blue - 1 health
    MOVING_STRONG: { hits: 2, color: '#1E90FF', points: 25, moving: true }, // Dodger blue - 2 health
    UNBREAKABLE: { hits: -1, color: '#808080', points: 0 } // Grey unbreakable
};

// Color progression based on health (red = high health, blue = low health)
const COLOR_PROGRESSION = [
    '#87CEEB', // Sky blue - 1 health left
    '#1E90FF', // Dodger blue - 2 health left
    '#00CED1', // Dark turquoise - 4 health left
    '#4169E1', // Royal blue - 3 health left
    '#32CD32', // Lime green - 5 health left
    '#ADFF2F', // Green-yellow - 6 health left
    '#FFD700', // Gold/Yellow - 7 health left
    '#FFB347', // Orange - 8 health left
    '#FF8E53', // Red-orange - 9 health left
    '#FF6B6B'  // Red - 10 health left
];

// Game states
const GAME_STATES = {
    MENU: 'menu',
    PLAYING: 'playing',
    PAUSED: 'paused',
    GAME_OVER: 'gameOver',
    LEVEL_COMPLETE: 'levelComplete'
};

// Ball class
class Ball {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.radius = BALL_RADIUS;
        this.dx = 6;
        this.dy = -8;
        this.speed = 10;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        this.y += this.dy;
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ccc';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    reset(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
    }

    reverseX() {
        this.dx = -this.dx;
    }

    reverseY() {
        this.dy = -this.dy;
    }
}

// Paddle class
class Paddle {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = PADDLE_WIDTH;
        this.height = PADDLE_HEIGHT;
        this.speed = 10;
        this.dx = 0;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        
        // Keep paddle within canvas bounds
        if (this.x < 0) {
            this.x = 0;
        } else if (this.x + this.width > CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.x = CANVAS_WIDTH - this.width;
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Add gradient effect
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, '#ff6b6b');
        gradient.addColorStop(1, '#ee5a24');
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
    }

    moveLeft() {
        this.dx = -this.speed;
    }

    moveRight() {
        this.dx = this.speed;
    }

    stop() {
        this.dx = 0;
    }
}

// Brick class
class Brick {
    constructor(x, y, type = 'NORMAL') {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = BRICK_WIDTH;
        this.height = BRICK_HEIGHT;
        this.type = type;
        this.hits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.maxHits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.initialColor = BRICK_TYPES[type].color;
        this.color = this.initialColor;
        this.targetColor = this.initialColor;
        this.points = BRICK_TYPES[type].points;
        this.moving = BRICK_TYPES[type].moving || false;
        this.dx = this.moving ? 2 : 0;
        this.destroyed = false;
        this.originalX = x; // Store original position for moving bricks
        this.colorTransitionTime = 0;
        this.colorTransitionDuration = 300; // 300ms transition
    }

    update(allBricks, deltaTime = 16) {
        // Handle color transition animation (only if brick is not destroyed)
        if (this.colorTransitionTime > 0 && !this.destroyed) {
            this.colorTransitionTime -= deltaTime;
            const progress = 1 - (this.colorTransitionTime / this.colorTransitionDuration);
            this.color = this.interpolateColor(this.color, this.targetColor, progress);
        }

        if (this.moving && !this.destroyed) {
            const oldX = this.x;
            this.x += this.dx;
            
            // Check for collision with other bricks
            let collision = false;
            for (let brick of allBricks) {
                if (brick !== this && !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'MOVING') {
                    if (this.x < brick.x + brick.width &&
                        this.x + this.width > brick.x &&
                        this.y < brick.y + brick.height &&
                        this.y + this.height > brick.y) {
                        collision = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // If collision detected, revert position and reverse direction
            if (collision) {
                this.x = oldX;
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
            
            // Reverse direction at edges
            if (this.x <= 0 || this.x + this.width >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        if (this.destroyed) return;

        // Draw brick with gradient
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, this.color);
        gradient.addColorStop(1, this.darkenColor(this.color, 20));
        
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw border
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // No hit numbers displayed - color progression shows damage level
    }

    hit() {
        if (this.destroyed) return 0;
        
        if (this.hits === -1) return 0; // Unbreakable brick
        
        this.hits--;
        
        // Update color based on remaining health with smooth transition
        if (this.maxHits > 1) {
            // Color index is based on remaining health (hits), not damage taken
            const colorIndex = Math.min(this.hits - 1, COLOR_PROGRESSION.length - 1);
            this.targetColor = COLOR_PROGRESSION[colorIndex];
            this.colorTransitionTime = this.colorTransitionDuration;
        }
        
        if (this.hits <= 0) {
            this.destroyed = true;
            return this.points;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    interpolateColor(color1, color2, progress) {
        // Check if colors are valid
        if (!color1 || !color2 || typeof color1 !== 'string' || typeof color2 !== 'string') {
            return color1 || color2 || '#87CEEB'; // Return first valid color or default
        }
        
        // Convert hex colors to RGB
        const hex1 = color1.replace('#', '');
        const hex2 = color2.replace('#', '');
        
        const r1 = parseInt(hex1.substr(0, 2), 16);
        const g1 = parseInt(hex1.substr(2, 2), 16);
        const b1 = parseInt(hex1.substr(4, 2), 16);
        
        const r2 = parseInt(hex2.substr(0, 2), 16);
        const g2 = parseInt(hex2.substr(2, 2), 16);
        const b2 = parseInt(hex2.substr(4, 2), 16);
        
        // Interpolate RGB values
        const r = Math.round(r1 + (r2 - r1) * progress);
        const g = Math.round(g1 + (g2 - g1) * progress);
        const b = Math.round(b1 + (b2 - b1) * progress);
        
        // Convert back to hex
        return `#${r.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${g.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    }

    darkenColor(color, percent) {
        const num = parseInt(color.replace("#", ""), 16);
        const amt = Math.round(2.55 * percent);
        const R = (num >> 16) - amt;
        const G = (num >> 8 & 0x00FF) - amt;
        const B = (num & 0x0000FF) - amt;
        return "#" + (0x1000000 + (R < 255 ? R < 1 ? 0 : R : 255) * 0x10000 +
            (G < 255 ? G < 1 ? 0 : G : 255) * 0x100 +
            (B < 255 ? B < 1 ? 0 : B : 255)).toString(16).slice(1);
    }
}

// Main Game class
class Game {
    constructor(canvas) {
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.balls = []; // Array to hold multiple balls
        this.maxBalls = 3; // Maximum balls per life
        this.currentBalls = 3; // Current number of balls
        this.paddle = new Paddle(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 30);
        this.bricks = [];
        this.keys = {};
        this.animationId = null;
        
        console.log('Game initialized with state:', this.state);
        this.setupEventListeners();
        this.generateBricks();
        this.initializeBalls();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
    }

    setupEventListeners() {
        // Keyboard events
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
            
            if (e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
                    this.startGame();
                } else {
                    this.togglePause();
                }
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
        });

        // Button events
        document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.startGame());
        document.getElementById('pauseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.togglePause());
        document.getElementById('resetBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.resetGame());
    }

    generateBricks() {
        this.bricks = [];
        
        // Number of bricks: 2x + 3 breakable blocks + 2 unbreakable blocks
        const breakableBricks = 2 * this.level + 3;
        const unbreakableBricks = 2;
        const numBricks = breakableBricks + unbreakableBricks;
        
        // Define possible brick types with weights based on level difficulty
        const maxDifficulty = Math.min(2 * this.level + 1, 10); // Cap at 10
        
        const brickTypes = [];
        
        // Always include basic types
        brickTypes.push({ type: 'NORMAL', weight: 3 });
        brickTypes.push({ type: 'MOVING', weight: 2 });
        
        // Add stronger types based on level
        if (maxDifficulty >= 2) {
            brickTypes.push({ type: 'STRONG', weight: 2 });
            brickTypes.push({ type: 'MOVING_STRONG', weight: 1 });
        }
        
        if (maxDifficulty >= 3) {
            brickTypes.push({ type: 'VERY_STRONG', weight: 1 });
        }
        
        if (maxDifficulty >= 4) {
            brickTypes.push({ type: 'UNBREAKABLE', weight: 1 });
        }
        
        // For higher levels, add more variety
        if (this.level >= 3) {
            brickTypes.push({ type: 'STRONG', weight: 1 }); // Extra strong blocks
        }
        
        if (this.level >= 5) {
            brickTypes.push({ type: 'VERY_STRONG', weight: 1 }); // Extra very strong blocks
        }
        
        // Create weighted array for random selection
        const weightedTypes = [];
        brickTypes.forEach(brickType => {
            for (let i = 0; i < brickType.weight; i++) {
                weightedTypes.push(brickType.type);
            }
        });
        
        // Generate random positions
        const positions = [];
        const minX = 50;
        const maxX = CANVAS_WIDTH - BRICK_WIDTH - 50;
        const minY = BRICK_OFFSET_TOP;
        const maxY = CANVAS_HEIGHT / 2; // Keep bricks in upper half
        
        for (let i = 0; i < numBricks; i++) {
            let attempts = 0;
            let validPosition = false;
            let x, y;
            
            // Try to find a valid position (not overlapping with existing bricks)
            while (!validPosition && attempts < 50) {
                x = minX + Math.random() * (maxX - minX);
                y = minY + Math.random() * (maxY - minY);
                
                validPosition = true;
                
                // Check for overlap with existing bricks
                for (let pos of positions) {
                    const distance = Math.sqrt((x - pos.x) ** 2 + (y - pos.y) ** 2);
                    if (distance < BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING) {
                        validPosition = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                
                attempts++;
            }
            
            // If we couldn't find a valid position, use a fallback grid position
            if (!validPosition) {
                const col = i % BRICK_COLS;
                const row = Math.floor(i / BRICK_COLS);
                x = minX + col * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING);
                y = minY + row * (BRICK_HEIGHT + BRICK_PADDING);
            }
            
            positions.push({ x, y });
            
            // Determine brick type: first 2 are unbreakable, rest are random breakable
            let randomType;
            if (i < unbreakableBricks) {
                randomType = 'UNBREAKABLE';
            } else {
                randomType = weightedTypes[Math.floor(Math.random() * weightedTypes.length)];
            }
            
            this.bricks.push(new Brick(x, y, randomType));
        }
    }

    initializeBalls() {
        this.balls = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < this.maxBalls; i++) {
            this.balls.push(new Ball(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50));
        }
    }

    getRandomBallDirection() {
        const directions = [
            { dx: 6, dy: -8 },
            { dx: -6, dy: -8 },
            { dx: 8, dy: -6 },
            { dx: -8, dy: -6 },
            { dx: 0, dy: -10 }
        ];
        return directions[Math.floor(Math.random() * directions.length)];
    }

    launchBall(ball) {
        const direction = this.getRandomBallDirection();
        ball.dx = direction.dx;
        ball.dy = direction.dy;
    }

    startGame() {
        console.log('startGame called, current state:', this.state);
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            console.log('Game started, new state:', this.state);
            this.hideOverlay();
            // Launch the first ball
            if (this.balls.length > 0) {
                this.launchBall(this.balls[0]);
            }
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    togglePause() {
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PAUSED;
            this.showOverlay('Game Paused', 'Press SPACE to resume');
        } else if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PAUSED) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    resetGame() {
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.currentBalls = 3;
        this.initializeBalls();
        this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
        this.generateBricks();
        this.updateUI();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
        
        if (this.animationId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(this.animationId);
        }
    }

    update() {
        if (this.state !== GAME_STATES.PLAYING) return;

        // Handle paddle movement
        if (this.keys['arrowleft'] || this.keys['a']) {
            this.paddle.moveLeft();
        } else if (this.keys['arrowright'] || this.keys['d']) {
            this.paddle.moveRight();
        } else {
            this.paddle.stop();
        }

        // Update game objects
        this.paddle.update();
        this.balls.forEach(ball => ball.update());
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.update(this.bricks, 16)); // 16ms deltaTime for 60fps

        // Ball collision with walls
        this.balls.forEach(ball => {
            if (ball.x - ball.radius <= 0 || ball.x + ball.radius >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
                ball.reverseX();
            }
            if (ball.y - ball.radius <= 0) {
                ball.reverseY();
            }
        });

        // Ball collision with paddle
        this.balls.forEach(ball => {
            if (ball.y + ball.radius >= this.paddle.y &&
                ball.x >= this.paddle.x &&
                ball.x <= this.paddle.x + this.paddle.width &&
                ball.dy > 0) {
                ball.reverseY();
                
                // Add some spin based on where ball hits paddle
                const hitPos = (ball.x - this.paddle.x) / this.paddle.width;
                ball.dx = (hitPos - 0.5) * 8;
            }
        });

        // Ball collision with bricks
        this.balls.forEach(ball => {
            this.bricks.forEach(brick => {
                if (!brick.destroyed &&
                    ball.x + ball.radius >= brick.x &&
                    ball.x - ball.radius <= brick.x + brick.width &&
                    ball.y + ball.radius >= brick.y &&
                    ball.y - ball.radius <= brick.y + brick.height) {
                    
                    const points = brick.hit();
                    this.score += points;
                    
                    // Calculate collision side more accurately
                    const ballLeft = ball.x - ball.radius;
                    const ballRight = ball.x + ball.radius;
                    const ballTop = ball.y - ball.radius;
                    const ballBottom = ball.y + ball.radius;
                    
                    const brickLeft = brick.x;
                    const brickRight = brick.x + brick.width;
                    const brickTop = brick.y;
                    const brickBottom = brick.y + brick.height;
                    
                    // Calculate overlap distances
                    const overlapLeft = ballRight - brickLeft;
                    const overlapRight = brickRight - ballLeft;
                    const overlapTop = ballBottom - brickTop;
                    const overlapBottom = brickBottom - ballTop;
                    
                    // Find the smallest overlap to determine collision side
                    const minOverlap = Math.min(overlapLeft, overlapRight, overlapTop, overlapBottom);
                    
                    if (minOverlap === overlapLeft || minOverlap === overlapRight) {
                        // Horizontal collision (left or right side)
                        ball.reverseX();
                    } else {
                        // Vertical collision (top or bottom side)
                        ball.reverseY();
                    }
                }
            });
        });

        // Check if balls fell below paddle
        this.balls = this.balls.filter(ball => {
            if (ball.y > CANVAS_HEIGHT) {
                this.currentBalls--;
                return false; // Remove this ball
            }
            return true; // Keep this ball
        });

        // If no balls left, lose a life and get new balls
        if (this.balls.length === 0) {
            this.lives--;
            if (this.lives <= 0) {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER;
                this.showOverlay('Game Over!', `Final Score: ${this.score}`);
            } else {
                // Reset balls and paddle position
                this.currentBalls = this.maxBalls;
                this.initializeBalls();
                this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
                // Launch the first ball
                if (this.balls.length > 0) {
                    this.launchBall(this.balls[0]);
                }
            }
        }

        // Check level completion
        const remainingBricks = this.bricks.filter(brick => !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'UNBREAKABLE');
        if (remainingBricks.length === 0) {
            this.level++;
            this.lives += 3; // Add 3 lives for completing a level
            this.currentBalls = this.maxBalls; // Reset balls
            this.generateBricks();
            this.initializeBalls();
            this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            this.state = GAME_STATES.LEVEL_COMPLETE;
            this.showOverlay(`Level ${this.level - 1} Complete!`, `Score: ${this.score} - +3 Lives!`);
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
                this.hideOverlay();
                // Launch the first ball
                if (this.balls.length > 0) {
                    this.launchBall(this.balls[0]);
                }
                this.gameLoop();
            }, 2000);
        }

        this.updateUI();
    }

    draw() {
        // Clear canvas
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

        // Draw game objects
        this.paddle.draw(this.ctx);
        this.balls.forEach(ball => ball.draw(this.ctx));
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.draw(this.ctx));

        // Draw particles for destroyed bricks (simple effect)
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        this.ctx.font = '16px Arial';
        this.ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        this.ctx.fillText(`Level ${this.level}`, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 30);
    }

    gameLoop() {
        this.update();
        this.draw();
        
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.gameLoop());
        }
    }

    updateUI() {
        document.getElementById('score').textContent = this.score;
        document.getElementById('level').textContent = this.level;
        
        // Update lives with heart emojis
        const livesElement = document.getElementById('lives');
        let heartsDisplay = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            if (i < this.lives) {
                heartsDisplay += '❤️'; // Red heart for remaining lives
            } else {
                heartsDisplay += '🖤'; // Black heart for lost lives
            }
        }
        livesElement.textContent = heartsDisplay;
    }

    showOverlay(title, message) {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        const titleEl = document.getElementById('overlayTitle');
        const messageEl = document.getElementById('overlayMessage');
        
        titleEl.textContent = title;
        messageEl.textContent = message;
        overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    hideOverlay() {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        overlay.classList.add('hidden');
    }
}

// React component for the game
const BrickBreakerGame = () => {
    const canvasRef = useRef(null);
    const gameRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (canvasRef.current && !gameRef.current) {
            gameRef.current = new Game(canvasRef.current);
        }

    return (

                <button id="startBtn">Start Game</button>
                <button id="pauseBtn">Pause</button>
                <button id="resetBtn">Reset</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};
```

```typescriptreact
const { useState, useEffect, useRef } = React;

// Game constants
const CANVAS_WIDTH = 800;
const CANVAS_HEIGHT = 600;
const PADDLE_WIDTH = 100;
const PADDLE_HEIGHT = 15;
const BALL_RADIUS = 5;
const BRICK_WIDTH = 80;
const BRICK_HEIGHT = 30;
const BRICK_ROWS = 3;
const BRICK_COLS = 4;
const BRICK_PADDING = 15;
const BRICK_OFFSET_TOP = 50;
const BRICK_OFFSET_LEFT = 50;

// Brick types
const BRICK_TYPES = {
    NORMAL: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 10 }, // Sky blue - 1 health
    STRONG: { hits: 3, color: '#4169E1', points: 30 }, // Royal blue - 3 health
    VERY_STRONG: { hits: 5, color: '#32CD32', points: 50 }, // Lime green - 5 health
    MOVING: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 15, moving: true }, // Sky blue - 1 health
    MOVING_STRONG: { hits: 2, color: '#1E90FF', points: 25, moving: true }, // Dodger blue - 2 health
    UNBREAKABLE: { hits: -1, color: '#808080', points: 0 } // Grey unbreakable
};

// Color progression based on health (red = high health, blue = low health)
const COLOR_PROGRESSION = [
    '#87CEEB', // Sky blue - 1 health left
    '#1E90FF', // Dodger blue - 2 health left
    '#00CED1', // Dark turquoise - 4 health left
    '#4169E1', // Royal blue - 3 health left
    '#32CD32', // Lime green - 5 health left
    '#ADFF2F', // Green-yellow - 6 health left
    '#FFD700', // Gold/Yellow - 7 health left
    '#FFB347', // Orange - 8 health left
    '#FF8E53', // Red-orange - 9 health left
    '#FF6B6B'  // Red - 10 health left
];

// Game states
const GAME_STATES = {
    MENU: 'menu',
    PLAYING: 'playing',
    PAUSED: 'paused',
    GAME_OVER: 'gameOver',
    LEVEL_COMPLETE: 'levelComplete'
};

// Ball class
class Ball {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.radius = BALL_RADIUS;
        this.dx = 6;
        this.dy = -8;
        this.speed = 10;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        this.y += this.dy;
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ccc';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    reset(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
    }

    reverseX() {
        this.dx = -this.dx;
    }

    reverseY() {
        this.dy = -this.dy;
    }
}

// Paddle class
class Paddle {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = PADDLE_WIDTH;
        this.height = PADDLE_HEIGHT;
        this.speed = 10;
        this.dx = 0;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        
        // Keep paddle within canvas bounds
        if (this.x < 0) {
            this.x = 0;
        } else if (this.x + this.width > CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.x = CANVAS_WIDTH - this.width;
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Add gradient effect
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, '#ff6b6b');
        gradient.addColorStop(1, '#ee5a24');
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
    }

    moveLeft() {
        this.dx = -this.speed;
    }

    moveRight() {
        this.dx = this.speed;
    }

    stop() {
        this.dx = 0;
    }
}

// Brick class
class Brick {
    constructor(x, y, type = 'NORMAL') {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = BRICK_WIDTH;
        this.height = BRICK_HEIGHT;
        this.type = type;
        this.hits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.maxHits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.initialColor = BRICK_TYPES[type].color;
        this.color = this.initialColor;
        this.targetColor = this.initialColor;
        this.points = BRICK_TYPES[type].points;
        this.moving = BRICK_TYPES[type].moving || false;
        this.dx = this.moving ? 2 : 0;
        this.destroyed = false;
        this.originalX = x; // Store original position for moving bricks
        this.colorTransitionTime = 0;
        this.colorTransitionDuration = 300; // 300ms transition
    }

    update(allBricks, deltaTime = 16) {
        // Handle color transition animation (only if brick is not destroyed)
        if (this.colorTransitionTime > 0 && !this.destroyed) {
            this.colorTransitionTime -= deltaTime;
            const progress = 1 - (this.colorTransitionTime / this.colorTransitionDuration);
            this.color = this.interpolateColor(this.color, this.targetColor, progress);
        }

        if (this.moving && !this.destroyed) {
            const oldX = this.x;
            this.x += this.dx;
            
            // Check for collision with other bricks
            let collision = false;
            for (let brick of allBricks) {
                if (brick !== this && !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'MOVING') {
                    if (this.x < brick.x + brick.width &&
                        this.x + this.width > brick.x &&
                        this.y < brick.y + brick.height &&
                        this.y + this.height > brick.y) {
                        collision = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // If collision detected, revert position and reverse direction
            if (collision) {
                this.x = oldX;
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
            
            // Reverse direction at edges
            if (this.x <= 0 || this.x + this.width >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        if (this.destroyed) return;

        // Draw brick with gradient
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, this.color);
        gradient.addColorStop(1, this.darkenColor(this.color, 20));
        
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw border
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // No hit numbers displayed - color progression shows damage level
    }

    hit() {
        if (this.destroyed) return 0;
        
        if (this.hits === -1) return 0; // Unbreakable brick
        
        this.hits--;
        
        // Update color based on remaining health with smooth transition
        if (this.maxHits > 1) {
            // Color index is based on remaining health (hits), not damage taken
            const colorIndex = Math.min(this.hits - 1, COLOR_PROGRESSION.length - 1);
            this.targetColor = COLOR_PROGRESSION[colorIndex];
            this.colorTransitionTime = this.colorTransitionDuration;
        }
        
        if (this.hits <= 0) {
            this.destroyed = true;
            return this.points;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    interpolateColor(color1, color2, progress) {
        // Check if colors are valid
        if (!color1 || !color2 || typeof color1 !== 'string' || typeof color2 !== 'string') {
            return color1 || color2 || '#87CEEB'; // Return first valid color or default
        }
        
        // Convert hex colors to RGB
        const hex1 = color1.replace('#', '');
        const hex2 = color2.replace('#', '');
        
        const r1 = parseInt(hex1.substr(0, 2), 16);
        const g1 = parseInt(hex1.substr(2, 2), 16);
        const b1 = parseInt(hex1.substr(4, 2), 16);
        
        const r2 = parseInt(hex2.substr(0, 2), 16);
        const g2 = parseInt(hex2.substr(2, 2), 16);
        const b2 = parseInt(hex2.substr(4, 2), 16);
        
        // Interpolate RGB values
        const r = Math.round(r1 + (r2 - r1) * progress);
        const g = Math.round(g1 + (g2 - g1) * progress);
        const b = Math.round(b1 + (b2 - b1) * progress);
        
        // Convert back to hex
        return `#${r.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${g.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    }

    darkenColor(color, percent) {
        const num = parseInt(color.replace("#", ""), 16);
        const amt = Math.round(2.55 * percent);
        const R = (num >> 16) - amt;
        const G = (num >> 8 & 0x00FF) - amt;
        const B = (num & 0x0000FF) - amt;
        return "#" + (0x1000000 + (R < 255 ? R < 1 ? 0 : R : 255) * 0x10000 +
            (G < 255 ? G < 1 ? 0 : G : 255) * 0x100 +
            (B < 255 ? B < 1 ? 0 : B : 255)).toString(16).slice(1);
    }
}

// Main Game class
class Game {
    constructor(canvas) {
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.balls = []; // Array to hold multiple balls
        this.maxBalls = 3; // Maximum balls per life
        this.currentBalls = 3; // Current number of balls
        this.paddle = new Paddle(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 30);
        this.bricks = [];
        this.keys = {};
        this.animationId = null;
        
        console.log('Game initialized with state:', this.state);
        this.setupEventListeners();
        this.generateBricks();
        this.initializeBalls();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
    }

    setupEventListeners() {
        // Keyboard events
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
            
            if (e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
                    this.startGame();
                } else {
                    this.togglePause();
                }
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
        });

        // Button events
        document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.startGame());
        document.getElementById('pauseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.togglePause());
        document.getElementById('resetBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.resetGame());
    }

    generateBricks() {
        this.bricks = [];
        
        // Number of bricks: 2x + 3 breakable blocks + 2 unbreakable blocks
        const breakableBricks = 2 * this.level + 3;
        const unbreakableBricks = 2;
        const numBricks = breakableBricks + unbreakableBricks;
        
        // Define possible brick types with weights based on level difficulty
        const maxDifficulty = Math.min(2 * this.level + 1, 10); // Cap at 10
        
        const brickTypes = [];
        
        // Always include basic types
        brickTypes.push({ type: 'NORMAL', weight: 3 });
        brickTypes.push({ type: 'MOVING', weight: 2 });
        
        // Add stronger types based on level
        if (maxDifficulty >= 2) {
            brickTypes.push({ type: 'STRONG', weight: 2 });
            brickTypes.push({ type: 'MOVING_STRONG', weight: 1 });
        }
        
        if (maxDifficulty >= 3) {
            brickTypes.push({ type: 'VERY_STRONG', weight: 1 });
        }
        
        if (maxDifficulty >= 4) {
            brickTypes.push({ type: 'UNBREAKABLE', weight: 1 });
        }
        
        // For higher levels, add more variety
        if (this.level >= 3) {
            brickTypes.push({ type: 'STRONG', weight: 1 }); // Extra strong blocks
        }
        
        if (this.level >= 5) {
            brickTypes.push({ type: 'VERY_STRONG', weight: 1 }); // Extra very strong blocks
        }
        
        // Create weighted array for random selection
        const weightedTypes = [];
        brickTypes.forEach(brickType => {
            for (let i = 0; i < brickType.weight; i++) {
                weightedTypes.push(brickType.type);
            }
        });
        
        // Generate random positions
        const positions = [];
        const minX = 50;
        const maxX = CANVAS_WIDTH - BRICK_WIDTH - 50;
        const minY = BRICK_OFFSET_TOP;
        const maxY = CANVAS_HEIGHT / 2; // Keep bricks in upper half
        
        for (let i = 0; i < numBricks; i++) {
            let attempts = 0;
            let validPosition = false;
            let x, y;
            
            // Try to find a valid position (not overlapping with existing bricks)
            while (!validPosition && attempts < 50) {
                x = minX + Math.random() * (maxX - minX);
                y = minY + Math.random() * (maxY - minY);
                
                validPosition = true;
                
                // Check for overlap with existing bricks
                for (let pos of positions) {
                    const distance = Math.sqrt((x - pos.x) ** 2 + (y - pos.y) ** 2);
                    if (distance < BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING) {
                        validPosition = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                
                attempts++;
            }
            
            // If we couldn't find a valid position, use a fallback grid position
            if (!validPosition) {
                const col = i % BRICK_COLS;
                const row = Math.floor(i / BRICK_COLS);
                x = minX + col * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING);
                y = minY + row * (BRICK_HEIGHT + BRICK_PADDING);
            }
            
            positions.push({ x, y });
            
            // Determine brick type: first 2 are unbreakable, rest are random breakable
            let randomType;
            if (i < unbreakableBricks) {
                randomType = 'UNBREAKABLE';
            } else {
                randomType = weightedTypes[Math.floor(Math.random() * weightedTypes.length)];
            }
            
            this.bricks.push(new Brick(x, y, randomType));
        }
    }

    initializeBalls() {
        this.balls = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < this.maxBalls; i++) {
            this.balls.push(new Ball(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50));
        }
    }

    getRandomBallDirection() {
        const directions = [
            { dx: 6, dy: -8 },
            { dx: -6, dy: -8 },
            { dx: 8, dy: -6 },
            { dx: -8, dy: -6 },
            { dx: 0, dy: -10 }
        ];
        return directions[Math.floor(Math.random() * directions.length)];
    }

    launchBall(ball) {
        const direction = this.getRandomBallDirection();
        ball.dx = direction.dx;
        ball.dy = direction.dy;
    }

    startGame() {
        console.log('startGame called, current state:', this.state);
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            console.log('Game started, new state:', this.state);
            this.hideOverlay();
            // Launch the first ball
            if (this.balls.length > 0) {
                this.launchBall(this.balls[0]);
            }
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    togglePause() {
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PAUSED;
            this.showOverlay('Game Paused', 'Press SPACE to resume');
        } else if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PAUSED) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    resetGame() {
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.currentBalls = 3;
        this.initializeBalls();
        this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
        this.generateBricks();
        this.updateUI();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
        
        if (this.animationId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(this.animationId);
        }
    }

    update() {
        if (this.state !== GAME_STATES.PLAYING) return;

        // Handle paddle movement
        if (this.keys['arrowleft'] || this.keys['a']) {
            this.paddle.moveLeft();
        } else if (this.keys['arrowright'] || this.keys['d']) {
            this.paddle.moveRight();
        } else {
            this.paddle.stop();
        }

        // Update game objects
        this.paddle.update();
        this.balls.forEach(ball => ball.update());
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.update(this.bricks, 16)); // 16ms deltaTime for 60fps

        // Ball collision with walls
        this.balls.forEach(ball => {
            if (ball.x - ball.radius <= 0 || ball.x + ball.radius >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
                ball.reverseX();
            }
            if (ball.y - ball.radius <= 0) {
                ball.reverseY();
            }
        });

        // Ball collision with paddle
        this.balls.forEach(ball => {
            if (ball.y + ball.radius >= this.paddle.y &&
                ball.x >= this.paddle.x &&
                ball.x <= this.paddle.x + this.paddle.width &&
                ball.dy > 0) {
                ball.reverseY();
                
                // Add some spin based on where ball hits paddle
                const hitPos = (ball.x - this.paddle.x) / this.paddle.width;
                ball.dx = (hitPos - 0.5) * 8;
            }
        });

        // Ball collision with bricks
        this.balls.forEach(ball => {
            this.bricks.forEach(brick => {
                if (!brick.destroyed &&
                    ball.x + ball.radius >= brick.x &&
                    ball.x - ball.radius <= brick.x + brick.width &&
                    ball.y + ball.radius >= brick.y &&
                    ball.y - ball.radius <= brick.y + brick.height) {
                    
                    const points = brick.hit();
                    this.score += points;
                    
                    // Calculate collision side more accurately
                    const ballLeft = ball.x - ball.radius;
                    const ballRight = ball.x + ball.radius;
                    const ballTop = ball.y - ball.radius;
                    const ballBottom = ball.y + ball.radius;
                    
                    const brickLeft = brick.x;
                    const brickRight = brick.x + brick.width;
                    const brickTop = brick.y;
                    const brickBottom = brick.y + brick.height;
                    
                    // Calculate overlap distances
                    const overlapLeft = ballRight - brickLeft;
                    const overlapRight = brickRight - ballLeft;
                    const overlapTop = ballBottom - brickTop;
                    const overlapBottom = brickBottom - ballTop;
                    
                    // Find the smallest overlap to determine collision side
                    const minOverlap = Math.min(overlapLeft, overlapRight, overlapTop, overlapBottom);
                    
                    if (minOverlap === overlapLeft || minOverlap === overlapRight) {
                        // Horizontal collision (left or right side)
                        ball.reverseX();
                    } else {
                        // Vertical collision (top or bottom side)
                        ball.reverseY();
                    }
                }
            });
        });

        // Check if balls fell below paddle
        this.balls = this.balls.filter(ball => {
            if (ball.y > CANVAS_HEIGHT) {
                this.currentBalls--;
                return false; // Remove this ball
            }
            return true; // Keep this ball
        });

        // If no balls left, lose a life and get new balls
        if (this.balls.length === 0) {
            this.lives--;
            if (this.lives <= 0) {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER;
                this.showOverlay('Game Over!', `Final Score: ${this.score}`);
            } else {
                // Reset balls and paddle position
                this.currentBalls = this.maxBalls;
                this.initializeBalls();
                this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
                // Launch the first ball
                if (this.balls.length > 0) {
                    this.launchBall(this.balls[0]);
                }
            }
        }

        // Check level completion
        const remainingBricks = this.bricks.filter(brick => !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'UNBREAKABLE');
        if (remainingBricks.length === 0) {
            this.level++;
            this.lives += 3; // Add 3 lives for completing a level
            this.currentBalls = this.maxBalls; // Reset balls
            this.generateBricks();
            this.initializeBalls();
            this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            this.state = GAME_STATES.LEVEL_COMPLETE;
            this.showOverlay(`Level ${this.level - 1} Complete!`, `Score: ${this.score} - +3 Lives!`);
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
                this.hideOverlay();
                // Launch the first ball
                if (this.balls.length > 0) {
                    this.launchBall(this.balls[0]);
                }
                this.gameLoop();
            }, 2000);
        }

        this.updateUI();
    }

    draw() {
        // Clear canvas
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

        // Draw game objects
        this.paddle.draw(this.ctx);
        this.balls.forEach(ball => ball.draw(this.ctx));
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.draw(this.ctx));

        // Draw particles for destroyed bricks (simple effect)
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        this.ctx.font = '16px Arial';
        this.ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        this.ctx.fillText(`Level ${this.level}`, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 30);
    }

    gameLoop() {
        this.update();
        this.draw();
        
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.gameLoop());
        }
    }

    updateUI() {
        document.getElementById('score').textContent = this.score;
        document.getElementById('level').textContent = this.level;
        
        // Update lives with heart emojis
        const livesElement = document.getElementById('lives');
        let heartsDisplay = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            if (i < this.lives) {
                heartsDisplay += '❤️'; // Red heart for remaining lives
            } else {
                heartsDisplay += '🖤'; // Black heart for lost lives
            }
        }
        livesElement.textContent = heartsDisplay;
        
        // Update balls count
        document.getElementById('balls').textContent = this.currentBalls;
    }

    showOverlay(title, message) {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        const titleEl = document.getElementById('overlayTitle');
        const messageEl = document.getElementById('overlayMessage');
        
        titleEl.textContent = title;
        messageEl.textContent = message;
        overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    hideOverlay() {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        overlay.classList.add('hidden');
    }
}

// React component for the game
const BrickBreakerGame = () => {
    const canvasRef = useRef(null);
    const gameRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {

};

ReactDOM.render(<BrickBreakerGame />, document.getElementById('root'));
```

```typescriptreact
const { useState, useEffect, useRef } = React;

// Game constants
const CANVAS_WIDTH = 800;
const CANVAS_HEIGHT = 600;
const PADDLE_WIDTH = 100;
const PADDLE_HEIGHT = 15;
const BALL_RADIUS = 5;
const BRICK_WIDTH = 80;
const BRICK_HEIGHT = 30;
const BRICK_ROWS = 3;
const BRICK_COLS = 4;
const BRICK_PADDING = 15;
const BRICK_OFFSET_TOP = 50;
const BRICK_OFFSET_LEFT = 50;

// Brick types
const BRICK_TYPES = {
    NORMAL: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 10 }, // Sky blue - 1 health
    STRONG: { hits: 3, color: '#4169E1', points: 30 }, // Royal blue - 3 health
    VERY_STRONG: { hits: 5, color: '#32CD32', points: 50 }, // Lime green - 5 health
    MOVING: { hits: 1, color: '#87CEEB', points: 15, moving: true }, // Sky blue - 1 health
    MOVING_STRONG: { hits: 2, color: '#1E90FF', points: 25, moving: true }, // Dodger blue - 2 health
    UNBREAKABLE: { hits: -1, color: '#808080', points: 0 } // Grey unbreakable
};

// Color progression based on health (red = high health, blue = low health)
const COLOR_PROGRESSION = [
    '#87CEEB', // Sky blue - 1 health left
    '#1E90FF', // Dodger blue - 2 health left
    '#00CED1', // Dark turquoise - 4 health left
    '#4169E1', // Royal blue - 3 health left
    '#32CD32', // Lime green - 5 health left
    '#ADFF2F', // Green-yellow - 6 health left
    '#FFD700', // Gold/Yellow - 7 health left
    '#FFB347', // Orange - 8 health left
    '#FF8E53', // Red-orange - 9 health left
    '#FF6B6B'  // Red - 10 health left
];

// Game states
const GAME_STATES = {
    MENU: 'menu',
    PLAYING: 'playing',
    PAUSED: 'paused',
    GAME_OVER: 'gameOver',
    LEVEL_COMPLETE: 'levelComplete'
};

// Ball class
class Ball {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.radius = BALL_RADIUS;
        this.dx = 6;
        this.dy = -8;
        this.speed = 10;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        this.y += this.dy;
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ccc';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    reset(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.dx = 4;
        this.dy = -4;
    }

    reverseX() {
        this.dx = -this.dx;
    }

    reverseY() {
        this.dy = -this.dy;
    }
}

// Paddle class
class Paddle {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = PADDLE_WIDTH;
        this.height = PADDLE_HEIGHT;
        this.speed = 10;
        this.dx = 0;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.dx;
        
        // Keep paddle within canvas bounds
        if (this.x < 0) {
            this.x = 0;
        } else if (this.x + this.width > CANVAS_WIDTH) {
            this.x = CANVAS_WIDTH - this.width;
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Add gradient effect
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, '#ff6b6b');
        gradient.addColorStop(1, '#ee5a24');
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
    }

    moveLeft() {
        this.dx = -this.speed;
    }

    moveRight() {
        this.dx = this.speed;
    }

    stop() {
        this.dx = 0;
    }
}

// Brick class
class Brick {
    constructor(x, y, type = 'NORMAL') {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = BRICK_WIDTH;
        this.height = BRICK_HEIGHT;
        this.type = type;
        this.hits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.maxHits = BRICK_TYPES[type].hits;
        this.initialColor = BRICK_TYPES[type].color;
        this.color = this.initialColor;
        this.targetColor = this.initialColor;
        this.points = BRICK_TYPES[type].points;
        this.moving = BRICK_TYPES[type].moving || false;
        this.dx = this.moving ? 2 : 0;
        this.destroyed = false;
        this.originalX = x; // Store original position for moving bricks
        this.colorTransitionTime = 0;
        this.colorTransitionDuration = 300; // 300ms transition
    }

    update(allBricks, deltaTime = 16) {
        // Handle color transition animation (only if brick is not destroyed)
        if (this.colorTransitionTime > 0 && !this.destroyed) {
            this.colorTransitionTime -= deltaTime;
            const progress = 1 - (this.colorTransitionTime / this.colorTransitionDuration);
            this.color = this.interpolateColor(this.color, this.targetColor, progress);
        }

        if (this.moving && !this.destroyed) {
            const oldX = this.x;
            this.x += this.dx;
            
            // Check for collision with other bricks
            let collision = false;
            for (let brick of allBricks) {
                if (brick !== this && !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'MOVING') {
                    if (this.x < brick.x + brick.width &&
                        this.x + this.width > brick.x &&
                        this.y < brick.y + brick.height &&
                        this.y + this.height > brick.y) {
                        collision = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // If collision detected, revert position and reverse direction
            if (collision) {
                this.x = oldX;
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
            
            // Reverse direction at edges
            if (this.x <= 0 || this.x + this.width >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
                this.dx = -this.dx;
            }
        }
    }

    draw(ctx) {
        if (this.destroyed) return;

        // Draw brick with gradient
        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, this.color);
        gradient.addColorStop(1, this.darkenColor(this.color, 20));
        
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // Draw border
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        
        // No hit numbers displayed - color progression shows damage level
    }

    hit() {
        if (this.destroyed) return 0;
        
        if (this.hits === -1) return 0; // Unbreakable brick
        
        this.hits--;
        
        // Update color based on remaining health with smooth transition
        if (this.maxHits > 1) {
            // Color index is based on remaining health (hits), not damage taken
            const colorIndex = Math.min(this.hits - 1, COLOR_PROGRESSION.length - 1);
            this.targetColor = COLOR_PROGRESSION[colorIndex];
            this.colorTransitionTime = this.colorTransitionDuration;
        }
        
        if (this.hits <= 0) {
            this.destroyed = true;
            return this.points;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    interpolateColor(color1, color2, progress) {
        // Check if colors are valid
        if (!color1 || !color2 || typeof color1 !== 'string' || typeof color2 !== 'string') {
            return color1 || color2 || '#87CEEB'; // Return first valid color or default
        }
        
        // Convert hex colors to RGB
        const hex1 = color1.replace('#', '');
        const hex2 = color2.replace('#', '');
        
        const r1 = parseInt(hex1.substr(0, 2), 16);
        const g1 = parseInt(hex1.substr(2, 2), 16);
        const b1 = parseInt(hex1.substr(4, 2), 16);
        
        const r2 = parseInt(hex2.substr(0, 2), 16);
        const g2 = parseInt(hex2.substr(2, 2), 16);
        const b2 = parseInt(hex2.substr(4, 2), 16);
        
        // Interpolate RGB values
        const r = Math.round(r1 + (r2 - r1) * progress);
        const g = Math.round(g1 + (g2 - g1) * progress);
        const b = Math.round(b1 + (b2 - b1) * progress);
        
        // Convert back to hex
        return `#${r.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${g.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    }

    darkenColor(color, percent) {
        const num = parseInt(color.replace("#", ""), 16);
        const amt = Math.round(2.55 * percent);
        const R = (num >> 16) - amt;
        const G = (num >> 8 & 0x00FF) - amt;
        const B = (num & 0x0000FF) - amt;
        return "#" + (0x1000000 + (R < 255 ? R < 1 ? 0 : R : 255) * 0x10000 +
            (G < 255 ? G < 1 ? 0 : G : 255) * 0x100 +
            (B < 255 ? B < 1 ? 0 : B : 255)).toString(16).slice(1);
    }
}

// Main Game class
class Game {
    constructor(canvas) {
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.balls = []; // Array to hold multiple balls
        this.maxBalls = 3; // Maximum balls per life
        this.currentBalls = 3; // Current number of balls
        this.paddle = new Paddle(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 30);
        this.bricks = [];
        this.keys = {};
        this.animationId = null;
        
        console.log('Game initialized with state:', this.state);
        this.setupEventListeners();
        this.generateBricks();
        this.initializeBalls();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
    }

    setupEventListeners() {
        // Keyboard events
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
            
            if (e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
                    this.startGame();
                } else {
                    this.togglePause();
                }
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
            this.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
        });

        // Button events
        document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.startGame());
        document.getElementById('pauseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.togglePause());
        document.getElementById('resetBtn').addEventListener('click', () => this.resetGame());
    }

    generateBricks() {
        this.bricks = [];
        
        // Number of bricks: 2x + 3 breakable blocks + 2 unbreakable blocks
        const breakableBricks = 2 * this.level + 3;
        const unbreakableBricks = 2;
        const numBricks = breakableBricks + unbreakableBricks;
        
        // Define possible brick types with weights based on level difficulty
        const maxDifficulty = Math.min(2 * this.level + 1, 10); // Cap at 10
        
        const brickTypes = [];
        
        // Always include basic types
        brickTypes.push({ type: 'NORMAL', weight: 3 });
        brickTypes.push({ type: 'MOVING', weight: 2 });
        
        // Add stronger types based on level
        if (maxDifficulty >= 2) {
            brickTypes.push({ type: 'STRONG', weight: 2 });
            brickTypes.push({ type: 'MOVING_STRONG', weight: 1 });
        }
        
        if (maxDifficulty >= 3) {
            brickTypes.push({ type: 'VERY_STRONG', weight: 1 });
        }
        
        if (maxDifficulty >= 4) {
            brickTypes.push({ type: 'UNBREAKABLE', weight: 1 });
        }
        
        // For higher levels, add more variety
        if (this.level >= 3) {
            brickTypes.push({ type: 'STRONG', weight: 1 }); // Extra strong blocks
        }
        
        if (this.level >= 5) {
            brickTypes.push({ type: 'VERY_STRONG', weight: 1 }); // Extra very strong blocks
        }
        
        // Create weighted array for random selection
        const weightedTypes = [];
        brickTypes.forEach(brickType => {
            for (let i = 0; i < brickType.weight; i++) {
                weightedTypes.push(brickType.type);
            }
        });
        
        // Generate random positions
        const positions = [];
        const minX = 50;
        const maxX = CANVAS_WIDTH - BRICK_WIDTH - 50;
        const minY = BRICK_OFFSET_TOP;
        const maxY = CANVAS_HEIGHT / 2; // Keep bricks in upper half
        
        for (let i = 0; i < numBricks; i++) {
            let attempts = 0;
            let validPosition = false;
            let x, y;
            
            // Try to find a valid position (not overlapping with existing bricks)
            while (!validPosition && attempts < 50) {
                x = minX + Math.random() * (maxX - minX);
                y = minY + Math.random() * (maxY - minY);
                
                validPosition = true;
                
                // Check for overlap with existing bricks
                for (let pos of positions) {
                    const distance = Math.sqrt((x - pos.x) ** 2 + (y - pos.y) ** 2);
                    if (distance < BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING) {
                        validPosition = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                
                attempts++;
            }
            
            // If we couldn't find a valid position, use a fallback grid position
            if (!validPosition) {
                const col = i % BRICK_COLS;
                const row = Math.floor(i / BRICK_COLS);
                x = minX + col * (BRICK_WIDTH + BRICK_PADDING);
                y = minY + row * (BRICK_HEIGHT + BRICK_PADDING);
            }
            
            positions.push({ x, y });
            
            // Determine brick type: first 2 are unbreakable, rest are random breakable
            let randomType;
            if (i < unbreakableBricks) {
                randomType = 'UNBREAKABLE';
            } else {
                randomType = weightedTypes[Math.floor(Math.random() * weightedTypes.length)];
            }
            
            this.bricks.push(new Brick(x, y, randomType));
        }
    }

    initializeBalls() {
        this.balls = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < this.maxBalls; i++) {
            this.balls.push(new Ball(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, CANVAS_HEIGHT - 50));
        }
    }

    getRandomBallDirection() {
        const directions = [
            { dx: 6, dy: -8 },
            { dx: -6, dy: -8 },
            { dx: 8, dy: -6 },
            { dx: -8, dy: -6 },
            { dx: 0, dy: -10 }
        ];
        return directions[Math.floor(Math.random() * directions.length)];
    }

    launchBall(ball) {
        const direction = this.getRandomBallDirection();
        ball.dx = direction.dx;
        ball.dy = direction.dy;
    }

    startGame() {
        console.log('startGame called, current state:', this.state);
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.MENU || this.state === GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            console.log('Game started, new state:', this.state);
            this.hideOverlay();
            // Launch the first ball
            if (this.balls.length > 0) {
                this.launchBall(this.balls[0]);
            }
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    togglePause() {
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PAUSED;
            this.showOverlay('Game Paused', 'Press SPACE to resume');
        } else if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PAUSED) {
            this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
            this.hideOverlay();
            this.gameLoop();
        }
    }

    resetGame() {
        this.state = GAME_STATES.MENU;
        this.score = 0;
        this.level = 1;
        this.lives = 3;
        this.currentBalls = 3;
        this.initializeBalls();
        this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
        this.generateBricks();
        this.updateUI();
        this.showOverlay('Brick Breaker', 'Press SPACE to start!');
        
        if (this.animationId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(this.animationId);
        }
    }

    update() {
        if (this.state !== GAME_STATES.PLAYING) return;

        // Handle paddle movement
        if (this.keys['arrowleft'] || this.keys['a']) {
            this.paddle.moveLeft();
        } else if (this.keys['arrowright'] || this.keys['d']) {
            this.paddle.moveRight();
        } else {
            this.paddle.stop();
        }

        // Update game objects
        this.paddle.update();
        this.balls.forEach(ball => ball.update());
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.update(this.bricks, 16)); // 16ms deltaTime for 60fps

        // Ball collision with walls
        this.balls.forEach(ball => {
            if (ball.x - ball.radius <= 0 || ball.x + ball.radius >= CANVAS_WIDTH) {
                ball.reverseX();
            }
            if (ball.y - ball.radius <= 0) {
                ball.reverseY();
            }
        });

        // Ball collision with paddle
        this.balls.forEach(ball => {
            if (ball.y + ball.radius >= this.paddle.y &&
                ball.x >= this.paddle.x &&
                ball.x <= this.paddle.x + this.paddle.width &&
                ball.dy > 0) {
                ball.reverseY();
                
                // Add some spin based on where ball hits paddle
                const hitPos = (ball.x - this.paddle.x) / this.paddle.width;
                ball.dx = (hitPos - 0.5) * 8;
            }
        });

        // Ball collision with bricks
        this.balls.forEach(ball => {
            this.bricks.forEach(brick => {
                if (!brick.destroyed &&
                    ball.x + ball.radius >= brick.x &&
                    ball.x - ball.radius <= brick.x + brick.width &&
                    ball.y + ball.radius >= brick.y &&
                    ball.y - ball.radius <= brick.y + brick.height) {
                    
                    const points = brick.hit();
                    this.score += points;
                    
                    // Calculate collision side more accurately
                    const ballLeft = ball.x - ball.radius;
                    const ballRight = ball.x + ball.radius;
                    const ballTop = ball.y - ball.radius;
                    const ballBottom = ball.y + ball.radius;
                    
                    const brickLeft = brick.x;
                    const brickRight = brick.x + brick.width;
                    const brickTop = brick.y;
                    const brickBottom = brick.y + brick.height;
                    
                    // Calculate overlap distances
                    const overlapLeft = ballRight - brickLeft;
                    const overlapRight = brickRight - ballLeft;
                    const overlapTop = ballBottom - brickTop;
                    const overlapBottom = brickBottom - ballTop;
                    
                    // Find the smallest overlap to determine collision side
                    const minOverlap = Math.min(overlapLeft, overlapRight, overlapTop, overlapBottom);
                    
                    if (minOverlap === overlapLeft || minOverlap === overlapRight) {
                        // Horizontal collision (left or right side)
                        ball.reverseX();
                    } else {
                        // Vertical collision (top or bottom side)
                        ball.reverseY();
                    }
                }
            });
        });

        // Check if balls fell below paddle
        this.balls = this.balls.filter(ball => {
            if (ball.y > CANVAS_HEIGHT) {
                this.currentBalls--;
                return false; // Remove this ball
            }
            return true; // Keep this ball
        });

        // If no balls left, lose a life and get new balls
        if (this.balls.length === 0) {
            this.lives--;
            if (this.lives <= 0) {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.GAME_OVER;
                this.showOverlay('Game Over!', `Final Score: ${this.score}`);
            } else {
                // Reset balls and paddle position
                this.currentBalls = this.maxBalls;
                this.initializeBalls();
                this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
                // Launch the first ball
                if (this.balls.length > 0) {
                    this.launchBall(this.balls[0]);
                }
            }
        }

        // Check level completion
        const remainingBricks = this.bricks.filter(brick => !brick.destroyed && brick.type !== 'UNBREAKABLE');
        if (remainingBricks.length === 0) {
            this.level++;
            this.lives += 3; // Add 3 lives for completing a level
            this.currentBalls = this.maxBalls; // Reset balls
            this.generateBricks();
            this.initializeBalls();
            this.paddle.x = CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - PADDLE_WIDTH / 2;
            this.state = GAME_STATES.LEVEL_COMPLETE;
            this.showOverlay(`Level ${this.level - 1} Complete!`, `Score: ${this.score} - +3 Lives!`);
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.state = GAME_STATES.PLAYING;
                this.hideOverlay();
                // Launch the first ball
                if (this.balls.length > 0) {
                    this.launchBall(this.balls[0]);
                }
                this.gameLoop();
            }, 2000);
        }

        this.updateUI();
    }

    draw() {
        // Clear canvas
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

        // Draw game objects
        this.paddle.draw(this.ctx);
        this.balls.forEach(ball => ball.draw(this.ctx));
        this.bricks.forEach(brick => brick.draw(this.ctx));

        // Draw particles for destroyed bricks (simple effect)
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        this.ctx.font = '16px Arial';
        this.ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        this.ctx.fillText(`Level ${this.level}`, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 30);
    }

    gameLoop() {
        this.update();
        this.draw();
        
        if (this.state === GAME_STATES.PLAYING) {
            this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.gameLoop());
        }
    }

    updateUI() {
        document.getElementById('score').textContent = this.score;
        document.getElementById('level').textContent = this.level;
        
        // Update lives with heart emojis
        const livesElement = document.getElementById('lives');
        let heartsDisplay = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            if (i < this.lives) {
                heartsDisplay += '❤️'; // Red heart for remaining lives
            } else {
                heartsDisplay += '🖤'; // Black heart for lost lives
            }
        }
        livesElement.textContent = heartsDisplay;
        
        // Update balls count
        document.getElementById('balls').textContent = this.currentBalls;
    }

    showOverlay(title, message) {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        const titleEl = document.getElementById('overlayTitle');
        const messageEl = document.getElementById('overlayMessage');
        
        titleEl.textContent = title;
        messageEl.textContent = message;
        overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    hideOverlay() {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        overlay.classList.add('hidden');
    }
}

// React component for the game
const BrickBreakerGame = () => {
    const canvasRef = useRef(null);
    const gameRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (canvasRef.current && !gameRef.current) {
            gameRef.current = new Game(canvasRef.current);
        }
    }, []);

    return (
        <div className="game-container">
            <div className="game-header">
                <h1>Brick Breaker</h1>
                        <div className="game-info">

                            <div className="balls">Balls: <span id="balls">3</span></div>
                        </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-area">
                <canvas ref={canvasRef} id="gameCanvas" width={CANVAS_WIDTH} height={CANVAS_HEIGHT}></canvas>
                <div className="game-overlay" id="gameOverlay">
                    <div className="overlay-content">
                        <h2 id="overlayTitle">Brick Breaker</h2>
                        <p id="overlayMessage">Press SPACE to start!</p>
                        <div className="controls">

                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="game-footer">
                <button id="startBtn">Start Game</button>
                <button id="pauseBtn">Pause</button>
                <button id="resetBtn">Reset</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

// Render the game
ReactDOM.render(<BrickBreakerGame />, document.getElementById('root'));
```

## ✅ **All Features Implemented**

### **1. Lives Per Level**
- **+3 Lives**: When completing a level, player gets 3 additional lives
- **Progressive Rewards**: Encourages level completion
- **Visual Feedback**: Shows "+3 Lives!" message on level completion

### **2. Multiple Balls System**
- **3 Balls Per Life**: Each life starts with 3 balls
- **Ball Management**: When all balls are lost, player loses a life and gets 3 new balls
- **Visual Counter**: UI shows current number of balls remaining
- **Smart Reset**: Paddle resets to center when getting new balls

### **3. Random Ball Directions**
When a ball is launched, it gets one of these random directions:
- `x = 6, y = -8` (right-up)
- `x = -6, y = -8` (left-up)  
- `x = 8, y = -6` (right-up)
- `x = -8, y = -6` (left-up)
- `x = 0, y = -10` (straight up)

### **4. Updated Block Formula**
- **Breakable Blocks**: `2x + 3` where x = level
- **Unbreakable Blocks**: Always exactly 2 per level
- **Examples**:
  - Level 1: 5 breakable + 2 unbreakable = 7 total
  - Level 2: 7 breakable + 2 unbreakable = 9 total
  - Level 3: 9 breakable + 2 unbreakable = 11 total

## 🎮 **New Gameplay Mechanics**

### **Multi-Ball Physics**
- **All Balls Active**: Multiple balls can hit bricks simultaneously
- **Independent Movement**: Each ball moves and bounces independently
- **Collision Detection**: All collision logic works with multiple balls
- **Visual Clarity**: All balls are drawn and updated properly

### **Enhanced UI**
- **Balls Counter**: Shows remaining balls (3, 2, 1, 0)
- **Lives Display**: Still shows hearts for lives
- **Level Progression**: Clear feedback on level completion rewards

### **Strategic Depth**
- **Risk/Reward**: More balls = more scoring potential but more risk
- **Resource Management**: Players must manage their ball count carefully
- **Progressive Difficulty**: More blocks per level with guaranteed unbreakable obstacles

The game now has much more strategic depth with the multi-ball system, rewarding level completion with extra lives, and a more challenging but fair block distribution!
